## send

Send Campaign. `POST /campaigns/{campaign_id}/send`

Send a campaign immediately

Optional body {"acknowledge_warmup_warning": true} (no body = false). A large WhatsApp campaign on a number that is still warming up is refused with HTTP 409 detail = {"code": "warmup_acknowledgement_required", "message": ..., "warmup": <warm-up assessment>} unless acknowledged or split over days (send_split_config). Nothing is prepared or sent on 409. A split plan that would run too long is refused with HTTP 422 {"code": "split_plan_too_long", "message": ...}.

```php
$result = $sendseven->campaigns()->send(campaignId: 'campaign_id');
```

- Scopes: `campaigns:send`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$campaignId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$body` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | The request body |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `array<array-key, mixed>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Campaigns/send_campaign_api_v1_campaigns__campaign_id__send_post)

## sendNextBatch

Send Next Batch. `POST /campaigns/{campaign_id}/send-next-batch`

Send the next batch of a campaign sent in batches

Only for a campaign that finished a batch: status = "paused" with throttle_reason = "batch_complete", or one that ended as completed / failed while recipients were still waiting (it continues its unfinished batch first, if any). Anything else returns HTTP 409 {"code": "campaign_not_awaiting_batch", "message": ...} (also when two requests race: only the first one sends a batch). HTTP 422 send_pacing_unavailable while batch sending is briefly unavailable.

```php
$result = $sendseven->campaigns()->sendNextBatch(campaignId: 'campaign_id');
```

- Scopes: `campaigns:send`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$campaignId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$body` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | The request body |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `SendNextBatch`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Campaigns/send_next_batch_api_v1_campaigns__campaign_id__send_next_batch_post)

## getSendPlan

Get Campaign Send Plan. `GET /campaigns/{campaign_id}/send-plan`

Send plan: speed, batches and estimated duration

Read-only estimate for the campaign's audience at its saved send speed and batch size, or at the values given as query parameters (to preview a change before saving it). effective_rate_per_minute is the requested speed capped by what the campaign's channels can send, and rate_limited_by says which of the two decides ("campaign" or "channel"). channels[] lists each channel's recipients and maximum messages per second. eta_seconds estimates the time to send everyone who is left (time paused between batches not included); eta_seconds_per_batch the time per batch. pacing_available = false means send speed and batches are not available for this account yet.

```php
$result = $sendseven->campaigns()->getSendPlan(campaignId: 'campaign_id');
```

- Scopes: `campaigns:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$campaignId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$sendRateLimit` | `?int` | no | Preview this send speed (messages per minute, 1-60000) instead of the saved one |
| `$sendBatchSize` | `?int` | no | Preview this batch size (>= 1) instead of the saved one |

Returns `SendPlan`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Campaigns/get_campaign_send_plan_api_v1_campaigns__campaign_id__send_plan_get)

# Canned Responses

`$sendseven->cannedResponses()` — 7 endpoints.

| Method | HTTP | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`list()`](#list) | `GET /canned-responses` | List Canned Responses |
| [`create()`](#create) | `POST /canned-responses` | Create Canned Response |
| [`getByShortcut()`](#getbyshortcut) | `GET /canned-responses/by-shortcut/{shortcut}` | Get By Shortcut |
| [`listCategories()`](#listcategories) | `GET /canned-responses/categories` | List Categories |
| [`delete()`](#delete) | `DELETE /canned-responses/{canned_response_id}` | Delete Canned Response |
| [`get()`](#get) | `GET /canned-responses/{canned_response_id}` | Get Canned Response |
| [`update()`](#update) | `PUT /canned-responses/{canned_response_id}` | Update Canned Response |

## list

List Canned Responses. `GET /canned-responses`

List canned responses visible to the current user.

Returns the user's own responses and all shared responses. Users with canned_responses:settings scope see all responses in the tenant.

```php
$result = $sendseven->cannedResponses()->list();
```

- Scopes: `canned_responses:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$page` | `?int` | no | Page number (1-indexed) |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no | Items per page |
| `$category` | `?string` | no | Filter by category |
| `$search` | `?string` | no | Search in title, content, and shortcut |

Returns `Page<CannedResponse>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Canned%20Responses/list_canned_responses_api_v1_canned_responses_get)

## create

Create Canned Response. `POST /canned-responses`

Create a new canned response.

By default, responses are personal (visible only to you). Set is_shared=true to make it visible to all team members (requires canned_responses:settings scope).

```php
$result = $sendseven->cannedResponses()->create(title: 'title', content: 'content');
```

- Scopes: `canned_responses:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$title` | `string` | yes | Display title for the canned response |
| `$content` | `string` | yes | The actual response text |
| `$shortcut` | `?string` | no | Keyboard shortcut (e.g., 'greeting'). Stored lowercase. |
| `$category` | `?string` | no | Category for organization (e.g., 'Greetings', 'Support') |
| `$isShared` | `?bool` | no | If true, visible to all team members. If false, only visible to creator. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `CannedResponse`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Canned%20Responses/create_canned_response_api_v1_canned_responses_post)

## getByShortcut

Get By Shortcut. `GET /canned-responses/by-shortcut/{shortcut}`

Get a canned response by its shortcut.

Used for slash command lookups (e.g., /greeting). The shortcut is case-insensitive and the leading slash is optional.

```php
$result = $sendseven->cannedResponses()->getByShortcut(shortcut: 'shortcut');
```

- Scopes: `canned_responses:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$shortcut` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `CannedResponse`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Canned%20Responses/get_by_shortcut_api_v1_canned_responses_by_shortcut__shortcut__get)

## listCategories

List Categories. `GET /canned-responses/categories`

# Channel Connect

`$sendseven->channelConnect()` — 6 endpoints.

| Method | HTTP | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`listTokens()`](#listtokens) | `GET /channel-connect-tokens` | List Tokens |
| [`createToken()`](#createtoken) | `POST /channel-connect-tokens` | Create Token |
| [`delegate()`](#delegate) | `POST /channel-connect-tokens/delegate` | Delegate Connect |
| [`revokeToken()`](#revoketoken) | `DELETE /channel-connect-tokens/{token_id}` | Revoke Token |
| [`getToken()`](#gettoken) | `GET /channel-connect-tokens/{token_id}` | Get Token |
| [`getTokenAuditLogs()`](#gettokenauditlogs) | `GET /channel-connect-tokens/{token_id}/audit-logs` | Get Token Audit Logs |

## listTokens

List Tokens. `GET /channel-connect-tokens`

List channel connect tokens for this tenant.

By default, only shows active (non-expired, non-revoked) tokens. Use query parameters to include inactive tokens.

```php
$result = $sendseven->channelConnect()->listTokens();
```

- Scopes: `channels:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$includeExpired` | `?bool` | no | Include expired tokens |
| `$includeRevoked` | `?bool` | no | Include revoked tokens |
| `$page` | `?int` | no | Page number (1-indexed) |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no | Items per page |

Returns `Page<ChannelConnectToken>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Channel%20Connect/list_tokens_api_v1_channel_connect_tokens_get)

## createToken

Create Token. `POST /channel-connect-tokens`

Create a new channel connect token.

Generates a secure, time-limited token that can be shared with partners or clients to allow them to connect messaging channels without full platform access.

```php
$result = $sendseven->channelConnect()->createToken(allowedChannelTypes: []);
```

- Scopes: `channels:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$allowedChannelTypes` | `list<string>` | yes | Channel types allowed to connect: telegram, whatsapp, instagram, messenger, gmail, smtp_imap, proxy, sendgrid_byok, mailgun_byok, sendgrid_managed, sms |
| `$name` | `?string` | no | User-friendly name for this token (e.g., 'Acme Corp Setup') |
| `$expiresInHours` | `?int` | no | Token validity in hours (1-168, default 24) |
| `$maxUses` | `?int` | no | Maximum number of successful connections (1-100, default 10) |
| `$useWindowMinutes` | `?int` | no | Grace period in minutes after first use (5-1440, default 30) |
| `$allowedChannelModes` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Optional per-channel connect-mode restrictions. Shape: {"instagram": ["messaging","social"], "messenger": ["business_messaging","business_social","personal_social"], "whatsapp": ["classic","coexistence"]}. An ABSENT channel key (or a null value) means ALL modes are allowed for that channel (backwards compatible). A channel key MUST list at least one mode — to allow every mode, omit the key rather than passing []. Enforcement is the intersection of these modes with the tenant's feature gating, fail-closed. |
| `$partnerName` | `?string` | no | Partner/client name to display on connect page |
| `$partnerRedirectUrl` | `?string` | no | URL to redirect to after successful connection |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `ChannelConnectTokenCreated`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Channel%20Connect/create_token_api_v1_channel_connect_tokens_post)

## delegate

Delegate Connect. `POST /channel-connect-tokens/delegate`

Hand a channel connect over to a colleague by email.

Creates a short-lived connect token scoped to the given channel types and mails the link to email. Intended for the channel setup wizard, where the person doing the setup often lacks the third-party platform access the connect needs (typically: they are not an admin of the Meta Business portfolio that owns the WhatsApp number or the Facebook Page).

```php
$result = $sendseven->channelConnect()->delegate(email: 'email', channelTypes: []);
```

- Scopes: `channels:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$email` | `string` | yes | Address of the colleague/agency who will do the connect |
| `$channelTypes` | `list<string>` | yes | Channel types the link may connect — normally a single platform. The consolidated email option expands to its provider sub-types. |
| `$recipientName` | `?string` | no | Recipient display name used in the email salutation |
| `$note` | `?string` | no | Optional message from the requester, shown in the email |
| `$expiresInHours` | `?int` | no | Link validity in hours (1-168, default 48) |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `ChannelConnectDelegate`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Channel%20Connect/delegate_connect_api_v1_channel_connect_tokens_delegate_post)

## revokeToken

Revoke Token. `DELETE /channel-connect-tokens/{token_id}`

Revoke a channel connect token.

Revoking a token immediately prevents any further use. This action cannot be undone - create a new token if needed.

```php
$result = $sendseven->channelConnect()->revokeToken(tokenId: 'token_id');
```

- Scopes: `channels:delete`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$tokenId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$reason` | `?string` | no | Reason for revocation (for audit purposes) |

Returns `Delete`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Channel%20Connect/revoke_token_api_v1_channel_connect_tokens__token_id__delete)

## getToken

Get Token. `GET /channel-connect-tokens/{token_id}`

Get details of a specific channel connect token.

Note: The raw token value is NOT included - it was only shown at creation.

```php
$result = $sendseven->channelConnect()->getToken(tokenId: 'token_id');
```

- Scopes: `channels:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$tokenId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `ChannelConnectToken`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Channel%20Connect/get_token_api_v1_channel_connect_tokens__token_id__get)

## getTokenAuditLogs

Get Token Audit Logs. `GET /channel-connect-tokens/{token_id}/audit-logs`

Get audit logs for a specific channel connect token.

Returns all events related to this token including: - Token creation - Public page views - Connection attempts (success/failure) - Revocation

- Scopes: `channels:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no | Items per page |

Returns `Page<ChannelConnectAuditLog>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Channel%20Connect/get_token_audit_logs_api_v1_channel_connect_tokens__token_id__audit_logs_get)

## deleteWhatsAppUsername

Delete Whatsapp Username. `DELETE /channels/{channel_id}/whatsapp/username`

Release the WhatsApp business username held by this channel's number.

WhatsApp does not return a released handle to the pool immediately, so someone else may not be able to claim it right away — and neither can you. Treat this as destructive.

```php
$result = $sendseven->channels()->deleteWhatsAppUsername(channelId: 'channel_id');
```

- Scopes: `channels:write`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$channelId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `WhatsAppUsernameDelete`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Channels/delete_whatsapp_username_api_v1_channels__channel_id__whatsapp_username_delete)

## getWhatsAppUsername

Get Whatsapp Username. `GET /channels/{channel_id}/whatsapp/username`

Get the WhatsApp business username claimed by this channel's phone number.

A username lets customers reach the business through wa.me/<username> without knowing its phone number. It belongs to the PHONE NUMBER, so each WhatsApp channel has at most one.

```php
$result = $sendseven->channels()->getWhatsAppUsername(channelId: 'channel_id');
```

- Scopes: `channels:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$channelId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `WhatsAppUsername`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Channels/get_whatsapp_username_api_v1_channels__channel_id__whatsapp_username_get)

## setWhatsAppUsername

Set Whatsapp Username. `POST /channels/{channel_id}/whatsapp/username`

Claim or change the WhatsApp business username for this channel's number.

Format: 3-35 characters of lowercase letters, numbers, periods and underscores; at least one letter; no leading/trailing period, no .., no www prefix, no domain-like suffix. Periods and underscores are distinct.

```php
$result = $sendseven->channels()->setWhatsAppUsername(channelId: 'channel_id', username: 'username');
```

- Scopes: `channels:write`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$channelId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$username` | `string` | yes | 3-35 characters of lowercase letters, numbers, periods and underscores; must contain a letter, may not start/end with a period, contain '..', start with 'www' or end with a domain suffix |
| `$forceTransfer` | `?bool` | no | Only for retrying after error 147005: moves the username off another phone number in the same Meta portfolio |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `WhatsAppUsernameUpdate`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Channels/set_whatsapp_username_api_v1_channels__channel_id__whatsapp_username_post)

## translateEmailMessage

Translate Email Message. `POST /email-messages/{email_message_id}/translate`

Translate an email message body and cache the result in email metadata.

Cached translations are stored in email_metadata.translations so repeated requests for the same language return instantly.

$result = $sendseven->chatTranslation()->translateEmailMessage(emailMessageId: 'email_message_id', targetLanguage: 'target_language');

# Comment Rules

`$sendseven->commentRules()` — 5 endpoints.

| Method | HTTP | Summary |
|---|---|---|

## listSocial

List Social Comment Rules. `GET /social-comment-rules`

List comment auto-reply rules, in evaluation order.

Rules are returned in the order they are EVALUATED (priority ascending — lower runs first), so the list reads top-to-bottom exactly as it behaves.

```php
$sendseven->commentRules()->listSocial();
```

- Scopes: `flows:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$channelId` | `?string` | no | Filter by channel |
| `$enabled` | `?bool` | no | Filter by enabled state |
| `$page` | `?int` | no |  |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no |  |

Returns `void`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Comment%20Rules/list_social_comment_rules_api_v1_social_comment_rules_get)

## createSocial

Create Social Comment Rule. `POST /social-comment-rules`

Create a comment auto-reply rule.

```php
$sendseven->commentRules()->createSocial(name: 'name', channelId: 'channel_id');
```

- Scopes: `flows:write`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$name` | `string` | yes | Operator-facing label, e.g. "Summer sale — send the code". |
| `$channelId` | `string` | yes | The Instagram or Facebook channel this rule watches. |
| `$enabled` | `?bool` | no | Disabled rules are skipped entirely during evaluation. |
| `$priority` | `?int` | no | Evaluation order — LOWER runs FIRST (same convention as flows). The first matching rule wins; no further rule is evaluated. Ties are broken by specificity (a post-scoped, keyworded rule beats a catch-all), then by age. |
| `$postScope` | `SocialCommentRulePostScope\|string\|null` | no | Watch every post on the channel, or only selected posts. |
| `$postIds` | `list<string>\|null` | no | Post identifiers to watch when post_scope is specific_posts. These are the platform's own post ids as returned by the channel's posts/media listing endpoint. |
| `$matchMode` | `SocialCommentRuleMatchMode\|string\|null` | no | any_comment reacts to every comment (no keywords needed, and it also matches comments with no text at all). contains / exact / starts_with compare against the keyword list, case-insensitively. |
| `$keywords` | `list<string>\|null` | no | Keywords to match. Ignored when match_mode is any_comment. |
| `$action` | `SocialCommentRuleAction\|string\|null` | no | Send a private reply, or hand the comment off to a flow. |
| `$replyText` | `?string` | no | The private reply to send. Supports the same {{placeholders}} as the flow Send node — for example {{contact.first_name}} — plus {{comment.text}}, {{comment.author}} and {{post.caption}}. |
| `$flowId` | `?string` | no | Flow to start when action is start_flow. The flow's trigger must be "Comment received". |
| `$postMessageOverrides` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Optional per-post wording: {post_id: message}. A post listed here gets that message instead of reply_text; every other post falls back to reply_text. |
| `$replyButtons` | `list<array<string, mixed>>\|null` | no | Up to 3 buttons attached to the private reply. Supported on both Facebook Messenger and Instagram. A control the rule's channel cannot carry is rejected when the rule is saved, not silently stripped when it fires. Only meaningful when action is send_private_reply. |
| `$replyQuickReplies` | `list<array<string, mixed>>\|null` | no | DEPRECATED / IGNORED. Comment private replies are buttons-only since 2026-08-13. This field is still accepted for backwards compatibility so older clients do not get a 422, but it is never validated, stored, or sent — use reply_buttons instead. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `void`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Comment%20Rules/create_social_comment_rule_api_v1_social_comment_rules_post)

```

## listInbox

Comment inbox — comments across all posts. `GET /comments`

Every comment in the workspace, newest first, filtered by state — the screen an agent actually works from. It exists so nobody has to guess which post has something waiting on it: GET /comments?state=unanswered is the whole queue.

Defaults to state=unanswered, because that is the question this view answers. Pass state explicitly (repeatable) for anything else, or state=pending& state=auto_replied&state=replied&state=handled&state=ignored for everything.

```php
$result = $sendseven->comments()->listInbox();
```

- Scopes: `messages:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$channelId` | `?string` | no | Only comments on this channel's posts. |
| `$state` | `list<string>\|null` | no | Repeatable state filter: unanswered (alias of pending), pending, auto_replied, replied, handled, ignored. Defaults to unanswered. |
| `$includeOwner` | `?bool` | no | Include the connected account's own comments (our public replies). |
| `$includeReply` | `?bool` | no | Hydrate private_reply for answered comments. |
| `$includePost` | `?bool` | no | Embed each comment's post reference. One extra query per page; turn it off if you only need the comments themselves. |
| `$sortOrder` | `?string` | no | Order by commented_at. Defaults to desc (newest first); pass asc to work the queue oldest-first. |
| `$page` | `?int` | no | Page number (1-indexed) |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no | Items per page |

Returns `Page<SocialComment>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Comments/list_comment_inbox_api_v1_comments_get)

## resubscribeMessenger

Subscribe Facebook Messenger Page(s) to the comment webhook. `POST /comments/messenger/resubscribe`

Fix a Facebook Messenger Page that the capability probe reported as resubscribe_required — i.e. the connection is otherwise fine, the Page is just not subscribed to the feed webhook field that delivers post comments.

Unlike Instagram (which needs a real permission the customer can only add by reconnecting), no permission is missing here: the stored Page token already carries everything Facebook private replies need. So instead of sending the customer to reconnect, we do it for them — this POSTs the Page's subscribed_apps with the complete Messenger field list plus feed (a full replace, never a merge; a Page that also backs a legacy page-backed Instagram channel keeps comments on the union).

```php
$result = $sendseven->comments()->resubscribeMessenger();
```

- Scopes: `channels:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$channelId` | `?string` | no | Restrict to one Facebook Messenger channel. Omit to resubscribe every non-archived Messenger channel in the workspace. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `MessengerResubscribe`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Comments/resubscribe_messenger_comments_api_v1_comments_messenger_resubscribe_post)

## listSocialPosts

List posts that have comments. `GET /comments/posts`

The left-hand column of the Comments view: your Instagram media and Facebook Page posts, newest published first, each with its comment count and — the number that matters — how many of those comments are still unanswered.

Both counts are read from the post row itself rather than counted per request. They are maintained as comments arrive and recomputed whenever a comment is triaged or aged out, which is what keeps this list cheap on a post that went viral.

```php
$result = $sendseven->comments()->listSocialPosts();
```

- Scopes: `messages:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$channelId` | `?string` | no | Only posts on this Instagram / Facebook Messenger channel. Omit for every channel in the workspace. |
| `$hasUnanswered` | `?bool` | no | true → only posts with at least one unanswered comment; false → only fully cleared posts; omit for all. |
| `$page` | `?int` | no | Page number (1-indexed) |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no | Items per page |

Returns `Page<SocialPost>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Comments/list_social_posts_api_v1_comments_posts_get)

## refreshPostsInsightsBulk

Force-refresh cached insights for the workspace's recent posts. `POST /comments/posts/insights/refresh`

Force a LIVE Meta re-fetch for the workspace's most recent posts, overwrite the per-post cache columns, and return each refreshed post with its updated insights.

Bounded by limit (default 25, max 50, most-recent-first) so a large workspace never triggers a Graph storm — call it per channel with channel_id to refresh a specific account. A post whose page lacks insights access is refreshed to authorized: false + insights_not_authorized (persisted, never a 500); a non-IG/FB post to insights_unsupported_platform.

```php
$result = $sendseven->comments()->refreshPostsInsightsBulk();
```

- Scopes: `messages:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$channelId` | `?string` | no | Only refresh posts on this Instagram / Facebook channel. Omit to refresh the most recent posts across the workspace. |
| `$limit` | `?int` | no | How many most-recent posts to refresh. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `SocialPostInsightsBulkRefresh`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Comments/refresh_posts_insights_bulk_api_v1_comments_posts_insights_refresh_post)

## getPostsInsightsSummary

Aggregate insights totals across the workspace's posts. `GET /comments/posts/insights/summary`

Totals of the cached per-post insights across all of this workspace's comment-synced posts, for two windows: the last 30 days (posts published in that window) and all time.

Because per-post insights are Meta lifetime totals, the 30-day window selects WHICH posts are summed (by posted_at), it is NOT a per-day series — the numbers are still lifetime totals for the posts in scope. Each metric sums only the non-null cached values, so a metric a platform never exposes never distorts the total; post_count is how many posts had cached insights and contributed.

```php
$result = $sendseven->comments()->getPostsInsightsSummary();
```

- Scopes: `messages:read`

Returns `SocialPostInsightsSummary`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Comments/get_posts_insights_summary_api_v1_comments_posts_insights_summary_get)

## syncSocialPosts

Pull recent posts from Meta into the Posts list. `POST /comments/posts/sync`

Fetch the newest posts straight off the connected Instagram account / Facebook Page and upsert them into the Posts list — including posts that have no comments yet, which is what ordinary comment ingestion never surfaces.

Pass channel_id to sync one channel, or omit it to sync every connected social channel in the workspace. limit (default 25) is how many recent posts to pull per channel.

```php
$result = $sendseven->comments()->syncSocialPosts();
```

- Scopes: `messages:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$channelId` | `?string` | no | Only sync this Instagram / Facebook Messenger channel. Omit to sync every connected social channel in the workspace. |
| `$limit` | `?int` | no | How many of the newest posts to pull per channel. The list is paged as needed to reach this many. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `SyncPosts`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Comments/sync_social_posts_api_v1_comments_posts_sync_post)

## listPost

List the comments on one post. `GET /comments/posts/{post_id}/comments`

The comment thread for one post, oldest first so it reads chronologically.

post_id is our id, as returned by GET /comments/posts — not Meta's post id.

```php
$result = $sendseven->comments()->listPost(postId: 'post_id');
```

- Scopes: `messages:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

| `$state` | `list<string>\|null` | no | Repeatable state filter: unanswered (alias of pending), pending, auto_replied, replied, handled, ignored. Omit for all states. |
| `$includeOwner` | `?bool` | no | Include comments made by the connected account itself. Off by default: Meta echoes our own public replies back as ordinary comments, and they are noise in a work queue. |
| `$includeReply` | `?bool` | no | Hydrate each answered comment's private-reply message into private_reply. One extra query per page; turn it off for bulk exports. |
| `$sortOrder` | `?string` | no | Order by commented_at. Defaults to asc — a thread reads forwards. |

## refreshPostInsightsSingle

Force-refresh cached insights for one post. `POST /comments/posts/{post_id}/insights/refresh`

Force a LIVE Meta re-fetch for one comment-synced post, overwrite its cache columns (and insights_refreshed_at), and return the updated insights.

Degrades softly and persists the degraded state: a page lacking insights access → authorized: false + insights_not_authorized; an object Meta carries no insights for → insights_unavailable; a non-IG/FB channel → insights_unsupported_platform. Never a 500 for a Meta-side condition.

$result = $sendseven->comments()->refreshPostInsightsSingle(postId: 'post_id');
```

- Scopes: `messages:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

Returns `SocialPostInsightsRefresh`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Comments/refresh_post_insights_single_api_v1_comments_posts__post_id__insights_refresh_post)

## getSocial

Get one comment. `GET /comments/{comment_id}`

One comment, with its post and its private reply resolved.

comment_id is Meta's comment id — the same value POST /comments/{comment_id}/private-reply takes, the same value the comment.received webhook delivers, and the same value that appears on the outbound reply message as meta.comment_id. Our own comment id is accepted too.

```php
$result = $sendseven->comments()->getSocial(commentId: 'comment_id');
```

- Scopes: `messages:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$commentId` | `string` | yes | Meta's comment id (Instagram: numeric; Facebook: {post_id}_{comment_id}), or our own comment id. |
| `$includeReply` | `?bool` | no | Hydrate the private-reply message into private_reply. |

Returns `SocialComment`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Comments/get_social_comment_api_v1_comments__comment_id__get)

## triageSocial

Mark a comment handled or ignored (or reopen it). `PATCH /comments/{comment_id}`

Clear a comment from the unanswered queue without sending a private reply — for the comment you answered publicly, answered on the phone, or simply decided to skip. This is what stops the unanswered badge from being a number nobody can ever drive to zero.

* handled — dealt with, no private reply sent. * ignored — not actionable. * pending — reopen; undoes either of the above.

```php
$result = $sendseven->comments()->triageSocial(commentId: 'comment_id', state: 'state');
```

- Scopes: `conversations:update, messages:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$commentId` | `string` | yes | Meta's comment id, or our own comment id. |
| `$state` | `string` | yes | The new state: * handled — you answered publicly or off-platform. Clears it from the unanswered queue. * ignored — not actionable; skip it. * pending — reopen a comment that was marked handled or ignored by mistake. replied and auto_replied are not settable here: they mean a private reply message exists, and are set by actually sending one. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `SocialComment`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Comments/triage_social_comment_api_v1_comments__comment_id__patch)

## sendPrivateReply

Send a private reply to a comment. `POST /comments/{comment_id}/private-reply`

Send a private reply: a direct message to the person who left a public comment on your Instagram post or Facebook Page post.

Pass Meta's own comment id in the path — the value your comment.received webhook delivers. The comment does not have to be stored in your workspace; if it is not, supply channel_id in the body.

```php
$result = $sendseven->comments()->sendPrivateReply(commentId: 'comment_id', text: 'text');
```

- Scopes: `messages:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$commentId` | `string` | yes | Meta's comment id (Instagram: numeric; Facebook: {post_id}_{comment_id}) — exactly as delivered by the webhook. |
| `$text` | `string` | yes | The message body — or the button template's body when buttons is set. |
| `$channelId` | `?string` | no | The Instagram or Facebook Messenger channel whose post was commented on. Optional when the comment is already stored in your workspace (the stored channel wins); required otherwise — for example when you received the comment id from a comment.received webhook before it was persisted. |
| `$buttons` | `list<array<string, mixed>>\|null` | no | Up to 3 buttons, sent as a button template. Each is either a url button (opens a link) or a postback button (sends a value back to you, and can start a flow). Supported on both Facebook Messenger and Instagram. Cannot be combined with image_url. |
| `$quickReplies` | `list<array<string, mixed>>\|null` | no | DEPRECATED / IGNORED. Comment private replies are buttons-only since 2026-08-13. This field is still accepted so existing clients do not get a 422, but any chips supplied are silently ignored and never sent to Meta — use buttons instead. |
| `$imageUrl` | `?string` | no | Facebook Messenger only. Publicly reachable image URL sent as an attachment. Rejected with 400 on Instagram. Cannot be combined with buttons. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `PrivateReply`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Comments/send_comment_private_reply_api_v1_comments__comment_id__private_reply_post)

## sendPublicReply

Post a public reply under a comment. `POST /comments/{comment_id}/public-reply`

Post a public reply visible under a comment on your Instagram post or Facebook Page post — the ordinary "reply to this comment" action.

Pass Meta's own comment id in the path. If the comment is not stored in your workspace, supply channel_id in the body.

```php
$result = $sendseven->comments()->sendPublicReply(commentId: 'comment_id', text: 'text');
```

- Scopes: `messages:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$commentId` | `string` | yes | Meta's comment id (Instagram: numeric; Facebook: {post_id}_{comment_id}) — exactly as delivered by the webhook. |
| `$text` | `string` | yes | The public reply body, posted under the comment on the post (text only in v1 — no buttons, chips or media). Instagram/Facebook comment limit is 2200 characters. |
| `$channelId` | `?string` | no | The Instagram or Facebook Messenger channel whose post was commented on. Optional when the comment is already stored in your workspace (the stored channel wins); required otherwise — for example when you received the comment id from a comment.received webhook before it was persisted. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `PublicReply`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Comments/send_comment_public_reply_api_v1_comments__comment_id__public_reply_post)

## sendAndPrivateReply

Post a public reply and/or send a private DM in one call. `POST /comments/{comment_id}/reply`

Post a public reply and/or send a private DM to a comment in one call. Supply public_text, private_text, or both (at least one is required).

The private-DM fields (buttons, quick_replies, image_url) behave exactly as on POST /{comment_id}/private-reply and apply only to the DM.

```php
$result = $sendseven->comments()->sendAndPrivateReply(commentId: 'comment_id');
```

- Scopes: `messages:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$commentId` | `string` | yes | Meta's comment id (Instagram: numeric; Facebook: {post_id}_{comment_id}) — exactly as delivered by the webhook. |
| `$publicText` | `?string` | no | Public reply body, posted under the comment (text only). Omit to send only a private DM. |
| `$privateText` | `?string` | no | Private DM body — or the button template's body when buttons is set. Omit to post only a public reply. |
| `$channelId` | `?string` | no | The Instagram or Facebook Messenger channel whose post was commented on. Optional when the comment is stored in your workspace (the stored channel wins); required otherwise. |
| `$buttons` | `list<array<string, mixed>>\|null` | no | Up to 3 buttons on the private DM (sent as a button template). Cannot be combined with image_url. Ignored unless private_text is set. |
| `$quickReplies` | `list<array<string, mixed>>\|null` | no | DEPRECATED / IGNORED. Comment private replies are buttons-only since 2026-08-13. Accepted for backwards compatibility (no 422), but any chips are silently ignored and never sent to Meta — use buttons instead. |
| `$imageUrl` | `?string` | no | Facebook Messenger only. Image URL on the private DM. Rejected on Instagram. Cannot be combined with buttons. Ignored unless private_text is set. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `CommentAndPrivateReply`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Comments/send_comment_and_private_reply_api_v1_comments__comment_id__reply_post)

# Contact Bulk Actions

`$sendseven->contactBulkActions()` — 4 endpoints.

| Method | HTTP | Summary |
|---|---|---|

## list

List Bulk Actions. `GET /contacts/bulk-actions`

List this tenant's contact bulk action runs, newest first (audit history).

Returns the standard {"items": [...], "pagination": {...}} envelope; each item has the same shape as GET /contacts/bulk-actions/{id}.

```php
$sendseven->contactBulkActions()->list();
```

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

## execute

Execute Bulk Action. `POST /contacts/bulk-actions/execute`

Execute a previously previewed contact bulk action (202 Accepted).

Requires the confirmation_token from /contacts/bulk-actions/preview together with the IDENTICAL selection + actions. Errors:

```php
$result = $sendseven->contactBulkActions()->execute(selection: [], actions: [], confirmationToken: 'confirmation_token');
```

- Scopes: `contacts:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$selection` | `array<string, mixed>` | yes |  |
| `$actions` | `list<array<string, mixed>>` | yes | Ordered list of actions, executed in order per contact |
| `$confirmationToken` | `string` | yes | Signed token from POST /contacts/bulk-actions/preview |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `BulkActionExecute`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Contact%20Bulk%20Actions/execute_bulk_action_api_v1_contacts_bulk_actions_execute_post)

## preview

Preview Bulk Action. `POST /contacts/bulk-actions/preview`

Preview a contact bulk action (mass edit) — no changes are made.

Validates the selection and every action against the tenant (tags/list/ custom field existence + value/type checks, set_field allowlist), computes how many contacts the selection currently matches and returns a signed confirmation_token. Submit the IDENTICAL selection + actions together with that token to /contacts/bulk-actions/execute within expires_in_seconds (~10 minutes).

```php
$result = $sendseven->contactBulkActions()->preview(selection: [], actions: []);
```

- Scopes: `contacts:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$selection` | `array<string, mixed>` | yes |  |
| `$actions` | `list<array<string, mixed>>` | yes | Ordered list of actions, executed in order per contact |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `BulkActionPreview`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Contact%20Bulk%20Actions/preview_bulk_action_api_v1_contacts_bulk_actions_preview_post)

## get

Get Bulk Action. `GET /contacts/bulk-actions/{bulk_action_id}`

Poll one contact bulk action run (status + audit detail).

status: pending → processing → completed | failed. affected_count is the running total of actually-changed contacts (committed per chunk) and the final total once completed. error carries the failure reason (failed) or a truncated summary of individually skipped contacts (completed).

```php
$result = $sendseven->contactBulkActions()->get(bulkActionId: 'bulk_action_id');
```

- Scopes: `contacts:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$bulkActionId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `BulkActionStatus`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Contact%20Bulk%20Actions/get_bulk_action_api_v1_contacts_bulk_actions__bulk_action_id__get)

## confirmMergeSuggestion

Confirm Contact Merge Suggestion. `POST /contact-merge-suggestions/{suggestion_id}/confirm`

Confirm a contact merge suggestion: merge the visitor contact into the matched contact.

The request body must be {"confirmed": true}; anything else returns 422. The unverified contact (source_contact) is merged into the existing contact (target_contact), exactly like POST /contacts/{contact_id}/merge: conversations, messages, notes, tags and contact methods move to the surviving contact. This cannot be undone.

```php
$result = $sendseven->contacts()->confirmMergeSuggestion(suggestionId: 'suggestion_id');
```

- Scopes: `contacts:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$suggestionId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$body` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | The request body |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `ContactMergeSuggestion`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Contacts/confirm_contact_merge_suggestion_api_v1_contact_merge_suggestions__suggestion_id__confirm_post)

## dismissMergeSuggestion

Dismiss Contact Merge Suggestion. `POST /contact-merge-suggestions/{suggestion_id}/dismiss`

Dismiss a contact merge suggestion and keep both contacts separate.

A dismissed pair is not suggested again. Returns 404 when the suggestion does not exist and 409 with error_code: suggestion_not_pending when it was already confirmed or dismissed. conversation_id and source_contact are null in the response when you cannot open the visitor's conversation.

```php
$result = $sendseven->contacts()->dismissMergeSuggestion(suggestionId: 'suggestion_id');
```

- Scopes: `contacts:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$suggestionId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `ContactMergeSuggestion`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Contacts/dismiss_contact_merge_suggestion_api_v1_contact_merge_suggestions__suggestion_id__dismiss_post)

## list

List Contacts. `GET /contacts`

List contacts with pagination, search, server-side sorting, custom-field and list-subscription filtering.

Returns a paginated list of contacts matching the search criteria. Each contact includes tags and custom fields.

```php
$result = $sendseven->contacts()->list();
```

- Scopes: `contacts:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$page` | `?int` | no | Page number (1-indexed) |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no | Items per page (max 250) |
| `$search` | `?string` | no | Search by name, phone, email, or IDs |
| `$includeLiveChat` | `?bool` | no | Include live chat contacts |
| `$sortBy` | `?string` | no | Field to sort by. 'custom_field' requires custom_field_id. |
| `$sortDir` | `?string` | no | Sort direction |
| `$customFieldId` | `?string` | no | custom_field_definitions.id used for filtering and/or as the sort target when sort_by='custom_field'. |
| `$customFieldValue` | `?string` | no | Value to filter by. Requires custom_field_id. The match strategy is chosen SERVER-SIDE from the field's field_type (text=contains, select=exact, number=operator-based). If custom_field_id is set without this, filters to contacts that have ANY value for that field. For op='between' this is the lower bound. |
| `$customFieldValueTo` | `?string` | no | Upper bound for the custom-field filter. Only used when custom_field_op='between' (number fields only); ignored otherwise. |
| `$customFieldOp` | `?string` | no | Optional comparison operator for the custom-field filter. If omitted, defaults are derived from the field_type (text->contains, select->eq, number->eq, others->eq). Numeric operators (gt/lt/gte/lte/between) are only valid for number fields; 'contains' is only valid for text-like fields. Incompatible combinations return 422. |
| `$listId` | `?string` | no | lists.id — filter to contacts by their subscription to that list. Must belong to the tenant (422 if not). |
| `$listSubscriptionStatus` | `?string` | no | Subscription status to match for list_id. Defaults to 'subscribed'. 'any' = a subscription row in ANY status; 'not_subscribed' = NOT currently subscribed (includes contacts with no row at all). Requires list_id (422). |
| `$listSubscriptionChannel` | `SubscriptionChannelType\|string\|null` | no | Optionally narrow the list filter to one subscription channel (subscription rows are per channel). Requires list_id (422). |
| `$tagId` | `list<string>\|null` | no | tags.id — filter to contacts carrying that tag. Repeatable (?tag_id=a&tag_id=b) to match contacts carrying ANY of the given tags (OR). Filters by tag id, NOT tag name; this is distinct from search (which never matches tags). Each id must belong to the tenant (422 if not). Combinable with search and the other filters (all AND-ed). |

Returns `Page<Contact>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Contacts/list_contacts_api_v1_contacts_get)

Honors the tenant's duplicate_contact_mode setting (or the optional duplicate_mode body field for a per-request override):

$result = $sendseven->contacts()->create();

Each value is validated and coerced to the field's type (see GET /custom-fields). On create, null / "" / [] entries are ignored. In auto_merge mode the given values overwrite the matched contact's values. Unknown or inactive fields are rejected with 422 unknown_field and nothing is written. |

## bulkDelete

Bulk Delete Contacts. `POST /contacts/bulk-delete`

Bulk delete multiple contacts and all their related data.

Accepts up to 100 contact IDs. Each contact is deleted individually using the same full-cascade GDPR deletion as single delete (conversations, messages, attachments, email transcripts, live-chat sessions and flow runs are all removed). Each contact commits independently, so one failure does not roll back the others.

```php
$result = $sendseven->contacts()->bulkDelete(contactIds: []);
```

- Scopes: `contacts:delete`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$contactIds` | `list<string>` | yes |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `BulkDeleteContacts`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Contacts/bulk_delete_contacts_api_v1_contacts_bulk_delete_post)

## listDuplicateGroups

List Duplicate Groups. `GET /contacts/duplicates`

List groups of contacts sharing the same identifier (potential duplicates).

Returns groups by signal value. Each group contains 2+ contacts that share the signal, sorted by created_at ascending (oldest first — the typical primary candidate).

```php
$result = $sendseven->contacts()->listDuplicateGroups();
```

- Scopes: `contacts:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$signals` | `?string` | no | Comma-separated list of signals to use for duplicate detection. Allowed: phone, email, platform_id, name. 'name' is opt-in (false-positive prone). |
| `$page` | `?int` | no |  |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no |  |

Returns `Page<DuplicateGroup>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Contacts/list_duplicate_groups_api_v1_contacts_duplicates_get)

## export

Export Contacts. `POST /contacts/export`

Start an async contact export to CSV or XLSX (202 Accepted).

Accepts the SAME filter parameters as GET /contacts (search + custom-field filter + list-subscription filter) so a filtered contact list can be exported exactly as seen on screen. With no filters, ALL contacts are exported.

```php
$result = $sendseven->contacts()->export();
```

| `$includeLiveChat` | `?bool` | no | Include live chat contacts (same as GET /contacts) |
| `$customFieldId` | `?string` | no | custom_field_definitions.id used for filtering (same as GET /contacts). |
| `$customFieldValue` | `?string` | no | Custom-field filter value (same semantics as GET /contacts). |
| `$customFieldValueTo` | `?string` | no | Upper bound for custom_field_op='between' (same as GET /contacts). |
| `$customFieldOp` | `?string` | no | Custom-field comparison operator (same as GET /contacts). |
| `$listId` | `?string` | no | lists.id — filter by list subscription (same as GET /contacts). |
| `$listSubscriptionStatus` | `?string` | no | Subscription status for list_id, default 'subscribed' (same semantics as GET /contacts). Requires list_id. |

## downloadExport

Download Contact Export. `GET /contacts/export/{job_id}/download`

Download a finished contact export (302 redirect to a signed URL).

Only the requesting tenant's own COMPLETED export jobs can be downloaded (404 unknown job, 403 foreign tenant, 409 not finished yet). A fresh short-lived (60 min) signed Cloud Storage URL is minted on every call. With ?redirect=false the signed URL is returned as JSON {"download_url": ..., "filename": ...} instead of a 302.

```php
$sendseven->contacts()->downloadExport(jobId: 'job_id');
```

- Scopes: `contacts:export`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$jobId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$redirect` | `?bool` | no | true (default): 302 redirect to the signed URL. false: return {download_url, filename} JSON instead — needed by browser SPAs whose auth is Bearer-header-only (a top-level navigation cannot carry the header, and an XHR cannot follow the 302 to Cloud Storage because the bucket has no CORS rule). |

Returns `void`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Contacts/download_contact_export_api_v1_contacts_export__job_id__download_get)

## getExportStatus

Get Contact Export Status. `GET /contacts/export/{job_id}/status`

Poll the status/progress of an async contact export job.

When status is completed, download_url points at the download endpoint (302 to a short-lived signed URL). failed carries error_message.

```php
$result = $sendseven->contacts()->getExportStatus(jobId: 'job_id');
```

- Scopes: `contacts:export`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$jobId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `ContactExportStatus`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Contacts/get_contact_export_status_api_v1_contacts_export__job_id__status_get)

## delete

Delete Contact. `DELETE /contacts/{contact_id}`

Delete a contact and all related data.

Performs GDPR-compliant deletion (full cascade): - All PII is removed (subscriptions, custom fields, tags, campaign data) - The contact's conversations AND their messages, attachments (incl. stored files), reactions, email transcripts, live-chat sessions and flow runs are permanently deleted — nothing connected to the customer is retained - Billing records are preserved for invoicing

```php
$result = $sendseven->contacts()->delete(contactId: 'contact_id');
```

- Scopes: `contacts:delete`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$contactId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `ContactDelete`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Contacts/delete_contact_api_v1_contacts__contact_id__delete)

## get

Get Contact. `GET /contacts/{contact_id}`

Get a specific contact with custom fields and tags.

If the requested ID is the UUID of a contact that has been merged into another (i.e., it appears in contact_aliases.old_contact_id), the response returns the surviving contact, includes a merged_from object describing the merge, and sets the X-Merged-Into response header to the surviving contact's UUID.

```php
$result = $sendseven->contacts()->get(contactId: 'contact_id');
```

- Scopes: `contacts:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$contactId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `Contact`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Contacts/get_contact_api_v1_contacts__contact_id__get)

## partialUpdate

Partial Update Contact. `PATCH /contacts/{contact_id}`

Partial update a contact

custom_fields (optional) MERGES typed custom field values, keyed by custom field definition ID (preferred) or field key: only the given fields are touched, null / "" / [] clears one. Every entry is validated against the field type BEFORE anything is written; any failure returns 422 with one structured error per field (code: unknown_field, duplicate_field, invalid_type, invalid_format, not_an_option, out_of_range, too_long, too_many_fields) and nothing is changed. When custom_fields is sent, the response includes the contact's custom_fields map.

```php
$result = $sendseven->contacts()->partialUpdate(contactId: 'contact_id');
```

- Scopes: `contacts:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$contactId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$name` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$firstName` | `?string` | no | Contact's first/given name |
| `$lastName` | `?string` | no | Contact's last/family name |
| `$phone` | `?string` | no | Phone number with country code (E.164, e.g. +491754633940) |
| `$email` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$avatarUrl` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$languages` | `?string` | no | Comma-separated ISO 639-1 language codes (e.g. 'en,de,fr'). |
| `$birthday` | `?string` | no | Contact's date of birth (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `$customFields` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Custom field values to MERGE, keyed by custom field definition ID (preferred) or field key. Only the given fields are touched; null / "" / [] clears that field. Omitting custom_fields (or sending null for the whole map) changes nothing. Validated per field_type; any invalid entry rejects the whole request with 422 and nothing is written. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `Contact`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Contacts/partial_update_contact_api_v1_contacts__contact_id__patch)

## listAttachments

List Contact Attachments. `GET /contacts/{contact_id}/attachments`

Keyset-paginated, newest-first list of ALL media exchanged with a contact across every one of their conversations.

Powers the WhatsApp-profile-style media gallery on the contact-detail page. Covers every media category — images, video, audio, voice notes, AND documents/files (nothing is filtered out). Each item carries a short-lived (60 min) signed VIEW url into the private media bucket plus, when available, a signed thumbnail url — never raw bucket urls.

```php
$result = $sendseven->contacts()->listAttachments(contactId: 'contact_id');
```

- Scopes: `contacts:read`, `messages:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$contactId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$cursor` | `?string` | no | Opaque cursor from a previous page's next_cursor |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no | Page size (default 30, max 100) |

Returns `ContactAttachments`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Contacts/list_contact_attachments_api_v1_contacts__contact_id__attachments_get)

## getAvailableChannels

Get Contact Available Channels. `GET /contacts/{contact_id}/available-channels`

Get list of channels available to reach a contact.

Returns all channels the tenant has configured that the contact has identifiers for, along with channel-specific status:

```php
$result = $sendseven->contacts()->getAvailableChannels(contactId: 'contact_id');
```

- Scopes: `contacts:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

Returns `AvailableChannels`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Contacts/get_contact_available_channels_api_v1_contacts__contact_id__available_channels_get)

## deleteAvatar

Delete Contact Avatar. `DELETE /contacts/{contact_id}/avatar`

Remove a contact's profile picture.

Clears the stored image and re-opens platform syncing: the next inbound message from this contact re-mirrors whatever picture the channel currently reports. Until then the UI shows the contact's initials.

```php
$result = $sendseven->contacts()->deleteAvatar(contactId: 'contact_id');
```

- Scopes: `contacts:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$contactId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `ContactAvatar`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Contacts/delete_contact_avatar_api_v1_contacts__contact_id__avatar_delete)

## uploadAvatar

Upload Contact Avatar. `POST /contacts/{contact_id}/avatar`

Upload a profile picture for a contact.

The image is downscaled to 256px and stored in our own bucket, then served from the permanent /api/v1/public/avatar/... proxy. A manually uploaded avatar is marked avatar_is_custom and is NEVER overwritten by the channel's own profile picture — remove it (DELETE this endpoint) to let platform syncing resume.

```php
$result = $sendseven->contacts()->uploadAvatar(contactId: 'contact_id', file: FilePart::fromPath('/path/to/file.pdf'));
```

- Scopes: `contacts:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$contactId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$file` | `FilePart` | yes |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `ContactAvatar`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Contacts/upload_contact_avatar_api_v1_contacts__contact_id__avatar_post)

## block

Block Contact. `POST /contacts/{contact_id}/block`

Block a contact across all channels.

Blocked contacts will have their inbound messages silently dropped and will not trigger bot responses. If the contact has an email address, it is also added to the email sender blacklist.

```php
$sendseven->contacts()->block(contactId: 'contact_id');
```

- Scopes: `contacts:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$contactId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `void`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Contacts/block_contact_api_v1_contacts__contact_id__block_post)

## listHistory

List Contact History. `GET /contacts/{contact_id}/history`

Unified timeline of conversations, flow runs, flow-sent messages, scheduled sends, all messages, and AI ticket summaries for a single contact.

Powers the contact-detail "History" card (Activity + Messages view modes). Returns a single keyset-paginated, time-descending stream merged from multiple SHARD tables — see :class:app.services.contact_history_service.ContactHistoryService for the per-source query strategy and batch lookups.

```php
$result = $sendseven->contacts()->listHistory(contactId: 'contact_id');
```

- Scopes: `contacts:read`, `flows:read`, `conversations:read`, `scheduler:read`, `knowledge_base:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$contactId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$types` | `list<string>\|null` | no | Filter by event_type. Repeatable. Allowed values: conversation, flow_run, flow_message, message, scheduler, ticket_summary. Omit to include all known types (current FE behavior). Use message for the flat all-messages stream that powers the Messages view mode; use scheduler for pending/fired scheduled sends; use ticket_summary for the contact's AI conversation summaries (editable KB documents). |
| `$dateFrom` | `?string` | no | ISO8601 lower bound on each source's sort column. |
| `$dateTo` | `?string` | no | ISO8601 upper bound on each source's sort column. |
| `$q` | `?string` | no | Substring filter (LIKE %q%). Ignored when shorter than 2 chars. Matches conversation.subject + last message text, flow.name, and message.text depending on the event_type. |
| `$cursor` | `?string` | no | Opaque cursor from a previous page's next_cursor. |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no | Page size (default 50, max 100). |

Returns `ContactHistory`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Contacts/list_contact_history_api_v1_contacts__contact_id__history_get)

## merge

Merge Contacts. `POST /contacts/{contact_id}/merge`

Manually merge one or more contacts into the contact at {contact_id}.

By default the OLDEST contact in the set ({contact_id} plus the secondary_ids) is used as primary. Pass primary_override: true to force {contact_id} as primary even if a secondary is older.

```php
$result = $sendseven->contacts()->merge(contactId: 'contact_id', secondaryIds: []);
```

- Scopes: `contacts:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$contactId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$secondaryIds` | `list<string>` | yes | UUIDs of contacts to merge into the primary contact (the {id} in the URL). |
| `$primaryOverride` | `?bool` | no | When False (default), the oldest contact among {id, *secondary_ids} is used as primary regardless of which UUID is in the URL. Set True to force {id} as primary even if a secondary is older. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `MergeContacts`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Contacts/merge_contacts_api_v1_contacts__contact_id__merge_post)

## previewMerge

Preview Merge Contacts. `POST /contacts/{contact_id}/merge/preview`

Preview what merging contacts would do to running flows. Nothing is changed.

Takes the same body as POST /contacts/{contact_id}/merge and picks the surviving contact the same way (oldest unless primary_override: true).

```php
$result = $sendseven->contacts()->previewMerge(contactId: 'contact_id', secondaryIds: []);
```

- Scopes: `contacts:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$contactId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$secondaryIds` | `list<string>` | yes | UUIDs of contacts to merge into the primary contact (the {id} in the URL). |
| `$primaryOverride` | `?bool` | no | When False (default), the oldest contact among {id, *secondary_ids} is used as primary regardless of which UUID is in the URL. Set True to force {id} as primary even if a secondary is older. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `MergeContactsPreview`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Contacts/preview_merge_contacts_api_v1_contacts__contact_id__merge_preview_post)

## listChannelMessages

List Contact Channel Messages. `GET /contacts/{contact_id}/messages`

Keyset-paginated stream of a contact's messages on a SINGLE channel, drawn from PRIOR conversations only.

Returns this contact's messages on channel_id from conversations OTHER than before_conversation_id whose parent conversation was created BEFORE the before_conversation_id conversation (i.e. earlier threads on the same channel). Newest-first, keyset-paginated on (created_at, id).

```php
$result = $sendseven->contacts()->listChannelMessages(contactId: 'contact_id', channelId: 'channel_id', beforeConversationId: 'before_conversation_id');
```

- Scopes: `contacts:read`, `messages:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$contactId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$channelId` | `string` | yes | Channel to scope the timeline to |
| `$beforeConversationId` | `string` | yes | The currently-open conversation; only PRIOR conversations are included |
| `$cursor` | `?string` | no | Opaque cursor from a previous page's next_cursor |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no | Page size (default 5, max 50) |

Returns `ContactChannelTimeline`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Contacts/list_contact_channel_messages_api_v1_contacts__contact_id__messages_get)

## listMethods

List Contact Methods. `GET /contacts/{contact_id}/methods`

List all contact methods for a contact.

Returns all external identifiers (phone numbers, emails, platform IDs) associated with this contact, optionally filtered by method type.

```php
$result = $sendseven->contacts()->listMethods(contactId: 'contact_id');
```

- Scopes: `contacts:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$contactId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$methodType` | `?string` | no | Filter by method type (phone, email, whatsapp_id, whatsapp_bsuid, telegram_id, messenger_id, instagram_id) |
| `$includeTechnical` | `?bool` | no | Include technical/internal method types in the response. Defaults to false — LIVE_CHAT (per-device visitor cookie UUID) and any future 'technical' types are hidden from the contact detail UI by default. Set true to include them (e.g. for admin tooling or debugging). |

Returns `list<ContactMethod>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Contacts/list_contact_methods_api_v1_contacts__contact_id__methods_get)

## createMethod

Create Contact Method. `POST /contacts/{contact_id}/methods`

Add a new contact method to a contact.

Creates a new external identifier (phone, email, platform ID) linked to this contact. For page-scoped types (messenger_id, instagram_id), a channel_id is required.

```php
$result = $sendseven->contacts()->createMethod(contactId: 'contact_id', methodType: 'method_type', value: 'value');
```

- Scopes: `contacts:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$contactId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$methodType` | `string` | yes | Type: phone, email, whatsapp_id, whatsapp_bsuid, telegram_id, messenger_id, instagram_id, linkedin, homepage, facebook, instagram_handle, social_other |
| `$value` | `string` | yes | The external identifier value |
| `$channelId` | `?string` | no | Required for messenger_id, instagram_id (page-scoped) and whatsapp_bsuid (business-portfolio-scoped) |
| `$displayName` | `?string` | no | Display name like @username or custom label for social_other |
| `$phoneType` | `?string` | no | Phone line type (only meaningful when method_type=phone). One of: mobile, fixed_line, fixed_line_or_mobile, voip, unknown. Auto-inferred from value if omitted. |
| `$isPrimary` | `?bool` | no | Set as primary for this method type |
| `$duplicateMode` | `DuplicateMode\|string\|null` | no | Optional per-request override for duplicate-contact handling. If omitted, the tenant's duplicate_contact_mode setting applies. Values: auto_merge, allow_duplicates, dont_allow_duplicates. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `ContactMethod`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Contacts/create_contact_method_api_v1_contacts__contact_id__methods_post)

## deleteMethod

Delete Contact Method. `DELETE /contacts/{contact_id}/methods/{method_id}`

Delete a contact method.

If the deleted method was primary, the next oldest method of the same type is automatically promoted. Denormalized fields (phone, email) on the contact are updated accordingly.

```php
$sendseven->contacts()->deleteMethod(contactId: 'contact_id', methodId: 'method_id');
```

- Scopes: `contacts:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$contactId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$methodId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `void`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Contacts/delete_contact_method_api_v1_contacts__contact_id__methods__method_id__delete)

## updateMethod

| `$value` | `?string` | no | Updated identifier value |
| `$displayName` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$phoneType` | `?string` | no | Override phone line type (only meaningful when method_type=phone). One of: mobile, fixed_line, fixed_line_or_mobile, voip, unknown. |

## unblock

## listConversationMergeSuggestions

List Conversation Contact Merge Suggestions. `GET /conversations/{conversation_id}/contact-merge-suggestions`

List pending contact merge suggestions for a conversation's contact.

A suggestion is created when a live chat visitor enters an email address or phone number (or the website passes a contact ID) that matches an existing contact. The conversation is never linked to that contact automatically: confirm the suggestion to merge the visitor into the existing contact, or dismiss it to keep them separate.

```php
$result = $sendseven->contacts()->listConversationMergeSuggestions(conversationId: 'conversation_id');
```

- Scopes: `conversations:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$conversationId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$page` | `?int` | no | Page number (1-indexed) |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no | Items per page |

Returns `Page<ContactMergeSuggestion>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Contacts/list_conversation_contact_merge_suggestions_api_v1_conversations__conversation_id__contact_merge_suggestions_get)

## list

List Conversations. `GET /conversations`

List all conversations for the tenant with pagination.

Respects multi-agent mode setting: - Multi-agent mode: Shows all conversations - Single-agent mode: Shows only assigned + unassigned (agents only)

```php
$result = $sendseven->conversations()->list();
```

- Scopes: `conversations:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$page` | `?int` | no | Page number (1-indexed) |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no | Items per page |
| `$status` | `?string` | no | Filter by tab/status: 'open' (excludes snoozed), 'snoozed', 'closed' |
| `$assignedTo` | `?string` | no | Filter by assignment: 'me', 'unassigned', 'me_and_unassigned', or user_id |
| `$needsReply` | `?bool` | no | Filter for conversations needing a reply |
| `$filter` | `?string` | no | Alias: 'unanswered' sets needs_reply=True |
| `$contactId` | `?string` | no | Filter by contact ID |
| `$search` | `?string` | no | Search by contact name, phone, email, or subject |
| `$inboxId` | `?string` | no | Filter to conversations in this custom inbox |
| `$channelType` | `?string` | no | Filter by channel type (e.g. whatsapp, telegram, sms, email, messenger, instagram, live_chat) |

Returns `Page<Conversation>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Conversations/list_conversations_api_v1_conversations_get)

## openOrCreate

Open Or Create Conversation. `POST /conversations/open-or-create`

Open an existing conversation or create a new one.

This is a simplified endpoint that does NOT send a message. Use this when you want to navigate to a conversation and let the user compose messages using the normal chat UI.

```php
$result = $sendseven->conversations()->openOrCreate(contactId: 'contact_id', channelId: 'channel_id');
```

- Scopes: `conversations:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$contactId` | `string` | yes | Contact UUID to start conversation with |
| `$channelId` | `string` | yes | Channel UUID to use for this conversation |
| `$contactMethodId` | `?string` | no | Optional. Bind the conversation to a SPECIFIC contact method (e.g. one of the contact's several email addresses / phone numbers) instead of resolving the recipient via the channel's primary method. Must belong to the same contact + tenant and be compatible with the channel's method type (a PHONE method is also accepted for a WhatsApp channel). For email the synthetic 'email_mailbox_<uuid>' / 'email_integration_<uuid>' channel_id is validated as an EMAIL method type. When a NEW conversation is created both contact_method_id and active_contact_method_id are set to this value; when an existing conversation is reused only active_contact_method_id is updated. When omitted, behavior is unchanged (recipient resolved via the channel's primary method). |
| `$action` | `?string` | no | Action to take: 'create_new', 'reopen_existing', or 'auto' (default). When using two-phase API, specify action explicitly to control webhook behavior. |
| `$reopenExisting` | `?bool` | no | DEPRECATED: Use action='reopen_existing' instead. If True and a closed conversation exists, reopen it. If False, always create new. |
| `$useConversationId` | `?string` | no | For email: specify an existing conversation ID to use instead of creating new. This allows continuing an existing email thread. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `OpenOrCreateConversation`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Conversations/open_or_create_conversation_api_v1_conversations_open_or_create_post)

## emailTranscript

Email Conversation Transcript. `POST /conversations/{conversation_id}/email-transcript`

Email the conversation transcript to the contact (or any address).

Offered when an agent closes a conversation (especially dead live-chat tickets where the visitor left before reading the replies), but callable for ANY conversation. Sends SYNCHRONOUSLY in-request: one branded HTML email (tenant logo/name header, localized greeting, optional agent note, the chat transcript, and the tenant's imprint/compliance footer) from the selected EmailMailbox.

```php
$result = $sendseven->conversations()->emailTranscript(conversationId: 'conversation_id', mailboxId: 'mailbox_id', toEmail: 'to_email');
```

- Scopes: `conversations:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$conversationId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$mailboxId` | `string` | yes | EmailMailbox id to send from (must be active and sendable). |
| `$toEmail` | `string` | yes | Recipient email address. Format is validated server-side (400 on invalid). |
| `$note` | `?string` | no | Optional free-text note from the agent, shown above the transcript (HTML-escaped; line breaks preserved). |
| `$saveAsContactMethod` | `?bool` | no | If true, store to_email as an EMAIL contact method on the conversation's contact (idempotent — no duplicate if it already exists). |
| `$language` | `?string` | no | Optional ISO 639-1 language override for the email copy (greeting/intro/subject/labels). Unsupported or missing values fall back to the contact's stored language, then English. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `EmailTranscript`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Conversations/email_conversation_transcript_api_v1_conversations__conversation_id__email_transcript_post)

## merge

Merge Conversation. `POST /conversations/{conversation_id}/merge`

Merge a source conversation into this one and reopen it.

The path conversation (conversation_id) SURVIVES and is reopened; the source_conversation_id from the body is merged in (all its messages, notes, tags, attachments, etc. move over) and then permanently deleted. Both conversations must belong to the SAME contact.

```php
$result = $sendseven->conversations()->merge(conversationId: 'conversation_id', sourceConversationId: 'source_conversation_id');
```

- Scopes: `conversations:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$conversationId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$sourceConversationId` | `string` | yes | ID of the conversation to merge in and delete |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `Conversation`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Conversations/merge_conversation_api_v1_conversations__conversation_id__merge_post)

## getSenderOptions

Get Conversation Sender Options. `GET /conversations/{conversation_id}/sender-options`

List email senders the caller may use for replying to this conversation.

Returns the user's accessible support-capable email connections, plus an ACL-override entry when the conversation's default reply sender (the receiving connection's outbound_provider) is NOT already in that set. The client pre-selects default_option_id and POSTs the chosen value as MessageCreate.sender_id on the outbound send. The server re-validates the choice on the send path.

```php
$result = $sendseven->conversations()->getSenderOptions(conversationId: 'conversation_id');
```

- Scopes: `conversations:read`
