## unsnooze

Unsnooze Conversation. `DELETE /conversations/{conversation_id}/snooze`

Clear a conversation's snooze (return it to the Open tab).

Sets snoozed_until and snooze_reopen_on_message back to NULL. Status is untouched. Idempotent — unsnoozing an already-unsnoozed conversation succeeds and still emits conversation.updated so stale client state converges.

```php
$result = $sendseven->conversations()->unsnooze(conversationId: 'conversation_id');
```

- Scopes: `conversations:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$conversationId` | `string` | yes |  |

## snooze

Snooze Conversation. `POST /conversations/{conversation_id}/snooze`

Snooze (postpone) a conversation.

Snooze is a DERIVED state: the conversation status stays open / assigned — it simply drops off the Open tab and appears on the Snoozed tab until snoozed_until passes (query-time expiry, no background job). Once the timestamp passes it behaves like a normal open conversation again.

```php
$result = $sendseven->conversations()->snooze(conversationId: 'conversation_id', snoozedUntil: 'snoozed_until');
```

- Scopes: `conversations:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$conversationId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$snoozedUntil` | `DateTimeInterface\|string` | yes | Timezone-aware ISO datetime when the snooze should expire. Must be in the future. After this moment the conversation behaves as a normal open conversation again. |
| `$reopenOnMessage` | `?bool` | no | When true, an inbound customer message arriving while the conversation is snoozed clears the snooze and returns it to the Open tab (handled by the inbound-message worker). |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `Conversation`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Conversations/snooze_conversation_api_v1_conversations__conversation_id__snooze_post)

## getSummary

Get Conversation Summary. `GET /conversations/{conversation_id}/summary`

Full AI ticket summary for a single conversation, broken into the three sections the contact-page timeline renders on expand: user_intent, summary, resolution.

Lazy-loaded by the FE when a ticket_summary timeline row is expanded — the timeline list itself only carries a 140-char summary_preview to keep the list payload small. Reads the text directly off the Conversation SHARD row (no KB-doc / RAG fetch).

```php
$result = $sendseven->conversations()->getSummary(conversationId: 'conversation_id');
```

- Scopes: `knowledge_base:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$conversationId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `ConversationSummaryDetail`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Conversations/get_conversation_summary_api_v1_conversations__conversation_id__summary_get)

## switchChannel

Switch Channel. `POST /conversations/{conversation_id}/switch-channel`

Generate channel switch deeplinks for a conversation.

Accepts a list of channel_ids to generate links for specific channels, or omit to generate for all active switchable channels.

```php
$result = $sendseven->conversations()->switchChannel(conversationId: 'conversation_id');
```

- Scopes: `conversations:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$conversationId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$channelIds` | `list<string>\|null` | no |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `ChannelSwitch`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Conversations/switch_channel_api_v1_conversations__conversation_id__switch_channel_post)

## getSwitchableChannels

Get Switchable Channels. `GET /conversations/{conversation_id}/switchable-channels`

List channels available for switching from this conversation.

Returns all active switchable channels (WhatsApp, Telegram, Messenger, Instagram) excluding the conversation's current channel. Used by the frontend to render a channel picker before generating deeplinks.

```php
$result = $sendseven->conversations()->getSwitchableChannels(conversationId: 'conversation_id');
```

- Scopes: `conversations:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$conversationId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `SwitchableChannels`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Conversations/get_switchable_channels_api_v1_conversations__conversation_id__switchable_channels_get)

## createTranscriptExport

Create Transcript Export. `POST /conversations/{conversation_id}/transcript`

Start an async transcript export (PDF or ZIP) for a conversation.

Creates a background job and returns it immediately with status queued (HTTP 202). Poll GET /conversations/{conversation_id}/transcript/{job_id} until status is completed (a download_url is then returned) or failed.

```php
$result = $sendseven->conversations()->createTranscriptExport(conversationId: 'conversation_id', format: 'format');
```

- Scopes: `conversations:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$conversationId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$format` | `string` | yes | Export artifact format: 'pdf' (transcript only) or 'zip' (transcript + attachments). |
| `$waitForSummary` | `?bool` | no | If true, the worker waits for the conversation's AI summary (conversation.ai_summary) to be populated before rendering, so the generated transcript can include the summary at the top. Defaults to false (render immediately). Does NOT affect export deduplication — a given (conversation, format) yields the same artifact regardless. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `TranscriptExportJob`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Conversations/create_transcript_export_api_v1_conversations__conversation_id__transcript_post)

## getTranscriptExport

Get Transcript Export. `GET /conversations/{conversation_id}/transcript/{job_id}`

Poll the status of an async transcript export job.

When status is completed the response includes the download_url (and storage_path) written by the worker; when failed see error_message.

```php
$result = $sendseven->conversations()->getTranscriptExport(conversationId: 'conversation_id', jobId: 'job_id');
```

- Scopes: `conversations:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$conversationId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$jobId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `TranscriptExportJob`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Conversations/get_transcript_export_api_v1_conversations__conversation_id__transcript__job_id__get)

## setContactValue

Set Contact Field Value. `POST /contacts/{contact_id}/fields/{field_id}`

Set a custom field value for a contact.

The value is validated against the field's type and options (if applicable). For SELECT/MULTISELECT fields, values that don't match the defined options are rejected with 400 (matching is case-insensitive; the canonical option spelling is stored).

```php
$result = $sendseven->customFields()->setContactValue(contactId: 'contact_id', fieldId: 'field_id', value: '...');
```

- Scopes: `contacts:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |

| `$fieldId` | `string` | yes |  |

| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `Success`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Custom%20Fields/set_contact_field_value_api_v1_contacts__contact_id__fields__field_id__post)

## create

Create Custom Field. `POST /custom-fields`

Create a new custom field definition.

Custom fields extend the contact model with tenant-specific attributes. Once created, the field key and field_type cannot be changed.

```php
$result = $sendseven->customFields()->create(name: 'name', key: 'key', fieldType: 'field_type');
```

- Scopes: `settings:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |

| `$description` | `?string` | no | Help text describing the field |
| `$options` | `list<string>\|null` | no | Options for SELECT/MULTISELECT field types |
| `$required` | `?bool` | no | Whether this field is required |
| `$defaultValue` | `?string` | no | Default value for new contacts |
| `$agentVisible` | `?bool` | no | Whether agents can see this field |
| `$agentEditable` | `?bool` | no | Whether agents can edit this field |
| `$userEditable` | `?bool` | no | Whether contacts can edit this field (self-service) |
| `$displayOrder` | `?int` | no | Display order in UI (lower = first) |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `CustomFieldDefinition`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Custom%20Fields/create_custom_field_api_v1_custom_fields_post)

## delete

Delete Custom Field. `DELETE /custom-fields/{field_id}`

Delete (deactivate) a custom field definition.

The field is soft-deleted (marked inactive) to preserve existing data. Inactive fields are not shown in the UI and cannot be assigned new values.


- Scopes: `settings:admin`

# Custom Inboxes

`$sendseven->customInboxes()` — 7 endpoints.

| Method | HTTP | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`list()`](#list) | `GET /inboxes` | List Inboxes |
| [`createInbox()`](#createinbox) | `POST /inboxes` | Create Inbox |
| [`deleteInbox()`](#deleteinbox) | `DELETE /inboxes/{inbox_id}` | Delete Inbox |
| [`getInbox()`](#getinbox) | `GET /inboxes/{inbox_id}` | Get Inbox |
| [`updateInbox()`](#updateinbox) | `PATCH /inboxes/{inbox_id}` | Update Inbox |
| [`getInboxSenderOptions()`](#getinboxsenderoptions) | `GET /inboxes/{inbox_id}/sender-options` | Get Inbox Sender Options |
| [`setInboxUsers()`](#setinboxusers) | `PUT /inboxes/{inbox_id}/users` | Set Inbox Users |

## list

List Inboxes. `GET /inboxes`

List custom inboxes the caller can access.

Admins / owners see every inbox in the tenant. Other users see inboxes whose access_mode='all' plus any inbox where they're listed in the ACL.

```php
$result = $sendseven->customInboxes()->list();
```

- Scopes: `conversations:read`

Returns `InboxList`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Custom%20Inboxes/list_inboxes_api_v1_inboxes_get)

## createInbox

Create Inbox. `POST /inboxes`

Create a new inbox.

```php
$result = $sendseven->customInboxes()->createInbox(name: 'name');
```

- Scopes: `inboxes:create`, ` (+ plan feature `, `custom_inboxes`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$name` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$description` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$icon` | `?string` | no | Lucide icon name |
| `$color` | `?string` | no | #RRGGBB hex color |
| `$accessMode` | `AccessMode\|string\|null` | no | 'all' (any team member) or 'specific' (whitelisted users) |
| `$tagFilterMode` | `TagFilterMode\|string\|null` | no | How tag rules are combined: any (has at least one), all (has every), none (has none of them). Ignored when tag_ids is empty. |
| `$channelIds` | `list<string>\|null` | no | Non-email channel IDs that belong to this inbox. Email connections are listed separately under email_connections. |
| `$emailConnections` | `list<array<string, mixed>>\|null` | no | Email connections (EmailIntegration rows with can_receive_support=True) routed to this inbox, each with an optional alias-subset filter. |
| `$tagIds` | `list<string>\|null` | no | Tag IDs used by the tag rule (interpreted via tag_filter_mode) |
| `$fieldFilters` | `list<array<string, mixed>>\|null` | no | Custom-field rules (AND-combined) |
| `$allowedUserIds` | `list<string>\|null` | no | Whitelisted user IDs (only used when access_mode='specific') |
| `$isActive` | `?bool` | no |  |
| `$sortOrder` | `?int` | no |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `InboxOut`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Custom%20Inboxes/create_inbox_api_v1_inboxes_post)

## getInboxSenderOptions

List email senders the caller may use for composing a NEW email from inside this inbox.

- Scopes: `conversations:read`

# Double Opt-In

## getPendingConfirmations

Get Pending Confirmations. `GET /double-opt-in/pending`

Get list of pending email confirmations

Shows all contacts awaiting email confirmation for this tenant. Useful for admin dashboard to track conversion rates.

```php
$result = $sendseven->doubleOptIn()->getPendingConfirmations();
```

- Scopes: `email:read`

## resendConfirmationEmail

Resend Confirmation Email. `POST /double-opt-in/resend`

Resend confirmation email for pending subscription

If the original token has expired, a new token will be generated. If the original token is still valid, the same confirmation link will be resent.

```php
$sendseven->doubleOptIn()->resendConfirmationEmail(email: 'email');
```

- Scopes: `email:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

## sendConfirmationEmail

Send Confirmation Email. `POST /double-opt-in/send`

Send double opt-in confirmation email to contact

This endpoint: 1. Creates or finds contact by email 2. Creates pending subscription record 3. Generates secure confirmation token 4. Sends confirmation email with link

```php
$result = $sendseven->doubleOptIn()->sendConfirmationEmail(email: 'email');
```

- Scopes: `email:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$email` | `string` | yes | Email address to confirm |
| `$listId` | `?string` | no | Optional list ID to subscribe to |
| `$category` | `?string` | no | Subscription category (newsletter, promotions, updates) |
| `$ipAddress` | `?string` | no | IP address of requester for audit trail |
| `$userAgent` | `?string` | no | User agent for audit trail |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `DoubleOptInSend`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Double%20Opt-In/send_confirmation_email_api_v1_double_opt_in_send_post)

## create

Create Campaign. `POST /email-campaigns`

Create a new email campaign.

- Creates both base Campaign and EmailCampaign records - Validates provider/integration and content exist - Estimates recipient count - Optional send_rate_limit (emails per minute, 1-60000) and send_batch_size (recipients per batch, at least 1). Rejected values return HTTP 422 {code, message}: send_rate_limit_out_of_range, send_batch_size_invalid, send_pacing_unavailable.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailCampaigns()->create(name: 'name', subjectLine: 'subject_line');
```

- Scopes: `campaigns:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$name` | `string` | yes | Campaign name |
| `$subjectLine` | `string` | yes | Email subject |
| `$mailboxId` | `?string` | no | Email mailbox to send from. Auto-resolves from_email, from_name, and sending method. When provided, from_email/from_name/provider/integration fields become optional. |
| `$emailProviderConfigId` | `?string` | no | Email provider to use (SendGrid/Mailgun) |
| `$emailIntegrationId` | `?string` | no | SES email integration to use (Type 4) |
| `$emailTemplateId` | `?string` | no | Email template (LEGACY - for backward compatibility) |
| `$emailContentId` | `?string` | no | Email content (NEW - 3-tier system with layouts) |
| `$previewText` | `?string` | no | Email preview text |
| `$fromName` | `?string` | no | From name (optional when mailbox_id is set) |
| `$fromEmail` | `?string` | no | From email address (optional when mailbox_id is set) |
| `$replyToEmail` | `?string` | no | Reply-to email address |
| `$subscriptionCategories` | `list<string>\|null` | no | Target specific subscription categories (max 100) |
| `$listIds` | `list<string>\|null` | no | Target specific lists (max 100; must belong to this workspace) |
| `$personalizationEnabled` | `?bool` | no | Enable personalization |
| `$trackingEnabled` | `?bool` | no | Track email OPENS. Omit to inherit the tenant's track_opens_default (defaults True). |
| `$trackClicks` | `?bool` | no | Track link CLICKS. Omit to inherit the tenant's track_clicks_default (defaults True). |
| `$scheduledAt` | `DateTimeInterface\|string\|null` | no | Schedule for future send |
| `$status` | `?string` | no | Campaign status |
| `$sendRateLimit` | `?int` | no | Send speed in emails per minute (1-60000). Null = default speed. |
| `$sendBatchSize` | `?int` | no | Recipients per batch (1-1000000). The campaign pauses after each batch until the next batch is sent. Null = no batches. Out of range -> 422 send_batch_size_invalid. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

## getRecipientCount

Get Recipient Count. `POST /email-campaigns/recipient-count`

Audience preview and price for an UNSAVED campaign draft.

Counts come from the same recipient resolution the send uses (subscribed list members only, spam complaints / hard bounces / suppressed addresses excluded, duplicate addresses collapsed), so subscribed is the number of emails the campaign will actually send.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailCampaigns()->getRecipientCount();
```

- Scopes: `campaigns:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

| `$listIds` | `list<string>\|null` | no | Target specific lists (max 100) |
| `$subscriptionCategories` | `list<string>\|null` | no | Filter by subscription categories (max 100) |
| `$emailProviderConfigId` | `?string` | no | Email provider the draft will send with (enables the cost quote) |
| `$emailIntegrationId` | `?string` | no | SES email integration the draft will send with (enables the cost quote) |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `RecipientCount`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Campaigns/get_recipient_count_api_v1_email_campaigns_recipient_count_post)

## getUnsubscribeCounts

Get Email Campaign Unsubscribe Counts. `GET /email-campaigns/unsubscribe-counts`

Batch opt-out counts for the email campaigns INDEX page.

ONE grouped query over unsubscribe_tokens (used tokens) for the given email campaign ids (EmailCampaign.id, tenant-scoped). All email opt-outs are link/one-click, so per campaign exact == total and estimated is always 0. Campaigns with no opt-outs are OMITTED — treat a missing id as 0.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailCampaigns()->getUnsubscribeCounts(ids: 'ids');
```

- Scopes: `campaigns:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$ids` | `string` | yes | Comma-separated email campaign ids (max 200) |

Returns `CampaignUnsubscribeCounts`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Campaigns/get_email_campaign_unsubscribe_counts_api_v1_email_campaigns_unsubscribe_counts_get)

## delete

Delete Campaign. `DELETE /email-campaigns/{campaign_id}`

Delete email campaign.

- Sending, throttled (paused by the send limit) and completed campaigns cannot be deleted: 400 Cannot delete campaign that has been sent. Pause the campaign first, then delete it. - A paused, cancelled or failed campaign can be deleted; the emails it already sent stay on the invoice (they are kept for billing before the delete, in the month they were sent).

```php
$sendseven->emailCampaigns()->delete(campaignId: 'campaign_id');
```

- Scopes: `campaigns:delete`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$campaignId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `void`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Campaigns/delete_campaign_api_v1_email_campaigns__campaign_id__delete)

## update

Update Campaign. `PATCH /email-campaigns/{campaign_id}`

Update email campaign.

- Can only update campaigns in DRAFT or SCHEDULED status - Once sending/sent, campaigns are immutable -- except the send speed (send_rate_limit, emails per minute) and batch size (send_batch_size): a sending, paused or failed campaign may change ONLY these two (explicit null clears one). The next emails and the next batch use the new values. Switching them on while the campaign is sending moves the recipients not sent yet into batch 1 at the new speed. - Rejected values return HTTP 422 {code, message}: send_rate_limit_out_of_range, send_batch_size_invalid, send_pacing_unavailable, send_pacing_not_editable (any other status, e.g. completed or cancelled).

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailCampaigns()->update(campaignId: 'campaign_id');
```

- Scopes: `campaigns:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$campaignId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$name` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$subjectLine` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$previewText` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$fromName` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$fromEmail` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$replyToEmail` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$emailProviderConfigId` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$emailIntegrationId` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$emailTemplateId` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$emailContentId` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$subscriptionCategories` | `list<string>\|null` | no |  |

| `$personalizationEnabled` | `?bool` | no |  |
| `$trackingEnabled` | `?bool` | no | Track email OPENS |
| `$trackClicks` | `?bool` | no | Track link CLICKS |
| `$scheduledAt` | `DateTimeInterface\|string\|null` | no |  |
| `$sendRateLimit` | `?int` | no | Send speed in emails per minute (1-60000). Null clears it. |
| `$sendBatchSize` | `?int` | no | Recipients per batch (1-1000000). Null clears it (no further batches). Out of range -> 422 send_batch_size_invalid. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `EmailCampaign`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Campaigns/update_campaign_api_v1_email_campaigns__campaign_id__patch)

## listBatches

List Email Campaign Batches. `GET /email-campaigns/{campaign_id}/batches`

Per-batch delivery counts of an email campaign sent in batches

One item per batch with its recipient counts, oldest batch first. remaining is the number of recipients waiting for a later batch, current_batch_number the batch the campaign is on and send_batch_size the saved batch size. A campaign that is not sent in batches returns an empty list.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailCampaigns()->listBatches(campaignId: 'campaign_id');
```

## cancel

Cancel Campaign. `POST /email-campaigns/{campaign_id}/cancel`

Cancel scheduled, sending or paused campaign.

- Updates status to CANCELLED (also from paused, including a campaign waiting for its next batch) - Stops further Pub/Sub processing - Recipients still waiting for a later batch are not sent - Does NOT refund balance (already deducted)

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailCampaigns()->cancel(campaignId: 'campaign_id');
```

- Scopes: `campaigns:send`

## pause

Pause Email Campaign. `POST /email-campaigns/{campaign_id}/pause`

Pause a sending email campaign

Only a campaign in sending or throttled can be paused (anything else returns HTTP 400). Emails already handed to the email provider are not recalled; everyone else waits until POST /email-campaigns/{id}/resume.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailCampaigns()->pause(campaignId: 'campaign_id');
```

- Scopes: `campaigns:send`

## getRecipients

Get Campaign Recipients. `GET /email-campaigns/{campaign_id}/recipients`

List an email campaign's recipients with delivery status.

Groups: successful = sent/delivered/opened/clicked, failed = failed/bounced/complained, all = the union of both, held = recipients waiting for a later batch (campaigns sent in batches; status held, not part of all). Each item: {id, contact_id, name, identifier, status, error_reason, sent_at, delivered_at, failed_at} where identifier is the email address and error_reason is the bounce reason (bounces) or the send error.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailCampaigns()->getRecipients(campaignId: 'campaign_id');
```

- Scopes: `campaigns:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$campaignId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$status` | `?string` | no | Recipient group: failed \| successful \| held \| all |
| `$page` | `?int` | no | Page number (1-indexed) |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no | Items per page |
| `$search` | `?string` | no | Search email address or contact name |

Returns `Page<CampaignRecipientItem>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Campaigns/get_campaign_recipients_api_v1_email_campaigns__campaign_id__recipients_get)

## unsubscribeRecipient

Unsubscribe Email Campaign Recipient. `POST /email-campaigns/{campaign_id}/recipients/{recipient_id}/unsubscribe`

Opt an email recipient's contact out of this campaign's lists.

This is DISTINCT from DELETE /{campaign_id}/recipients/{recipient_id} ("Remove"), which only deletes the per-recipient row and does NOT change subscription state. This endpoint resolves the recipient's contact, computes the campaign's originating list(s) (campaign_lists on the base campaign ∩ the contact's currently-subscribed lists) and opts the contact out of all of them via the subscription chokepoint, writing the opt-out ledger with campaign attribution (method='manual'). {campaign_id} is the EmailCampaign.id (as elsewhere on this router).

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailCampaigns()->unsubscribeRecipient(campaignId: 'campaign_id', recipientId: 'recipient_id');
```

- Scopes: `campaigns:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$campaignId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$recipientId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `RecipientUnsubscribe`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Campaigns/unsubscribe_email_campaign_recipient_api_v1_email_campaigns__campaign_id__recipients__recipient_id__unsubscribe_post)

## resume

Resume Email Campaign. `POST /email-campaigns/{campaign_id}/resume`

Resume a paused email campaign

Only a paused campaign can be resumed (anything else returns HTTP 400). Sending continues with everyone who has not been sent yet. If a send speed or batch size was saved while the campaign was paused, it applies from now on. A campaign that finished a batch (throttle_reason = "batch_complete") sends its next batch, exactly like POST /email-campaigns/{id}/send-next-batch with an empty body. A campaign sent in batches that ended as completed or failed while recipients were still waiting is re-opened the same way. HTTP 422 send_pacing_unavailable while sending at a set speed or in batches is briefly unavailable.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailCampaigns()->resume(campaignId: 'campaign_id');
```

- Scopes: `campaigns:send`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$campaignId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `EmailCampaign`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Campaigns/resume_email_campaign_api_v1_email_campaigns__campaign_id__resume_post)

## schedule

Schedule Campaign. `POST /email-campaigns/{campaign_id}/schedule`

Schedule an email campaign for future sending.

Accepts a local datetime and IANA timezone string. The backend converts to UTC for storage. The original timezone is preserved for display purposes.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailCampaigns()->schedule(campaignId: 'campaign_id', scheduledAt: 'scheduled_at', timezone: 'timezone');
```

- Scopes: `campaigns:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$campaignId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$scheduledAt` | `DateTimeInterface\|string` | yes | Local datetime in the given timezone (naive or with offset) |
| `$timezone` | `string` | yes | IANA timezone (e.g. 'Europe/Berlin', 'America/New_York') |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `EmailCampaign`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Campaigns/schedule_campaign_api_v1_email_campaigns__campaign_id__schedule_post)

## send

Send Campaign. `POST /email-campaigns/{campaign_id}/send`

Send or schedule email campaign.

- If send_test=true, sends to test_emails only (TODO) - Otherwise, queues campaign to Pub/Sub for async sending - Updates campaign status to SENDING - Deducts balance upfront (prepaid model) - Send speed and batches: with a send_rate_limit and/or send_batch_size saved on the campaign, the emails go out at that speed and in batches of that size. After each batch the campaign pauses (status = "paused", throttle_reason = "batch_complete") until POST /email-campaigns/{id}/send-next-batch. A saved batch size that cannot be used returns HTTP 422 {code, message} before anything is sent (send_pacing_unavailable, send_batch_size_invalid). - HTTP 409 "This campaign is already being sent" when the campaign is already sending / throttled / paused, or a concurrent request (a second click, the scheduled send) started it first -- nothing is queued twice. HTTP 409 "This campaign was paused or cancelled while it was being prepared for sending. Refresh and try again." when that happened during the send.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailCampaigns()->send(campaignId: 'campaign_id');
```

- Scopes: `campaigns:send`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$campaignId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$sendTest` | `?bool` | no | Send test to specific addresses |
| `$testEmails` | `list<string>\|null` | no | Test email addresses |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `SendCampaign`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Campaigns/send_campaign_api_v1_email_campaigns__campaign_id__send_post)

## sendNextBatch

Send Next Email Batch. `POST /email-campaigns/{campaign_id}/send-next-batch`

Send the next batch of an email campaign sent in batches

Only for a campaign that finished a batch: status = "paused" with throttle_reason = "batch_complete", or one that ended as completed / failed while recipients were still waiting (it continues its unfinished batch first, if any). HTTP 422 send_pacing_unavailable while batch sending is briefly unavailable. Anything else returns HTTP 409 {"code": "campaign_not_awaiting_batch", "message": ...} (also when two requests race: only the first one sends a batch).

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailCampaigns()->sendNextBatch(campaignId: 'campaign_id');
```

- Scopes: `campaigns:send`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$campaignId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$body` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | The request body |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `EmailSendNextBatch`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Campaigns/send_next_email_batch_api_v1_email_campaigns__campaign_id__send_next_batch_post)

## getSendPlan

Get Email Campaign Send Plan. `GET /email-campaigns/{campaign_id}/send-plan`

Send plan of an email campaign: speed, batches and estimated duration

Read-only estimate for the campaign's audience at its saved send speed and batch size, or at the values given as query parameters (to preview a change before saving it). eta_seconds estimates the time to send everyone who is left (time paused between batches not included). pacing_available = false means send speed and batches are not available for this account yet.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailCampaigns()->getSendPlan(campaignId: 'campaign_id');
```

- Scopes: `campaigns:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$campaignId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$sendRateLimit` | `?int` | no | Preview this send speed (emails per minute, 1-60000) instead of the saved one |
| `$sendBatchSize` | `?int` | no | Preview this batch size (>= 1) instead of the saved one |

Returns `SendPlan`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Campaigns/get_email_campaign_send_plan_api_v1_email_campaigns__campaign_id__send_plan_get)

## getUnsubscribes

Get Campaign Unsubscribes. `GET /email-campaigns/{campaign_id}/unsubscribes`

List recipients who opted out via THIS email campaign's unsubscribe link.

Campaign-attributed opt-outs, sourced from unsubscribe_tokens (SHARD) stamped with the email_campaign_id at send time. Ordered by unsubscribed_at DESC, paginated (page/page_size, default 25).

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailCampaigns()->getUnsubscribes(campaignId: 'campaign_id');
```

- Scopes: `analytics:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$campaignId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$page` | `?int` | no |  |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no |  |

Returns `Page<AppSchemasEmailCampaignSchemaCampaignUnsubscribeItem>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Campaigns/get_campaign_unsubscribes_api_v1_email_campaigns__campaign_id__unsubscribes_get)

## import

Import Email Contacts. `POST /email-contacts/import`

Import contacts from CSV file

Imports contacts from a CSV file. At least one of email, phone, whatsapp_id, display_name, first_name, or last_name is required per row. Optionally creates email subscriptions for contacts that have an email address.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailContacts()->import(file: FilePart::fromPath('/path/to/file.pdf'));
```

- Scopes: `contacts:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$file` | `FilePart` | yes | CSV or XLSX file (.xlsx: first sheet, first row = headers). Anchor columns (at least one per row): contact_id, email, phone, whatsapp_id, display_name, first_name, last_name. Supports contact_id (UUID match target), first_name, last_name, display_name, email, phone, whatsapp_id, languages, birthday, tags, linkedin, instagram_handle, facebook, homepage, custom_fields. |
| `$columnMapping` | `?string` | no | JSON string mapping target fields to CSV column names, e.g. {"email": "E-Mail", "name": "Full Name", "phone": "Telefon"}. Per-EAV custom-field targets use the key "custom_field:<field_definition_id>". |
| `$duplicateMode` | `?string` | no | Override the tenant's duplicate_contact_mode for this import. Values: auto_merge, allow_duplicates, dont_allow_duplicates, update_existing. Omit to use the tenant default. |
| `$updateFieldMode` | `?string` | no | Only used with duplicate_mode=update_existing. 'overwrite' (default) replaces standard + EAV custom fields from the CSV (blank cells never wipe); 'fill_empty' only populates empty fields. Values: overwrite, fill_empty. |
| `$subscriptions` | `?string` | no | JSON array of structured channel->list subscription targets, e.g. [{"channel_type":"email","list_id":"..."},{"channel_type":"whatsapp","list_id":"..."}]. A contact is subscribed to a target only if it has the channel's required method (email→email, sms→phone, whatsapp→whatsapp_id/phone); others are silently skipped. Supported channels: email, sms, whatsapp. Takes precedence over create_subscription. Requires optin_confirmed=true. |
| `$delimiter` | `?string` | no | CSV delimiter override. One of: ',' ';' tab '\|'. Omit to auto-sniff. |
| `$quotechar` | `?string` | no | CSV quote character override (default '"'). Omit to auto-detect. |
| `$defaultPhoneRegion` | `?string` | no | ISO-3166 alpha-2 region (e.g. 'DE') used to auto-prefix phone numbers lacking a '+' to E.164 (national '0175…' → '+49175…'). Omit to keep the lenient digit-prepend behaviour. |
| `$applyTagIds` | `?string` | no | Post-import action: JSON array of tag IDs (e.g. ["id1","id2"]) applied to EVERY contact this import creates OR updates. Tag IDs must belong to the tenant (404 otherwise). |
| `$applyCustomField` | `?string` | no | Post-import action: JSON object {"field_id": "...", "value": ...} — the custom-field value is set (overwrite) on EVERY contact this import creates OR updates. The field must be an active custom field of the tenant; SELECT/MULTISELECT values are options-validated, DATE/DATETIME must be ISO. |
| `$createSubscription` | `?bool` | no | Create email subscriptions for imported contacts |
| `$optinConfirmed` | `?bool` | no | User confirms all contacts have valid opt-in consent |
| `$listId` | `?string` | no | Optional list ID to add imported contacts to |
| `$listIds` | `?string` | no | Comma-separated list IDs to subscribe contacts to |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `ImportJobStart`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Contacts/import_email_contacts_api_v1_email_contacts_import_post)

## downloadImportTemplate

Download Import Template. `GET /email-contacts/import/template`

Download a contact-import template (CSV or XLSX) with 1–2 example rows.

The headers are EXACTLY the contact-export format (auto-detected by the importer with no manual mapping): a leading contact_id column (empty in the template — fill it to update an existing contact, leave it empty to create), the standard contact fields, and one custom.<key> column per active custom-field definition of the tenant.

```php
$sendseven->emailContacts()->downloadImportTemplate();
```

- Scopes: `contacts:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$format` | `?string` | no | Template file format: csv \| xlsx |

Returns `void`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Contacts/download_import_template_api_v1_email_contacts_import_template_get)

## sniffCsv

Sniff Csv. `POST /email-contacts/sniff`

Sniff a CSV/XLSX file's dialect and headers.

Returns the detected delimiter, quote character, header column names, and a best-effort suggested phone region (from the tenant's company_country) so the frontend preview parser matches the backend importer exactly. Does NOT import anything. For .xlsx uploads the headers come from the first sheet's first row and delimiter/ quotechar are reported as "," / '"' (the dialect the backend's xlsx→csv conversion emits).

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailContacts()->sniffCsv(file: FilePart::fromPath('/path/to/file.pdf'));
```

- Scopes: `contacts:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$file` | `FilePart` | yes | CSV or XLSX file to inspect for delimiter/quotechar/headers |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `CsvSniff`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Contacts/sniff_csv_api_v1_email_contacts_sniff_post)

## list

List Email Contents. `GET /email-contents`

List email contents for the tenant with pagination.

- Can filter by layout template ID (optional reference) - By default excludes hidden contents (use include_hidden=true to include) - Returns list without full MJML source (for performance) - Includes basic layout template info

## create

Create Email Content. `POST /email-contents`

Create a new email content with variable system.

The variable system supports 4 types of variables: - Template variables: Custom content (e.g., {{hero_title}}, {{cta_url}}) - Contact variables: Auto-filled from contact data (e.g., {{contact.name}}) - Company variables: Auto-filled from company data (e.g., {{company.name}}) - System variables: Auto-filled by platform (e.g., {{system.year}})

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailContents()->create(name: 'name');
```

- Scopes: `email:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$name` | `string` | yes | Content name |
| `$description` | `?string` | no | Content description |
| `$contentType` | `EmailContentTypeEnum\|string\|null` | no | Content type: 'html' for MJML-based or 'plain_text' for text-only templates |
| `$templateId` | `?string` | no | ID of email template used as base (analytics only, HTML type only) |
| `$subjectLine` | `?string` | no | Subject line with {{variable}} support |
| `$previewText` | `?string` | no | Email preview text (appears in inbox) |
| `$fromName` | `?string` | no | Default sender name |
| `$fromEmail` | `?string` | no | Default sender email |
| `$editorType` | `?string` | no | Editor type: 'stripo' (default for new content) or 'mjml' (legacy GrapesJS) |
| `$mjmlSource` | `?string` | no | Full MJML content with {{variable}} placeholders (required for html type with mjml editor) |
| `$stripoDesignJson` | `?string` | no | Stripo editor design JSON for re-opening designs (stripo editor type only) |
| `$compiledHtml` | `?string` | no | Pre-compiled HTML from Stripo export (stripo editor type only) |
| `$textBody` | `?string` | no | Plain text template content with {{variable}} placeholders (required for plain_text type) |
| `$variableValues` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Template variable values (not contact/company/system) |
| `$footerMode` | `?string` | no | Compliance footer override for this email: inherit (default — use the account setting), both (unsubscribe + manage preferences), unsubscribe_only, or none (no visible footer, for transactional mail). RFC 8058 List-Unsubscribe headers are sent regardless. |
| `$aiGenerated` | `?bool` | no | Whether content was AI-generated |
| `$aiPrompt` | `?string` | no | AI prompt used for generation |
| `$aiModelUsed` | `?string` | no | AI model used |
| `$aiGenerationCostCents` | `?int` | no | AI generation cost in cents |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `EmailContent`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Contents/create_email_content_api_v1_email_contents_post)

## update

Update Email Content. `PATCH /email-contents/{content_id}`

Update email content with variable system.

Variable Replacement Examples: - Template: {{hero_title}} -> "Welcome to Our Amazing Platform" - Contact: {{contact.name}} -> Actual contact's name at send time - Company: {{company.name}} -> Actual company name at send time - System: {{system.year}} -> Current year (e.g., 2025)

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailContents()->update(contentId: 'content_id');
```

- Scopes: `email:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |

| `$previewText` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$fromName` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$fromEmail` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$editorType` | `?string` | no | Editor type: 'stripo' or 'mjml' |
| `$mjmlSource` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$stripoDesignJson` | `?string` | no | Stripo editor design JSON |
| `$compiledHtml` | `?string` | no | Pre-compiled HTML from Stripo export |
| `$textBody` | `?string` | no | Plain text template content with {{variable}} placeholders |
| `$variableValues` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no |  |
| `$footerMode` | `?string` | no | Compliance footer override for this email: inherit (default — use the account setting), both (unsubscribe + manage preferences), unsubscribe_only, or none (no visible footer, for transactional mail). RFC 8058 List-Unsubscribe headers are sent regardless. |

## duplicate

Duplicate Email Content. `POST /email-contents/{content_id}/duplicate`

Duplicate an email content.

Creates a copy of the content with a new name. All content fields are copied (MJML, HTML, variables, subject line, preview text, etc.). The duplicate is always a non-system, non-hidden content owned by the requesting tenant.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailContents()->duplicate(contentId: 'content_id', newName: 'new_name');
```

- Scopes: `email:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$contentId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$newName` | `string` | yes | Name for the duplicated content |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `EmailContent`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Contents/duplicate_email_content_api_v1_email_contents__content_id__duplicate_post)

## preview

Preview Email Content. `POST /email-contents/{content_id}/preview`

Preview email content with test variables.

Use Case: - Test how email will look with specific contact/company data - Preview personalization before launching campaigns - Debug variable replacement issues

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailContents()->preview(contentId: 'content_id');
```

- Scopes: `email:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$contentId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$variables` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Test variables to render (e.g., {'contact': {'name': 'John'}}) |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `EmailContentPreview`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Contents/preview_email_content_api_v1_email_contents__content_id__preview_post)

## list

List Email Integrations. `GET /email-integrations`

List all active (non-archived) email integrations for the tenant.

Note: Archived integrations are excluded. Use GET /archived to view archived integrations.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailIntegrations()->list();
```

- Scopes: `email_integrations:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$integrationType` | `EmailIntegrationType\|string\|null` | no |  |
| `$activeOnly` | `?bool` | no |  |

Returns `list<EmailIntegration>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Integrations/list_email_integrations_api_v1_email_integrations_get)

## create

Create Email Integration. `POST /email-integrations`

Create a new email integration.

Integration Types: - gmail - OAuth2 connection to Gmail - smtp_imap - Generic SMTP/IMAP server - sendgrid - Customer's own SendGrid account (deprecated for new integrations) - ses_managed - SendSeven managed SES (auto-setup: creates tenant, config set, starts domain verification) - proxy - Email forwarding via proxy address

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailIntegrations()->create(name: 'name', emailAddress: 'email_address', integrationType: 'integration_type');
```

- Scopes: `email_integrations:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$name` | `string` | yes | Integration name |
| `$emailAddress` | `string` | yes | Email address for this integration |
| `$integrationType` | `EmailIntegrationType\|string` | yes | Type of integration (gmail, smtp_imap, sendgrid, ses_managed, proxy). Mailgun is a BYOK email provider configured via the email-providers flow, not an integration type. |
| `$smtpConfig` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no |  |
| `$imapConfig` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no |  |
| `$sesDomain` | `?string` | no | Domain for SES verification |
| `$sesReputationPolicy` | `?string` | no | SES reputation policy |
| `$proxyForwardTo` | `?string` | no | Email to forward proxy emails to |
| `$outboundMailboxId` | `?string` | no | ID of the EmailMailbox used to send proxy replies (must belong to the tenant and have can_send_support=True). This is the user-facing outbound selector for proxies. |
| `$outboundProviderId` | `?string` | no | DEPRECATED: dormant/backward-compat only. Use outbound_mailbox_id for proxy outbound. No longer used to drive proxy sending. |
| `$recipientValidationMode` | `?string` | no | Recipient validation mode: 'any', 'strict', or 'whitelist' |
| `$acceptedAliases` | `list<string>\|null` | no | Additional email aliases that are accepted |
| `$defaultSignature` | `?string` | no | Default email signature |
| `$includeSignature` | `?bool` | no | Include signature in outgoing emails |
| `$initialSyncHours` | `?int` | no | How many hours back to pull emails on first connection. Options: 0 (from now only), 24 (1 day), 72 (3 days), 168 (1 week), 336 (2 weeks), 720 (1 month) |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `EmailIntegrationCreateResponse`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Integrations/create_email_integration_api_v1_email_integrations_post)

## composeNew

Compose and send new outbound email. `POST /email-integrations/conversations/{conversation_id}/compose-email`

Compose and send a new outbound email (not a reply).

Use this endpoint for initiating new email conversations where there's no existing message to reply to.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailIntegrations()->composeNew(conversationId: 'conversation_id', subject: 'subject');
```

- Scopes: `email_integrations:update`, `messages:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

| `$subject` | `string` | yes | Email subject |
| `$textBody` | `?string` | no | Plain text body |
| `$htmlBody` | `?string` | no | HTML body (for rich text) |
| `$toEmail` | `?string` | no | Explicit recipient address. Honored over the contact's primary email; falls back to the contact's primary email when omitted. |
| `$ccEmails` | `list<string>\|null` | no | CC recipients |
| `$bccEmails` | `list<string>\|null` | no | BCC recipients |
| `$attachmentIds` | `list<string>\|null` | no | IDs of attachments to include |
| `$senderId` | `?string` | no | Override the connection used to send this email. Must be one of the ids returned by GET /api/v1/inboxes/{id}/sender-options (or, when composing inside an existing conversation, /api/v1/conversations/{id}/sender-options). |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `EmailReply`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Integrations/compose_new_email_api_v1_email_integrations_conversations__conversation_id__compose_email_post)

## composeFromTemplate

Compose and send email from an EmailContent template. `POST /email-integrations/conversations/{conversation_id}/compose-from-template`

Compose and send an outbound email using a pre-designed EmailContent template.

The template is compiled with the conversation contact's data (name, email, phone) substituted into template variables. Optional variable_overrides allow the caller to override or supplement template variable values before compilation.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailIntegrations()->composeFromTemplate(conversationId: 'conversation_id', emailContentId: 'email_content_id');
```

| `$conversationId` | `string` | yes |  |

| `$variableOverrides` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Override template variable values before compilation |
| `$ccEmails` | `list<string>\|null` | no | CC recipients |
| `$bccEmails` | `list<string>\|null` | no | BCC recipients |
| `$includeSignature` | `?bool` | no | Whether to include email signature |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `EmailReply`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Integrations/compose_from_template_api_v1_email_integrations_conversations__conversation_id__compose_from_template_post)

## getConversationThread

Get email thread for conversation. `GET /email-integrations/conversations/{conversation_id}/email-thread`

Returns all email messages associated with this conversation, including: - RFC 5322 headers (Message-ID, In-Reply-To, References) - From, To, CC, BCC addresses - Subject and body (text + signed URL for HTML) - Attachments with download URLs - Thread relationships for proper email client display

## blockSenderFromMessage

Block Sender From Message. `POST /email-integrations/email-messages/{email_message_id}/block-sender`

Adds the sender's email address to the blacklist. Future emails from this sender will be skipped during polling.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailIntegrations()->blockSenderFromMessage(emailMessageId: 'email_message_id');
```

- Scopes: `email_integrations:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$emailMessageId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$reason` | `?string` | no | Reason for blocking |
| `$hideExistingMessages` | `?bool` | no | Also hide all existing messages from this sender |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `BlockedSender`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Integrations/block_sender_from_message_api_v1_email_integrations_email_messages__email_message_id__block_sender_post)

## hideMessage

Hide Email Message. `POST /email-integrations/email-messages/{email_message_id}/hide`

Hide (soft-delete/archive) an email message.

The message will be hidden from the conversation view but kept in the database. Use unhide to restore it.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailIntegrations()->hideMessage(emailMessageId: 'email_message_id');
```

- Scopes: `email_integrations:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$emailMessageId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `EmailMessage`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Integrations/hide_email_message_api_v1_email_integrations_email_messages__email_message_id__hide_post)

## sendReply

Send email reply. `POST /email-integrations/email-messages/{email_message_id}/reply`

Send a reply to an email message.

Features: - Plain text and/or HTML body support (rich text) - CC/BCC handling with option to preserve original CCs - Reply-all option - Attachment support via attachment IDs - Automatic subject line (Re: original) with override option

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailIntegrations()->sendReply(emailMessageId: 'email_message_id');
```

- Scopes: `email_integrations:update`, `messages:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$emailMessageId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$textBody` | `?string` | no | Plain text body of reply |
| `$htmlBody` | `?string` | no | HTML body of reply (for rich text) |
| `$ccEmails` | `list<string>\|null` | no | CC recipients |
| `$bccEmails` | `list<string>\|null` | no | BCC recipients |
| `$preserveCc` | `?bool` | no | Auto-include original CC recipients |
| `$attachmentIds` | `list<string>\|null` | no | IDs of attachments to include |
| `$toEmails` | `list<string>\|null` | no | Explicit recipient override; when omitted, defaults to the original message's Reply-To or From address. When provided and non-empty, these addresses are used exactly (reply-all expansion is not applied on top). |
| `$replyAll` | `?bool` | no | Reply to all original recipients |
| `$subjectOverride` | `?string` | no | Override reply subject (default: Re: original) |
| `$includeThreadHistory` | `?bool` | no | Override whether to append the quoted prior-thread history block beneath this reply. When omitted/null, the owning mailbox's include_thread_history default (TRUE) is used. |
| `$senderId` | `?string` | no | Override the connection used to send this reply. Must be one of the ids returned by GET /api/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}/sender-options. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `EmailReply`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Integrations/send_email_reply_api_v1_email_integrations_email_messages__email_message_id__reply_post)

## delete

Delete Email Integration. `DELETE /email-integrations/{integration_id}`

Archive (soft-delete) an email integration with full resource cleanup.

This archives the integration and cleans up all associated resources: - For SES managed integrations: removes domain identity from AWS SES (only if no other active integration uses the same domain), deletes the SES configuration set, and removes the SES tenant - Deletes DNS verification records from the database - Deactivates proxy mappings for proxy integrations - Clears sensitive credentials (OAuth tokens, passwords, API keys) - Marks the integration as archived with timestamp - Preserves the integration record for billing history and audit purposes

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailIntegrations()->delete(integrationId: 'integration_id');
```

- Scopes: `email_integrations:delete`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$integrationId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `ArchiveIntegration`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Integrations/delete_email_integration_api_v1_email_integrations__integration_id__delete)

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailIntegrations()->update(integrationId: 'integration_id');
```

- Scopes: `email_integrations:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |

| `$imapConfig` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no |  |
| `$defaultSignature` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$includeSignature` | `?bool` | no |  |
| `$syncEnabled` | `?bool` | no |  |
| `$proxyForwardTo` | `?string` | no | Your email address where proxy emails are forwarded to (e.g., support@yourcompany.com) |
| `$outboundMailboxId` | `?string` | no | ID of the EmailMailbox used to send proxy replies (must belong to the tenant and have can_send_support=True). This is the user-facing outbound selector for proxies. |
| `$outboundProviderId` | `?string` | no | DEPRECATED: dormant/backward-compat only. Use outbound_mailbox_id for proxy outbound. No longer used to drive proxy sending. |
| `$acceptedAliases` | `list<string>\|null` | no | Additional email aliases that are accepted (e.g., dev@yourcompany.com, info@yourcompany.com) |
| `$recipientValidationMode` | `?string` | no | Recipient validation mode: 'any' (accept all), 'strict' (only proxy_forward_to), 'whitelist' (proxy_forward_to + accepted_aliases) |
| `$initialSyncHours` | `?int` | no | How many hours back to pull emails on first connection. Options: 0 (from now only), 24 (1 day), 72 (3 days), 168 (1 week), 336 (2 weeks), 720 (1 month) |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `EmailIntegration`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Integrations/update_email_integration_api_v1_email_integrations__integration_id__patch)

## addDomain

Add Domain. `POST /email-integrations/{integration_id}/add-domain`

Start domain verification for an SES managed integration.

This: 1. Creates an email identity for the domain in SES 2. Returns DNS records (DKIM, SPF, DMARC) that need to be added 3. Associates the domain with the SES tenant once verified

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailIntegrations()->addDomain(integrationId: 'integration_id', domain: 'domain');
```

- Scopes: `email_integrations:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$integrationId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$domain` | `string` | yes | Domain to verify (e.g., 'acme.com') |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `DomainVerification`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Integrations/add_domain_api_v1_email_integrations__integration_id__add_domain_post)

# Email Mailboxes

`$sendseven->emailMailboxes()` — 5 endpoints.

| Method | HTTP | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`list()`](#list) | `GET /email-mailboxes` | List Email Mailboxes |
| [`createMailbox()`](#createmailbox) | `POST /email-mailboxes` | Create Email Mailbox |
| [`deleteMailbox()`](#deletemailbox) | `DELETE /email-mailboxes/{mailbox_id}` | Delete Email Mailbox |
| [`getMailbox()`](#getmailbox) | `GET /email-mailboxes/{mailbox_id}` | Get Email Mailbox |
| [`updateMailbox()`](#updatemailbox) | `PUT /email-mailboxes/{mailbox_id}` | Update Email Mailbox |

## list

List Email Mailboxes. `GET /email-mailboxes`

List email mailboxes for the tenant.

Returns active mailboxes by default. Set active_only=false to include deactivated mailboxes.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailMailboxes()->list();
```

- Scopes: `channels:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$page` | `?int` | no | Page number (1-indexed) |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no | Items per page |
| `$activeOnly` | `?bool` | no | Only return active mailboxes |
| `$purpose` | `?string` | no | Filter by capability: 'campaign' (can_send_campaigns=True) or 'support' (can_send_support=True) |
| `$forUserId` | `?string` | no | Filter to mailboxes accessible by this user (respects access_mode) |

Returns `Page<EmailMailbox>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Mailboxes/list_email_mailboxes_api_v1_email_mailboxes_get)

## createMailbox

Create Email Mailbox. `POST /email-mailboxes`

Create a new email mailbox.

Either email_integration_id or email_provider_config_id must be set (but not both). If is_default is True the previous default mailbox for the tenant is unset.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailMailboxes()->createMailbox(name: 'name', emailAddress: 'email_address');
```

- Scopes: `channels:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$name` | `string` | yes | Display name for the mailbox (e.g. 'Support', 'Sales') |
| `$emailAddress` | `string` | yes | Email address for this mailbox |
| `$displayName` | `?string` | no | From name shown to email recipients. When set, overrides 'name' for sending. When null, 'name' is used. |
| `$emailIntegrationId` | `?string` | no | Link to an email integration (Gmail, SMTP, SES, Proxy) |
| `$emailProviderConfigId` | `?string` | no | Link to an email provider config (SendGrid, Mailgun) |
| `$isDefault` | `?bool` | no | Whether this is the default mailbox for the tenant |
| `$canSendCampaigns` | `?bool` | no | Whether this mailbox can be used for email campaigns |
| `$canSendSupport` | `?bool` | no | Whether this mailbox can be used for support replies |
| `$includeThreadHistory` | `?bool` | no | Default for outbound replies from this mailbox: when True, the quoted prior-thread history block is appended beneath the reply. Can be overridden per-send. |
| `$accessMode` | `?string` | no | Who can use this mailbox: 'all' (any team member) or 'specific' (only designated users) |
| `$allowedUserIds` | `list<string>\|null` | no | User IDs allowed to use this mailbox (only when access_mode='specific') |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `EmailMailbox`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Mailboxes/create_email_mailbox_api_v1_email_mailboxes_post)

| [`setDefault()`](#setdefault) | `PATCH /email-providers/{provider_id}/set-default` | Set Default Provider |
| [`test()`](#test) | `POST /email-providers/{provider_id}/test` | Test Provider |
| [`getWebhookSettings()`](#getwebhooksettings) | `GET /email-providers/{provider_id}/webhook-settings` | Get Webhook Settings |

## list

List Providers. `GET /email-providers`

List all active (non-archived) email provider configurations for the tenant

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailProviders()->list();
```

Returns `list<EmailProviderConfig>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Providers/list_providers_api_v1_email_providers_get)

## create

Create Provider. `POST /email-providers`

Create a new email provider configuration

- Encrypts API key before storage - If set as default, removes default flag from other providers - Validates provider configuration

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailProviders()->create(providerType: 'provider_type', name: 'name', apiKey: 'api_key');
```

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$providerType` | `ProviderType\|string` | yes | Provider type (sendgrid, mailgun) |
| `$name` | `string` | yes | User-friendly name |
| `$apiKey` | `string` | yes | API key for provider |
| `$config` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Provider-specific settings |
| `$isActive` | `?bool` | no | Whether provider is active |
| `$isDefault` | `?bool` | no | Set as default provider for tenant |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `EmailProviderConfig`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Providers/create_provider_api_v1_email_providers_post)

## configureWebhooks

## refreshVerifiedDomains

Refresh Verified Domains. `POST /email-providers/{provider_id}/refresh-domains`

Refresh the list of verified domains from the provider API.

Fetches current verified domains and updates provider config. Supports SendGrid and Mailgun. For Mailgun a domain-scoped SENDING key 401s on /v3/domains and the live list cannot be read — in that case the stored verified_domains degrades to the manually-configured domain.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailProviders()->refreshVerifiedDomains(providerId: 'provider_id');
```

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$providerId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `RefreshDomains`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Providers/refresh_verified_domains_api_v1_email_providers__provider_id__refresh_domains_post)

## reset

Reset Email Settings. `DELETE /email-settings`


- Scopes: `settings:admin`


## update

Update Email Settings. `PATCH /email-settings`

Update tenant email settings (partial update).

Only updates provided fields. Unspecified fields remain unchanged.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailSettings()->update();
```

- Scopes: `settings:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$defaultFromName` | `?string` | no | Default sender name for emails |
| `$defaultFromEmail` | `?string` | no | Default sender email address |
| `$defaultReplyTo` | `?string` | no | Default reply-to email address |
| `$doubleOptInEnabled` | `?bool` | no | Require double opt-in for new subscriptions |
| `$defaultDoubleOptInTemplateId` | `?string` | no | UUID of default confirmation email template |
| `$complianceFooterHtml` | `?string` | no | HTML footer for compliance (GDPR/CAN-SPAM) |
| `$footerMode` | `?string` | no | Which compliance links emails carry by default: both (unsubscribe + manage preferences), unsubscribe_only, or none (no visible footer — transactional senders only; RFC 8058 List-Unsubscribe headers are still sent). Individual emails can override this via the email content's footer_mode. unsubscribe_only and none also disable the hosted preference center for this account. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `EmailSettingsResponse`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Settings/update_email_settings_api_v1_email_settings_patch)

## getMy

Get My Signature. `GET /email-signatures/me`

Get the current user's email signature.

Returns 404 if the user hasn't created a signature yet. Use POST /email-signatures/me/copy-from-template to initialize from the tenant template.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailSignatures()->getMy();
```

- Scopes: `email_signatures:read`

Returns `UserSignature`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Signatures/get_my_signature_api_v1_email_signatures_me_get)

## updateMy

Update My Signature. `PUT /email-signatures/me`

Create or update the current user's email signature.

The signature HTML can include placeholders which will be resolved when emails are sent. However, users typically personalize the signature with their actual values.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailSignatures()->updateMy(contentHtml: 'content_html');
```

- Scopes: `email_signatures:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$contentHtml` | `string` | yes | HTML content of the personalized signature |
| `$contentText` | `?string` | no | Plain text version for non-HTML emails |
| `$isActive` | `?bool` | no | Whether the signature is active. When False, effective-signature resolution will skip this user signature (and the auto-insert effect in the composer will not pre-fill it). Optional on PUT — omitting it leaves the existing flag unchanged. |

Returns `UserSignature`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Signatures/update_my_signature_api_v1_email_signatures_me_put)

## copyTemplateToMy

Copy Template To My Signature. `POST /email-signatures/me/copy-from-template`

Copy the tenant's signature template to the current user's signature.

This creates a personalized copy of the tenant template that the user can then customize. The template's placeholders are copied as-is and will be resolved when emails are sent.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailSignatures()->copyTemplateToMy();
```

- Scopes: `email_signatures:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `UserSignature`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Signatures/copy_template_to_my_signature_api_v1_email_signatures_me_copy_from_template_post)

## getEffective

Get Effective Signature. `GET /email-signatures/me/effective`

Get the fully resolved signature for the current user.

Returns the user's signature (if exists) or falls back to tenant template, with all placeholders resolved to actual values.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailSignatures()->getEffective();
```

- Scopes: `email_signatures:read`

Returns `EffectiveSignature`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Signatures/get_effective_signature_api_v1_email_signatures_me_effective_get)

## previewMy

Preview My Signature. `GET /email-signatures/me/preview`

Preview the current user's signature with placeholders resolved.

Returns the user's signature (if exists) or falls back to tenant template, with all placeholders resolved to the user's actual values.


- Scopes: `email_signatures:read`

# Email Templates

`$sendseven->emailTemplates()` — 7 endpoints.

| Method | HTTP | Summary |
|---|---|---|

## listLayout

List Layout Templates. `GET /email-templates`

List email templates for the tenant

- Can filter by category (business, creative, minimal) - Can filter by system template flag - Can filter by active status - By default excludes hidden templates (use include_hidden=true to include) - Returns list without full MJML source (for performance) - Supports pagination with limit and offset

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailTemplates()->listLayout();
```

- Scopes: `email:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$category` | `?string` | no | Filter by category |
| `$isSystemTemplate` | `?bool` | no | Filter by system template flag |
| `$isActive` | `?bool` | no | Filter by active status |
| `$includeHidden` | `?bool` | no | Include hidden/archived templates |
| `$limit` | `?int` | no | Max results |
| `$offset` | `?int` | no | Results offset |

Returns `list<EmailLayoutTemplateList>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Templates/list_layout_templates_api_v1_email_templates_get)

## createLayout

Create Layout Template. `POST /email-templates`

Create a new email template with variable system

- Define structural framework with MJML - Use {{variable_name}} placeholders for customization - Set color palette and fonts for brand consistency - MJML is validated and compiled to HTML on creation - Variables use lowercase_with_underscores naming convention

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailTemplates()->createLayout(name: 'name', mjmlSource: 'mjml_source');
```

- Scopes: `email:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$name` | `string` | yes | Email template name |
| `$mjmlSource` | `string` | yes | MJML source with {{variable_name}} placeholders |
| `$description` | `?string` | no | Template description |
| `$category` | `?string` | no | Category (transactional, promotional, custom) |
| `$colorPalette` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Color palette (e.g., {'primary': '#0066CC'}) |
| `$fontFamily` | `?string` | no | Font family (e.g., 'Arial, sans-serif') |
| `$thumbnailUrl` | `?string` | no | Template preview thumbnail URL |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `EmailLayoutTemplate`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Templates/create_layout_template_api_v1_email_templates_post)

## previewLayout

Preview MJML template without saving (with variable replacement)

- Accepts MJML source with {{variable}} placeholders - Replaces variables with example values - Brand variables are auto-filled from tenant settings - Compiles MJML to HTML - Returns HTML for preview - Does not save to database

## duplicateLayout

Duplicate Layout Template. `POST /email-templates/{template_id}/duplicate`

Duplicate an email template

Creates a copy of the template with a new name. All content fields are copied (MJML, HTML, category, colors, thumbnail, description). The duplicate is always a non-system, non-hidden template owned by the requesting tenant.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailTemplates()->duplicateLayout(templateId: 'template_id', newName: 'new_name');
```

- Scopes: `email:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$templateId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$newName` | `string` | yes | Name for the duplicated template |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `EmailLayoutTemplate`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Templates/duplicate_layout_template_api_v1_email_templates__template_id__duplicate_post)
