## listEntries

List Faq Entries. `GET /knowledge-base/faq-entries`

List FAQ entries across folders, with filtering and sorting.

Unlike /faq-items, this reaches standalone Managed FAQ entries — the ones with no compiled parent document, which the document-scoped listing cannot see at all.

```php
$result = $sendseven->faqManagement()->listEntries();
```

- Scopes: `knowledge_base:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$folderId` | `?string` | no | Restrict to one KB folder |
| `$documentId` | `?string` | no | Restrict to one compiled parent document |
| `$status` | `?string` | no | draft \| published \| needs_review \| archived. Accepts a comma-separated list (e.g. 'draft,needs_review') for a UNION. |
| `$origin` | `?string` | no | manual \| auto_conversation \| migrated \| correction |
| `$language` | `?string` | no | Filter by language tag |
| `$search` | `?string` | no | Substring match on question/answer |
| `$flaggedOnly` | `?bool` | no | Only entries with flagged_count > 0 |
| `$reviewOnly` | `?bool` | no | The review queue: entries needing attention — status in (draft, needs_review) OR flagged_count > 0. Takes precedence over status/flagged_only. |
| `$includeLedger` | `?bool` | no | Include bulk-migration ledger rows (archived bookkeeping entries whose question is raw cluster text). Excluded by default. |
| `$sortBy` | `?string` | no | uses \| quality \| flags \| retrieved \| created_at \| updated_at \| sort_order |
| `$sortDir` | `?string` | no | asc \| desc |
| `$page` | `?int` | no |  |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no |  |

Returns `Page<FaqItem>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/FAQ%20Management/list_faq_entries_api_v1_knowledge_base_faq_entries_get)

## getDuplicateClusters

Get Duplicate Clusters. `GET /knowledge-base/faq-entries/duplicate-clusters`

Clusters of live entries that look like duplicates of each other.

Same heuristic as the KB-health dashboard (exact match on the alphanumeric-normalised question) so the two surfaces agree on what a duplicate is. Each cluster is a candidate for POST /faq-entries/merge. Ledger rows and archived entries are excluded.

```php
$sendseven->faqManagement()->getDuplicateClusters();
```

- Scopes: `knowledge_base:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$folderId` | `?string` | no | Restrict to one KB folder |

Returns `void`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/FAQ%20Management/get_duplicate_clusters_api_v1_knowledge_base_faq_entries_duplicate_clusters_get)

## mergeEntries

Merge Faq Entries. `POST /knowledge-base/faq-entries/merge`

Consolidate duplicate FAQ entries into one.

Approval-gated and NEVER automatic — nothing in generation/migration/ correction calls this. dry_run defaults to TRUE and only PREVIEWS (merged_stats, files that would be deleted, question variants). An execute (dry_run=false) is additionally gated by the server-side FAQ_MERGE_EXECUTION_ENABLED flag; while that flag is off the execute path returns 403 so the destructive RAG/GCS delete cannot run by accident against the shared production database. See faq_merge_service for the full safety model (three independent guards + the orphan basename guardrail).

```php
$sendseven->faqManagement()->mergeEntries(winnerId: 'winner_id', loserIds: []);
```

- Scopes: `knowledge_base:delete`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$winnerId` | `string` | yes | Entry that survives the merge |
| `$loserIds` | `list<string>` | yes | Entries folded into the winner then archived |
| `$dryRun` | `?bool` | no | Preview only (default). Set false to EXECUTE the destructive merge (deletes loser RAG files + GCS blobs, archives losers). |
| `$keepLoserQuestionsAsVariants` | `?bool` | no | Keep loser phrasings as retrievable alt-questions on the winner |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `void`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/FAQ%20Management/merge_faq_entries_api_v1_knowledge_base_faq_entries_merge_post)

## resolveEntryFlags

Resolve Faq Entry Flags. `POST /knowledge-base/faq-entries/{entry_id}/resolve-flags`

Clear an entry's flags after a reviewer has looked at it.

Sets flagged_count to 0 and writes an audit revision. Does NOT touch content, status or the corpus — resolving flags is review bookkeeping, not an edit, so retrieval is unaffected and no re-sync happens.

```php
$sendseven->faqManagement()->resolveEntryFlags(entryId: 'entry_id');
```

- Scopes: `knowledge_base:update`

<!-- docs/reference/faq-migration.md -->

# FAQ Migration

`$sendseven->faqMigration()` — 3 endpoints.

| Method | HTTP | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`estimate()`](#estimate) | `GET /knowledge-base/faq-migration/estimate` | Estimate Faq Migration |
| [`start()`](#start) | `POST /knowledge-base/faq-migration/start` | Start Faq Migration |
| [`getStatus()`](#getstatus) | `GET /knowledge-base/faq-migration/status` | Get Faq Migration Status |

## estimate

Estimate Faq Migration. `GET /knowledge-base/faq-migration/estimate`

Preview a bulk migration: how many summaries, how many clusters, what it costs.

Read-only and side-effect free — it loads the tenant's ticket summaries and runs the same clustering the migration would, but makes no LLM call and writes nothing. This is what the "migrate history" button shows before the user commits.

```php
$result = $sendseven->faqMigration()->estimate();
```

- Scopes: `knowledge_base:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$limit` | `?int` | no | Only consider this many summaries (default: all, max 20000) |

Returns `FaqMigrationEstimate`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/FAQ%20Migration/estimate_faq_migration_api_v1_knowledge_base_faq_migration_estimate_get)

## start

Start Faq Migration. `POST /knowledge-base/faq-migration/start`

Start (or preview) the bulk migration of ticket summaries into FAQ drafts.

dry_run=true is handled inline and never enqueues anything: it loads and clusters the summaries and returns what it would have processed. No Gemini call, no row written, no folder touched — so it cannot possibly change the tenant's knowledge base. Everything else publishes one migrate_ticket_summaries job; the worker processes a bounded number of clusters and re-enqueues itself until nothing is left, so this returns immediately and the UI polls /faq-migration/status.

```php
$result = $sendseven->faqMigration()->start();
```

- Scopes: `knowledge_base:manage`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$dryRun` | `?bool` | no | Preview only. Runs INLINE (no job is enqueued, no LLM call, no row written) and returns the clustering it would have processed |
| `$limit` | `?int` | no | Cap on summaries read in one pass (default: all, max 20000) |
| `$maxClusters` | `?int` | no | Clusters processed per worker message (default 40). Higher values risk the 600s worker message timeout; the job re-enqueues itself either way, so raising this buys nothing but risk |
| `$minClusterSize` | `?int` | no | Override the tenant's faq_min_cluster_size for this run — the floor at which a cluster counts as recurring rather than one-off |
| `$includeSingletons` | `?bool` | no | Process one-off cases too. Set false for the cheap high-value pass: singletons dominate the cluster count and the cost, and are refused almost every time |
| `$retireFolderWhenDone` | `?bool` | no | Hide the legacy 'Ticket Summaries' KB folder once nothing is left to migrate. A visible change to the tenant's KB tree, so opt-in. Ignored for dry_run |
| `$force` | `?bool` | no | Start even though a migration appears to be in flight, overriding the 409. Only for a run known to be dead — two live chains double-bill the tenant and race on the same summaries |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `FaqMigrationStart`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/FAQ%20Migration/start_faq_migration_api_v1_knowledge_base_faq_migration_start_post)

## getStatus

Get Faq Migration Status. `GET /knowledge-base/faq-migration/status`

Progress of the bulk migration, from what it has actually persisted.

Poll-safe: counts are read back from the rows the migration wrote, with no clustering and no LLM call.

```php
$result = $sendseven->faqMigration()->getStatus();
```

- Scopes: `knowledge_base:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$includeEstimate` | `?bool` | no | Also run a fresh clustering pass (same work as /faq-migration/estimate). Expensive — never poll with this on |

Returns `FaqMigrationStatus`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/FAQ%20Migration/get_faq_migration_status_api_v1_knowledge_base_faq_migration_status_get)

## listRunsForContact

List Flow Runs For Contact. `GET /contacts/{contact_id}/flow-runs`

List flow runs for a specific contact.

Used by the contact-detail "Flows" tab. When status is omitted the response defaults to active runs (running + waiting) — the rows a user expects to see. Pass an explicit status to inspect history.

```php
$result = $sendseven->flows()->listRunsForContact(contactId: 'contact_id');
```

- Scopes: `flows:read`, `contacts:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$contactId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$status` | `FlowRunStatus\|string\|null` | no | Filter by run status. Defaults to active runs (running + waiting) when omitted. |
| `$flowId` | `?string` | no | Filter to a specific flow |
| `$page` | `?int` | no |  |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no |  |

Returns `Page<FlowRun>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Flows/list_flow_runs_for_contact_api_v1_contacts__contact_id__flow_runs_get)

## list

List Flows. `GET /flows`

List flows for the current tenant.

```php
$result = $sendseven->flows()->list();
```

- Scopes: `flows:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$status` | `FlowStatus\|string\|null` | no | Filter by status (draft, published, paused, archived). |
| `$name` | `?string` | no | Case-insensitive substring filter on flow name. |

| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no |  |

## create

Create Flow. `POST /flows`

Create a new flow in draft status.

The definition JSON is validated structurally — see :class:FlowDefinitionValidator. Validation failures return 400 FLOW_DEFINITION_INVALID with the full error list.

```php
$result = $sendseven->flows()->create(name: 'name', definition: []);
```

- Scopes: `flows:write`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$name` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$definition` | `array<string, mixed>` | yes | The full flow graph: trigger + nodes[] + edges[] + entry_node_id. See fl01_create_flows.py migration docstring for the locked JSON shape. Hard-capped at 256 KB JSON-encoded; validated against the structural rules in FlowDefinitionValidator. |
| `$description` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$reEntryPolicy` | `?string` | no | How to behave when the same contact is triggered again while a run is already in flight. MVP only enforces block (ignore the new trigger). restart and parallel are scaffolded for Phase 3 UX. |
| `$defaultLanguage` | `?string` | no | Per-flow fallback language used by the runtime when a contact has no resolvable locale. Typically set by the frontend to the operator's current UI language at create time. Backend defaults to 'en' (DB server_default) if omitted. Must be one of the curated ~40 SUPPORTED_TRANSLATION_LOCALES. |
| `$manuallyTriggerable` | `?bool` | no | When True, the flow appears in the operator's manual-start picker and accepts POST /flows/{id}/runs requests. Automatically forced True when the trigger kind is manual. |
| `$autoTranslateMessages` | `?bool` | no | Per-flow opt-in for runtime LLM translation of outbound Send-node messages into the contact's preferred language. |
| `$languageDetectionStrategy` | `?string` | no | How this flow's runs resolve the language they speak to a contact. cascade (the default) resolves per run via the fallback chain (contact locale → inferred channel locale → default_language). fixed always speaks default_language, skipping the cascade. OMIT / null to keep the default — NULL is stored and treated as cascade by the runtime, so existing flows are unaffected. Any value other than cascade / fixed is rejected with 422. |
| `$defaultChannelChain` | `list<array<string, mixed>>\|null` | no | Flow-level channel fallback chain — May 2026 this is the SINGLE source of truth for channel order (per-node channel_chain has been removed; node configs only carry content). Bare channel-type strings (["whatsapp", "live_chat"]) OR {channel_type, channel_id?} objects pinning a specific Channel row. When omitted / NULL on create, the server seeds from the tenant's active channels in a sensible order. A flow with any send/choice/collect_input node MUST have a non-empty chain to validate. |
| `$stopOnAgentReply` | `?bool` | no | When True (the default), the flow engine terminates any active run for the contact + conversation the moment a human agent sends an outbound message. Bot replies and flow-Send messages do NOT trip the hook — only operator-authored outbound messages do. Set to False for long-running drips whose cadence should be independent of agent activity. |
| `$stopOnConversationClosed` | `?bool` | no | When True (the default), the flow engine terminates any active run scoped to the conversation the moment that conversation is closed. Only runs whose recorded context.conversation_id matches the closed conversation are canceled — flows without a recorded conversation are left untouched. Set to False for long-running re-engagement drips that intentionally outlive the original conversation. |
| `$priority` | `?int` | no | Trigger-arbitration priority among INBOUND-EVENT-triggered (entry) flows. LOWER = higher priority (evaluated FIRST). When multiple entry flows match the same inbound event they start in ascending-priority order. Default 0. Background flows (manual/api_event/schedule) ignore this field. |
| `$exclusive` | `?bool` | no | When True, while a run of this entry-triggered flow is actively running on a conversation, NO other entry-triggered flow may start on that conversation (background manual/api/schedule flows are exempt). Default False preserves today's fire-all behaviour. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `AppSchemasFlowSchemaFlow`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Flows/create_flow_api_v1_flows_post)

## reorder

Reorder Flows. `PATCH /flows/reorder`

Re-order flow trigger priorities for the current tenant.

Accepts EITHER an ordered flow_ids list (server assigns priority = position, 0-based, so the first id wins) OR an explicit items: [{flow_id, priority}] list. Exactly one shape must be supplied. Lower priority = higher precedence (evaluated first when multiple flows match the same inbound event).

```php
$result = $sendseven->flows()->reorder();
```

- Scopes: `flows:write`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$flowIds` | `list<string>\|null` | no | Ordered flow ids; server assigns priority = position (0-based). |
| `$items` | `list<array<string, mixed>>\|null` | no | Explicit per-flow priority assignments. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `ReorderFlows`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Flows/reorder_flows_api_v1_flows_reorder_patch)

## stopRunByRunId

Stop Flow Run By Run Id. `POST /flows/runs/{run_id}/stop`

Operator-initiated cancel of a flow run, by run_id alone.

Convenience companion to POST /flows/{flow_id}/runs/{run_id}/stop for callers (notably the Conversations UI) that have the run id from the conversation's active_flow_run.run_id but no flow_id. Marks the run canceled, deletes pending waits, emits flow.run.canceled via :class:EventBus. Idempotent — already-terminal runs return their current row unchanged.

```php
$result = $sendseven->flows()->stopRunByRunId(runId: 'run_id');
```

- Scopes: `flows:write`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$runId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `FlowRun`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Flows/stop_flow_run_by_run_id_api_v1_flows_runs__run_id__stop_post)

## update

Update Flow. `PATCH /flows/{flow_id}`

Update a flow.

All fields optional. When definition is provided the API re-runs save-time structural validation. Editing a published flow is allowed — the engine snapshots definition into flow_runs.context.definition_snapshot at run-start so in-flight runs are isolated from the edit.

```php
$result = $sendseven->flows()->update(flowId: 'flow_id');
```

- Scopes: `flows:write`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$flowId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$name` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$description` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$definition` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no |  |
| `$reEntryPolicy` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$defaultLanguage` | `?string` | no | Per-flow fallback language (see CreateFlowRequest). Must be in the curated ~40 SUPPORTED_TRANSLATION_LOCALES. |
| `$preferOriginatingChannel` | `?bool` | no | When True, outbound nodes attempt to send on the channel the contact originally entered the flow on, falling back to the node's channel_chain if that channel isn't allowed by the chain or the contact has no method for it. Defaults to True at the DB level. |
| `$manuallyTriggerable` | `?bool` | no | When True, the flow appears in the operator's manual-start picker and accepts POST /flows/{id}/runs requests. Automatically forced True when the trigger kind is changed to manual; never auto-cleared when the trigger is changed away from manual (operator preference is preserved). |
| `$autoTranslateMessages` | `?bool` | no | Per-flow opt-in for runtime LLM translation of outbound Send-node messages into the contact's preferred language. |
| `$languageDetectionStrategy` | `?string` | no | How this flow's runs resolve the language (see CreateFlowRequest). cascade \| fixed. Omit on PATCH to preserve the current value; any other value is rejected with 422. Note: because NULL means "cascade", this field cannot be explicitly reset to NULL via PATCH — send "cascade" to restore the default behaviour. |
| `$defaultChannelChain` | `list<array<string, mixed>>\|null` | no | Flow-level fallback channel chain — see CreateFlowRequest. Omitting this field on PATCH preserves the existing value; send an explicit empty list to clear it back to "no default" (stored as the empty list, not NULL, when explicitly cleared). |
| `$stopOnAgentReply` | `?bool` | no | When True (the default for new flows), the flow engine terminates any active run for the contact + conversation the moment a human agent sends an outbound message. Omit on PATCH to preserve the current setting. |
| `$stopOnConversationClosed` | `?bool` | no | When True (the default for new flows), the flow engine terminates any active run scoped to the conversation the moment that conversation is closed. Omit on PATCH to preserve the current setting. |
| `$priority` | `?int` | no | Trigger-arbitration priority among entry flows (LOWER = higher priority, evaluated first). Omit on PATCH to preserve the current value. The bulk reorder endpoint writes this field. |
| `$exclusive` | `?bool` | no | When True, a running run of this entry flow blocks all OTHER entry flows from starting on the same conversation. Omit on PATCH to preserve the current value. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `AppSchemasFlowSchemaFlow`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Flows/update_flow_api_v1_flows__flow_id__patch)

## duplicate

Duplicate Flow. `POST /flows/{flow_id}/duplicate`

Create an independent copy of an existing flow as a fresh draft.

The copy mirrors every behaviour-defining field on the source — full definition JSON (trigger, schedule, nodes, edges, node configs, re-entry policy), description, and the channel/tag/etc. config nested inside definition. Node ids are regenerated and every internal reference (edges, entry_node_id, config-level *_node_id keys) is remapped so the copy is fully self-consistent.

```php
$result = $sendseven->flows()->duplicate(flowId: 'flow_id');
```

- Scopes: `flows:write`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$flowId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$body` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | The request body |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `AppSchemasFlowSchemaFlow`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Flows/duplicate_flow_api_v1_flows__flow_id__duplicate_post)

## pause

## deletePermanently

Delete Flow Permanently. `DELETE /flows/{flow_id}/permanent`

Permanently delete a flow — irreversible, destroys run history.

Distinct from DELETE /flows/{id}, which soft-archives (reversible via POST /flows/{id}/unarchive). This endpoint removes the flows row AND every child row: flow_runs, flow_run_steps, flow_run_waits. No FK cascades exist on the flow tables, so the service deletes children explicitly inside one transaction. Keyword-bot wiring that pointed at the flow is detached (set to NULL) rather than deleted. Conversation messages and tracked_links produced by the flow are KEPT — they are real history and their flow attribution readers are already best-effort.

```php
$sendseven->flows()->deletePermanently(flowId: 'flow_id');
```

- Scopes: `flows:write`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$flowId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `void`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Flows/delete_flow_permanently_api_v1_flows__flow_id__permanent_delete)

## startRun

Start Flow Run. `POST /flows/{flow_id}/runs`

Start a flow run for a contact.

Honors idempotency from EITHER the request body field idempotency_key OR the HTTP header Idempotency-Key (body wins on conflict). The engine's start_run returns the existing run on collision with HTTP 200; new runs return HTTP 201.

```php
$result = $sendseven->flows()->startRun(flowId: 'flow_id', contactId: 'contact_id');
```

- Scopes: `flows:write`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$flowId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$contactId` | `string` | yes | Contact UUID on the tenant's shard |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Optional caller-supplied idempotency key for at-most-once start semantics. If a run with the same (tenant_id, idempotency_key) already exists, the existing run is returned with HTTP 200 instead of creating a new one. If omitted, the engine derives a key from the request payload (e.g. manual:<flow_id>:<contact_id>:<request_id>). |
| `$context` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Extra variables to seed flow_runs.context.vars. Hard-capped at 16 KB JSON-encoded. |
| `$contactMethodOverrides` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Optional map of ChannelType (string value, e.g. email, sms, whatsapp, telegram, messenger, instagram, browser_push) → contact_method.id. When the flow sends on the matching channel, this specific contact_method's value is used as the destination instead of the contact's primary method. Per-channel keys are independent; omitted channels fall back to the default (primary) resolution. Each referenced contact_method must belong to the same tenant, the same contact, and have a method_type that matches the channel key. |
| `$idempotencyKeyIdempotency` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `FlowRun`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Flows/start_flow_run_api_v1_flows__flow_id__runs_post)

## listRunSteps

List Flow Run Steps. `GET /flows/{flow_id}/runs/{run_id}/steps`

List the audit-trail rows for a single flow run, oldest first.

Each row is enriched from the CURRENT flows.definition: * node_label — editor-visible label (display_name → snapshot label/name → derived). * node_config_snapshot — a curated subset of the node's current config (e.g. for collect_input: validation, max_attempts, on_timeout_node_id, prompt). NOT a point-in-time snapshot of what the engine executed — callers that need that fidelity should rely on input_snapshot. * branch_taken — best-effort from output_snapshot.chosen_branch.

```php
$result = $sendseven->flows()->listRunSteps(flowId: 'flow_id', runId: 'run_id');
```

- Scopes: `flows:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$flowId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$runId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$page` | `?int` | no |  |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no |  |

Returns `Page<FlowRunStep>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Flows/list_flow_run_steps_api_v1_flows__flow_id__runs__run_id__steps_get)

## stopRun

Stop Flow Run. `POST /flows/{flow_id}/runs/{run_id}/stop`

Operator-initiated cancel of a flow run.

Marks the run canceled, deletes pending waits, emits flow.run.canceled webhook. Idempotent — already-terminal runs return their current row unchanged.

```php
$result = $sendseven->flows()->stopRun(flowId: 'flow_id', runId: 'run_id');
```

- Scopes: `flows:write`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$flowId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$runId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `FlowRun`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Flows/stop_flow_run_api_v1_flows__flow_id__runs__run_id__stop_post)

## unarchive

Unarchive Flow. `POST /flows/{flow_id}/unarchive`

Restore a soft-archived flow to draft status.

Returns 409 if the flow is not archived.

```php
$result = $sendseven->flows()->unarchive(flowId: 'flow_id');
```

- Scopes: `flows:write`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$flowId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `AppSchemasFlowSchemaFlow`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Flows/unarchive_flow_api_v1_flows__flow_id__unarchive_post)

## getValidation

Get Flow Validation. `GET /flows/{flow_id}/validation`

Return the publish-time validation snapshot for a flow.

Same shape as FlowResponse.validation — exposed as a dedicated endpoint so the Flows editor can poll cheap validation passes after local edits without re-fetching the whole flow row. The Flows editor uses this to gate the "Activate" button and surface inline {path, message} warnings on the offending nodes / trigger.

```php
$result = $sendseven->flows()->getValidation(flowId: 'flow_id');
```

- Scopes: `flows:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$flowId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `FlowValidationStatus`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Flows/get_flow_validation_api_v1_flows__flow_id__validation_get)

## disconnect

Hubspot Disconnect. `DELETE /integrations/hubspot/connection`

Disconnect HubSpot: best-effort token revoke, then status=disconnected. The row is kept for audit / clean re-install.

```php
$result = $sendseven->hubSpotIntegration()->disconnect();
```

- Scopes: `settings:update`

Returns `HubSpotDisconnect`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/HubSpot%20Integration/hubspot_disconnect_api_v1_integrations_hubspot_connection_delete)

## getContactSyncFilter

Hubspot Get Contact Sync Filter. `GET /integrations/hubspot/contact-sync-filter`

Read the persisted selective contact-sync filter. Returns the pre-feature default (mode = none — import everything) when nothing is stored yet.

```php
$result = $sendseven->hubSpotIntegration()->getContactSyncFilter();
```

- Scopes: `settings:read`

Returns `HubSpotContactSyncFilterModel`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/HubSpot%20Integration/hubspot_get_contact_sync_filter_api_v1_integrations_hubspot_contact_sync_filter_get)

## putContactSyncFilter

Hubspot Put Contact Sync Filter. `PUT /integrations/hubspot/contact-sync-filter`

Persist the selective contact-sync filter. The filter is VALIDATED against HubSpot on save (a HubSpot 400 surfaces its own limit message); persisting ALSO increments sync_generation so a sync run using the previous filter self-interrupts. Narrowing stops adding non-matching contacts but does not delete already-synced ones; widening does not auto-backfill (import is a separate explicit action).

```php
$result = $sendseven->hubSpotIntegration()->putContactSyncFilter(mode: 'mode');
```

- Scopes: `settings:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$mode` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$version` | `?int` | no |  |
| `$properties` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no |  |
| `$list` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no |  |
| `$updatedAt` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$updatedByUserId` | `?string` | no |  |

Returns `HubSpotContactSyncFilterModel`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/HubSpot%20Integration/hubspot_put_contact_sync_filter_api_v1_integrations_hubspot_contact_sync_filter_put)

## contactCount

Hubspot Contact Count. `GET /integrations/hubspot/contacts/count`

Count the connected HubSpot portal's contacts, optionally scoped by a draft filter (unsaved filter_groups) and/or a list_id — this powers the live "X contacts match" preview while a selective-sync filter is being edited. Backed by a HubSpot Search (POST /crm/v3/objects/contacts/search with limit:0) that returns the server-side total in ~0.3s; results are cached ≤5 min unless refresh=true.

```php
$result = $sendseven->hubSpotIntegration()->contactCount();
```

- Scopes: `settings:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$filter` | `?string` | no | URL-encoded filter_groups JSON (OR across groups, AND within). Omit filter AND list_id to count the whole portal. |
| `$listId` | `?string` | no | Count only this HubSpot list's members |
| `$refresh` | `?bool` | no | Bypass the ≤5-min server cache (live-preview edits) |

Returns `HubSpotContactCount`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/HubSpot%20Integration/hubspot_contact_count_api_v1_integrations_hubspot_contacts_count_get)

## listLists

Hubspot List Hubspot Lists. `GET /integrations/hubspot/lists`

List the connected portal's HubSpot lists, each annotated with whether a SendSeven HUBSPOT_SEGMENT list already backs it — the picker for "target a HubSpot list".

```php
$result = $sendseven->hubSpotIntegration()->listLists();
```

- Scopes: `lists:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

Returns `Page<HubSpotListItem>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/HubSpot%20Integration/hubspot_list_hubspot_lists_api_v1_integrations_hubspot_lists_get)

## migrateList

Hubspot Migrate List. `POST /integrations/hubspot/lists/migrate`

Migrate a HubSpot list into a NEW SendSeven newsletter list (imports the members, creates the list, subscribes them via the unified subscription system) — the "migrate leads -> send campaign" flow.

```php
$sendseven->hubSpotIntegration()->migrateList();
```

- Scopes: `lists:create`, `contacts:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$body` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | The request body |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

## listProperties

Hubspot List Properties. `GET /integrations/hubspot/properties`

List the connected portal's HubSpot contact properties — feeds the settings field-mapping dropdown (replacing free-text property inputs). Each item: name, label, type, field_type, group_name, custom.

Also returns targets: the mappable-target catalogue for the "Contact methods" and "Social media profiles" settings sections — {"contact_methods": [{"target": "email", "label": "Email (primary)"}, ...], "social_profiles": [{"target": "linkedin", "label": "LinkedIn"}, ...]}. Pair a HubSpot property (from items) with one or more of these targets to build the contact_method_mapping sent to PATCH /settings.

```php
$sendseven->hubSpotIntegration()->listProperties();
```

- Scopes: `settings:read`

Returns `void`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/HubSpot%20Integration/hubspot_list_properties_api_v1_integrations_hubspot_properties_get)

## createProperty

Hubspot Create Property. `POST /integrations/hubspot/properties`

Create a new custom HubSpot contact property so it can be selected inline in the field-mapping UI. Returns the created property in the same shape as the list endpoint.

NOTE: HubSpot requires the crm.schemas.contacts.write scope to create a property. If the connected portal did not grant it, this returns 400.

```php
$sendseven->hubSpotIntegration()->createProperty(name: 'name', label: 'label');
```

- Scopes: `settings:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$name` | `string` | yes | Internal property name (no spaces) |
| `$label` | `string` | yes | Human-readable label |
| `$type` | `?string` | no | HubSpot data type, e.g. string/number/enumeration |
| `$fieldType` | `?string` | no | HubSpot field widget type, e.g. text/select |
| `$groupName` | `?string` | no | HubSpot property group the new property belongs to |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `void`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/HubSpot%20Integration/hubspot_create_property_api_v1_integrations_hubspot_properties_post)

## createSegment

Hubspot Create Segment. `POST /integrations/hubspot/segments`

Create a SendSeven list whose membership is backed by a live HubSpot list. The list can then be used as a campaign audience; members are resolved through the normal newsletter recipient funnel (reachability + opt-out + per-channel fan-out) at send time (or from cache in cached mode).

```php
$result = $sendseven->hubSpotIntegration()->createSegment(hubSpotListId: 'hubspot_list_id');
```

- Scopes: `lists:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$hubSpotListId` | `string` | yes | HubSpot ILS list id to back the segment |
| `$name` | `?string` | no | Name for the SendSeven list (default: HubSpot list name) |
| `$refreshMode` | `HubSpotSegmentRefreshMode\|string\|null` | no |  |
| `$intervalMinutes` | `?int` | no | Cached mode: refresh cadence in minutes (ignored for send_time) |
| `$unresolvedPolicy` | `HubSpotSegmentUnresolvedPolicy\|string\|null` | no |  |
| `$methodScope` | `HubSpotSegmentMethodScope\|string\|null` | no |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `HubSpotSegment`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/HubSpot%20Integration/hubspot_create_segment_api_v1_integrations_hubspot_segments_post)

## previewSegment

Hubspot Preview Segment. `POST /integrations/hubspot/segments/{list_id}/preview`

Preview a segment's audience: resolve a sample of the HubSpot list live and report how many members map to existing contacts, how many would be auto-created, and how many are unresolved under the segment's policy.

Dry-run: this is non-mutating — it resolves and counts WITHOUT creating any link or contact (would_create is a projection, not an action). The real send/sync/cached-refresh paths still eagerly link and create.

```php
$result = $sendseven->hubSpotIntegration()->previewSegment(listId: 'list_id');
```

- Scopes: `lists:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$listId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `HubSpotSegmentPreview`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/HubSpot%20Integration/hubspot_preview_segment_api_v1_integrations_hubspot_segments__list_id__preview_post)

## updateSettings

Hubspot Update Settings. `PATCH /integrations/hubspot/settings`

Update sync direction toggles and/or field-mapping overrides.

```php
$result = $sendseven->hubSpotIntegration()->updateSettings();
```

- Scopes: `settings:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$syncDirectionConfig` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Legacy wholesale config, e.g. {"contacts": "bidirectional" \| "hubspot_to_ss" \| "ss_to_hubspot" \| "off", "transcripts": true}. Prefer the flat sync_direction / sync_transcripts fields. |
| `$fieldMappingConfig` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Legacy alias for field_mapping: {"hubspot_property": "sendseven_field"} overrides. |
| `$fieldMapping` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | {"hubspot_property": "sendseven_field"} overrides. A first-class contact field (first_name/last_name/name/birthday — NOT email/phone, see contact_method_mapping) OR a custom field referenced as "custom:<field_key>". A legacy override that still targets email/phone keeps working unchanged. "birthday" is ONE-WAY (HubSpot -> SendSeven only) — mapping it never projects contact.birthday back to HubSpot. |
| `$contactMethodMapping` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Category-based mapping for the 'Contact methods' (Email/WhatsApp/Phone primary) and 'Social media profiles' (LinkedIn/Instagram Profile/Facebook Profile/Website/Other) settings sections: {"contact_methods": {hubspot_property: [target, ...]}, "social_profiles": {hubspot_property: [target, ...]}}. See GET /status's field of the same name for the full shape + targets. |
| `$syncDirection` | `?string` | no | "bidirectional" \| "hubspot_to_ss" \| "ss_to_hubspot" \| "off" |
| `$syncTranscripts` | `?bool` | no | Attach conversation transcripts to HubSpot on close |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `HubSpotStatus`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/HubSpot%20Integration/hubspot_update_settings_api_v1_integrations_hubspot_settings_patch)

<!-- docs/reference/integrations.md -->

# Integrations

`$sendseven->integrations()` — 1 endpoint.

| Method | HTTP | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`list()`](#list) | `GET /integrations` | List Integrations |

## list

List Integrations. `GET /integrations`

List available integrations for the Integrations Hub.

Returns a static-ish catalog of integrations with a per-tenant connected status. For API-token integrations (Zapier, n8n) the tenant is considered connected when it has at least one active (non-revoked, non-expired) API token. External-link cards (docs, partners) are never "connected".

```php
$result = $sendseven->integrations()->list();
```

- Scopes: `settings:read`

Returns `IntegrationCatalog`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Integrations/list_integrations_api_v1_integrations_get)

## previewUpcoming

Preview Upcoming Invoice. `GET /invoices/preview`

Preview upcoming charges for the current billing period.

Shows detailed line items with connection-level breakdown: - "WhatsApp Messages +49171231231" - 100 x EUR 0.005 - "Telegram Messages @MyBot" - 50 x EUR 0.005

```php
$result = $sendseven->invoices()->previewUpcoming();
```

- Scopes: `billing:read`

Returns `InvoicePreview`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Invoices/preview_upcoming_invoice_api_v1_invoices_preview_get)

## get

Get Invoice. `GET /invoices/{invoice_id}`

Get invoice details including line items.

Returns full invoice with itemized charges showing connection-level detail.

```php
$result = $sendseven->invoices()->get(invoiceId: 'invoice_id');
```

- Scopes: `billing:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$invoiceId` | `string` | yes |  |

<!-- docs/reference/kb-health.md -->

# KB Health

`$sendseven->kbHealth()` — 1 endpoint.

| Method | HTTP | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`get()`](#get) | `GET /kb-health` | Get Kb Health |

## get

Get Kb Health. `GET /kb-health`

Knowledge-base health dashboard.

Buckets: most used, never used, flagged, low quality, possible duplicates, stale. Note never_used counts *sent replies*, not retrievals — an entry that keeps getting retrieved but never makes it into an answer is exactly the kind of dead weight this view exists to surface.

```php
$result = $sendseven->kbHealth()->get();
```

- Scopes: `knowledge_base:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$folderId` | `?string` | no | Restrict to one KB folder |

Returns `KbHealthResponse`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/KB%20Health/get_kb_health_api_v1_kb_health_get)

## bulkDeleteDocuments

Bulk Delete Documents. `POST /knowledge-base/documents/bulk-delete`

Queue async deletion for many documents at once.

Transactional safety: rows are flipped to status='deleting' in a single transaction, then one kb_delete_file Pub/Sub message is published per document. If publishing fails mid-batch, we revert all affected rows back to status='ready' and return 500.

```php
$result = $sendseven->knowledgeBase()->bulkDeleteDocuments(documentIds: []);
```

- Scopes: `knowledge_base:delete`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$documentIds` | `list<string>` | yes | List of document IDs to delete (all must belong to the caller's tenant). |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `BulkDelete`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Knowledge%20Base/bulk_delete_documents_api_v1_knowledge_base_documents_bulk_delete_post)

## crawlWebsite

Crawl Website. `POST /knowledge-base/documents/crawl`

Start asynchronous website crawl job.

This endpoint immediately returns a job_id that can be used to track progress. The actual crawling happens in a Pub/Sub background worker.

```php
$result = $sendseven->knowledgeBase()->crawlWebsite(url: 'url');
```

- Scopes: `knowledge_base:admin`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$url` | `string` | yes | URL to crawl |
| `$followLinks` | `?bool` | no | If true, follow links and crawl multiple pages. If false, only crawl the single URL provided. |
| `$titlePrefix` | `?string` | no | Optional prefix for document titles |
| `$pageLimit` | `?int` | no | Maximum pages to crawl when follow_links=True (1-2000, default 200). Smart safeguards prevent duplicate content pages. |
| `$maxDepth` | `?int` | no | Maximum crawl depth when follow_links=True (default from settings) |
| `$rateLimit` | `float\|int\|null` | no | Seconds between requests (default from settings) |
| `$refresh` | `?bool` | no | If true, delete existing documents from this domain before crawling |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `WebsiteCrawlJob`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Knowledge%20Base/crawl_website_api_v1_knowledge_base_documents_crawl_post)

## listActiveCrawlJobs

List Active Crawl Jobs. `GET /knowledge-base/documents/crawl/active`

List all active (non-completed) crawl jobs for the tenant.

Returns jobs that are currently in queued, discovering, uploading, or processing status. Use this to show running jobs when the page reloads.

```php
$result = $sendseven->knowledgeBase()->listActiveCrawlJobs();
```

- Scopes: `knowledge_base:read`

Returns `ActiveCrawlJobs`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Knowledge%20Base/list_active_crawl_jobs_api_v1_knowledge_base_documents_crawl_active_get)

## previewCrawlUrl

Preview Crawl Url. `POST /knowledge-base/documents/crawl/preview`

Pre-crawl sanity check for a website URL (always HTTP 200).

Validates the URL (scheme, hostname with a real domain ending, DNS, private network block, reachability) and, when reachable, detects a sitemap and counts the pages it lists so the UI can show "sitemap found, N pages" before the user starts the crawl.

```php
$result = $sendseven->knowledgeBase()->previewCrawlUrl(url: 'url');
```

- Scopes: `knowledge_base:admin`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$url` | `string` | yes | Raw URL as typed by the user |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `CrawlPreview`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Knowledge%20Base/preview_crawl_url_api_v1_knowledge_base_documents_crawl_preview_post)

## cancelCrawlJob

Cancel Crawl Job. `POST /knowledge-base/documents/crawl/{job_id}/cancel`

Cancel a running website crawl job.

Only jobs in QUEUED, DISCOVERING, or UPLOADING status can be cancelled. The worker will cooperatively check for CANCELLED status and stop processing.

```php
$result = $sendseven->knowledgeBase()->cancelCrawlJob(jobId: 'job_id');
```

- Scopes: `knowledge_base:admin`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$jobId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `Success`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Knowledge%20Base/cancel_crawl_job_api_v1_knowledge_base_documents_crawl__job_id__cancel_post)

## listCrawledDomains

List Crawled Domains. `GET /knowledge-base/documents/crawled-domains`

List previously crawled domains with stored URL history.

Returns domains that have been crawled and have stored URL lists for deterministic re-crawling. Use the returned history_id with the /documents/recrawl endpoint.

```php
$result = $sendseven->knowledgeBase()->listCrawledDomains();
```

## recrawlDomain

Recrawl Domain. `POST /knowledge-base/documents/recrawl`

Re-crawl a domain with non-destructive crawl-then-reconcile.

Modes: - existing_pages: Re-crawl the exact URLs from previous crawl history (faster, predictable scope) - full_rescan: Re-discover pages via sitemap/BFS from scratch (finds new pages, more thorough)

```php
$result = $sendseven->knowledgeBase()->recrawlDomain(historyId: 'history_id');
```

- Scopes: `knowledge_base:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$historyId` | `string` | yes | ID of the crawl history record to use for re-crawling |
| `$mode` | `?string` | no | Recrawl mode. Defaults to 'full_rescan', which re-discovers pages from scratch via sitemap/BFS and picks up newly added pages. 'existing_pages' re-crawls only the URLs stored from the previous crawl. |
| `$titlePrefix` | `?string` | no | Optional prefix for document titles |
| `$pageLimit` | `?int` | no | Maximum pages to crawl (1-2000). If omitted, the coordinator falls back to its default page limit. |
| `$clearExisting` | `?bool` | no | Hard reset. When True, the existing documents for this domain (and their RAG corpus files) are deleted BEFORE the re-crawl runs, then pages are re-discovered and re-imported from scratch. When False (default), the re-crawl is non-destructive: existing documents are updated in-place and orphaned documents are cleaned up only after a successful crawl (crawl-then-reconcile). |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `WebsiteCrawlJob`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Knowledge%20Base/recrawl_domain_api_v1_knowledge_base_documents_recrawl_post)

## uploadDocumentFile

## uploadMultipleDocuments

Upload Multiple Documents. `POST /knowledge-base/documents/upload-multiple`

Upload multiple files at once to the knowledge base.

Up to 200 files per request. Each file is uploaded to GCS, gets its own status='pending_ingestion' DB row + job_id, and is dispatched to the KB administration worker as an independent kb_add_file Pub/Sub message. Partial success is possible — a per-file GCS or publish failure rolls back only that file's row and surfaces as a success=false entry.

```php
$result = $sendseven->knowledgeBase()->uploadMultipleDocuments(files: []);
```

- Scopes: `knowledge_base:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$files` | `list<FilePart>` | yes | Files to upload (max 200 files) |
| `$documentType` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$folderId` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `MultiFileUpload`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Knowledge%20Base/upload_multiple_documents_api_v1_knowledge_base_documents_upload_multiple_post)

## deleteDocument

Delete Document. `DELETE /knowledge-base/documents/{document_id}`

Queue an async delete for a knowledge base document.

Async pipeline (B-4): 1. The row is flipped to status='deleting' with a fresh job_id. 2. A kb_delete_file Pub/Sub message is published. 3. The KB administration worker performs the RAG file delete and then removes the row. Poll GET /jobs/{job_id} to observe completion.

```php
$result = $sendseven->knowledgeBase()->deleteDocument(documentId: 'document_id');
```

- Scopes: `knowledge_base:delete`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$documentId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `KnowledgeBaseDelete`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Knowledge%20Base/delete_document_api_v1_knowledge_base_documents__document_id__delete)

## getDocumentRaw

Get Document Raw. `GET /knowledge-base/documents/{document_id}/raw`

Stream the raw UTF-8 text content of an editable KB document from GCS.

Supported document types: manual, uploaded_doc, faq — and only for extensions .md / .txt / .html. Returns 400 for PDFs, images, crawled website pages, or any other non-editable type.

```php
$result = $sendseven->knowledgeBase()->getDocumentRaw(documentId: 'document_id');
```

- Scopes: `knowledge_base:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$documentId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `KbDocumentRaw`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Knowledge%20Base/get_document_raw_api_v1_knowledge_base_documents__document_id__raw_get)

## putDocumentRaw

Put Document Raw. `PUT /knowledge-base/documents/{document_id}/raw`

Replace the raw text content of an editable KB document.

Behaviour: 1. Validates size (≤ 1 MB) — returns 413 otherwise. 2. Validates that the document type + extension are editable (otherwise 400, same rules as GET /raw). 3. Uploads the new bytes to GCS (same path pattern as upload_to_gcs() — rag_uploads/{tenant_id}/doc_{id}_{uuid}.{ext}). 4. Updates the DB row: gemini_file_name / upload_metadata.gcs_uri point at the new blob, status → pending_ingestion, a fresh job_id is set, updated_at = utc_now(). 5. Publishes a kb_add_file message to PUBSUB_TOPIC_KB_ADMINISTRATION so the KB administration worker performs the Vertex AI RAG import. When ingestion completes, status transitions back to ready.

```php
$result = $sendseven->knowledgeBase()->putDocumentRaw(documentId: 'document_id', content: 'content');
```

- Scopes: `knowledge_base:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$documentId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$content` | `string` | yes | New UTF-8 text content (max 1 MB) |

Returns `KnowledgeBaseDocument`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Knowledge%20Base/put_document_raw_api_v1_knowledge_base_documents__document_id__raw_put)

## refreshDocument

Refresh Document. `POST /knowledge-base/documents/{document_id}/refresh`

Refresh a single document by re-fetching its source URL.

Only works for website documents that have a source_url. Re-crawls the single page and updates the document content in-place.

```php
$result = $sendseven->knowledgeBase()->refreshDocument(documentId: 'document_id');
```

- Scopes: `knowledge_base:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$documentId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `RefreshDocument`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Knowledge%20Base/refresh_document_api_v1_knowledge_base_documents__document_id__refresh_post)

## retryDocument

Retry Document. `POST /knowledge-base/documents/{document_id}/retry`

Retry ingestion for a single knowledge base document.

Retryable documents are either status='failed' OR a *stuck* status='pending_ingestion' row — one left un-imported under a crawl/ ingestion job that has since finished (see _pending_ingestion_is_stuck: old enough and owned by no still-running job). Any other status — including a pending_ingestion row whose ingestion job is still running — returns 409. The GCS object already exists from the original upload, so this does NOT re-upload the file bytes — it re-derives the gcs_uri + folder corpus from the stored metadata, flips the row to status='pending_ingestion' with a fresh job_id and last_error=NULL, and re-publishes the kb_add_file Pub/Sub message. Returns the updated document (202).

```php
$result = $sendseven->knowledgeBase()->retryDocument(documentId: 'document_id');
```

- Scopes: `knowledge_base:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$documentId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `KnowledgeBaseDocument`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Knowledge%20Base/retry_document_api_v1_knowledge_base_documents__document_id__retry_post)

## deleteFolder

Delete Folder. `DELETE /knowledge-base/folders/{folder_id}`

Queue async deletion for a folder and all of its documents.

1. The folder is flipped to status='deleting'. 2. All contained documents are flipped to status='deleting' and each is dispatched as a kb_delete_file job. 3. A single kb_delete_folder_finalize job is published; the worker polls for document drain, then deletes the Vertex AI corpus and the folder row.

```php
$result = $sendseven->knowledgeBase()->deleteFolder(folderId: 'folder_id');
```

- Scopes: `knowledge_base:delete`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$folderId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `FolderDelete`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Knowledge%20Base/delete_folder_api_v1_knowledge_base_folders__folder_id__delete)

## retryFailedDocumentsInFolder

Retry Failed Documents In Folder. `POST /knowledge-base/folders/{folder_id}/retry-failed`

Retry every failed document in a folder.

Re-queues every retryable document in the folder using the same per-document logic as the single retry endpoint: all status='failed' documents, plus any status='pending_ingestion' document that is *stuck* — left un-imported under a crawl/ingestion job that has since finished (see _pending_ingestion_is_stuck). A pending_ingestion row still owned by a running job is skipped, never re-queued. A folder with nothing to retry is not an error — it returns retried_count: 0.

```php
$result = $sendseven->knowledgeBase()->retryFailedDocumentsInFolder(folderId: 'folder_id');
```

- Scopes: `knowledge_base:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$folderId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `RetryFailed`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Knowledge%20Base/retry_failed_documents_in_folder_api_v1_knowledge_base_folders__folder_id__retry_failed_post)

## getKbJobStatus

A job_id can belong to either a document operation (uploaded or deletion) or a folder deletion. The returned resource_type tells the client which. Returns 404 if no resource carries this job_id.

# Link Tracking

`$sendseven->linkTracking()` — 11 endpoints.

| Method | HTTP | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`listTracked()`](#listtracked) | `GET /tracked-links` | List Tracked Links |
| [`createTracked()`](#createtracked) | `POST /tracked-links` | Create Tracked Link |

| [`checkAliasAvailability()`](#checkaliasavailability) | `GET /tracked-links/check-alias/{alias}` | Check Alias Availability |
| [`extractUrls()`](#extracturls) | `POST /tracked-links/extract-urls` | Extract Urls |
| [`getFeatureAnalytics()`](#getfeatureanalytics) | `GET /tracked-links/feature/{feature_type}/{feature_id}/analytics` | Get Feature Analytics |
| [`createManualTracked()`](#createmanualtracked) | `POST /tracked-links/manual` | Create Manual Tracked Link |
| [`deleteTracked()`](#deletetracked) | `DELETE /tracked-links/{link_id}` | Delete Tracked Link |

| [`getAnalytics()`](#getanalytics) | `GET /tracked-links/{tracked_link_id}/analytics` | Get Link Analytics |

## listTracked

List Tracked Links. `GET /tracked-links`

List all tracked links for tenant with pagination and filtering.

Query Parameters: - page: Page number (1-indexed, default: 1) - page_size: Items per page (1-100, default: 20) - search: Search term for original_url, label, short_code, or custom_alias - feature_type: Filter by feature type (email_campaign, conversation, etc.) - tags: Filter by tags (returns links matching ANY of the provided tags)

```php
$result = $sendseven->linkTracking()->listTracked();
```

- Scopes: `link_tracking:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$page` | `?int` | no | Page number (1-indexed) |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no | Items per page (max 100) |
| `$search` | `?string` | no | Search in original_url, label, short_code, or custom_alias |
| `$featureType` | `FeatureType\|string\|null` | no | Filter by feature type |
| `$tags` | `list<string>\|null` | no | Filter by tags (any match) |

Returns `TrackedLinkList`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Link%20Tracking/list_tracked_links_api_v1_tracked_links_get)

| `$label` | `?string` | no | User-friendly label for the link |
| `$trackingMode` | `TrackingMode\|string\|null` | no | Tracking granularity. 'shared' (default) = one link for all recipients. 'per_recipient' = template link cloned per recipient at send time; requires feature_type=REACH or EMAIL_CAMPAIGN and feature_id. |

## getTracked

Get Tracked Link. `GET /tracked-links/{link_id}`

Get a single tracked link with detailed click statistics.

Returns full link details including: - Basic link info (short_code, original_url, etc.) - Custom alias, label, and tags - Click statistics (total clicks, unique clicks) - First and last click timestamps

```php
$result = $sendseven->linkTracking()->getTracked(linkId: 'link_id');
```

- Scopes: `link_tracking:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$linkId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `TrackedLinkDetail`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Link%20Tracking/get_tracked_link_api_v1_tracked_links__link_id__get)

## updateTracked

Update Tracked Link. `PUT /tracked-links/{link_id}`

Update a tracked link.

Updates the following fields (only provided fields are updated): - label: User-friendly label - tags: List of tags for categorization - custom_alias: Custom short code (must be unique) - is_active: Whether the link is active

```php
$result = $sendseven->linkTracking()->updateTracked(linkId: 'link_id');
```

- Scopes: `link_tracking:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$linkId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$label` | `?string` | no | User-friendly label for the link |
| `$tags` | `list<string>\|null` | no | Tags for categorization |
| `$customAlias` | `?string` | no | Custom short code/alias. Must be unique. Only lowercase letters (a-z), digits (0-9), and hyphens (-) allowed. |
| `$isActive` | `?bool` | no | Whether the link is active |

Returns `TrackedLinkDetail`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Link%20Tracking/update_tracked_link_api_v1_tracked_links__link_id__put)

## getAnalytics

Get Link Analytics. `GET /tracked-links/{tracked_link_id}/analytics`

Get analytics for a specific tracked link.

Includes: - Total clicks - Unique clicks (by IP) - Device breakdown - Click timeline

## listLists

List Lists. `GET /lists`

List all lists for the tenant with pagination.

Returns paginated list of all static, dynamic, and newsletter lists. Each list includes its computed contact count (for email subscriptions).

```php
$result = $sendseven->lists()->listLists();
```

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$page` | `?int` | no | Page number (1-indexed) |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no | Items per page |

Returns `Page<ListResponse>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Lists/list_lists_api_v1_lists_get)

## create

Create List. `POST /lists`

Create a new list (static, dynamic, or newsletter).

- Static lists: Contacts are manually added/removed - Dynamic lists: Contacts are matched via segment conditions - Newsletter lists: Contacts subscribe via widgets/deep links

```php
$result = $sendseven->lists()->create(name: 'name', listType: 'list_type');
```

- Scopes: `lists:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$name` | `string` | yes | List name |
| `$listType` | `ListType\|string` | yes | Type of list: static, dynamic, or newsletter |
| `$description` | `?string` | no | List description |
| `$segmentConditions` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Segment conditions for dynamic lists |
| `$slug` | `?string` | no | URL-safe slug for newsletter lists (auto-generated if not provided) |
| `$newsletterConfig` | `?string` | no | JSON string for newsletter configuration. Keys: opt_in_keywords, opt_out_keywords, welcome_message, goodbye_message, confirmation_message, auto_subscribe_via_deeplink, plus the button lists welcome_buttons / goodbye_buttons — each up to 3 objects of {"type": "unsubscribe"\|"unsubscribe_all"\|"subscribe"\|"url", "caption": "max 20 chars", "url": "https://… (url type only)"}. Buttons render natively on WhatsApp / Telegram / Messenger / Instagram and degrade to a keyword text hint elsewhere. Omitting goodbye_buttons entirely means a default "Re-subscribe" button is added; send [] for none. |
| `$showInPreferenceCenter` | `?bool` | no | Whether this newsletter list is offered in the hosted email preference center (the 'Manage preferences' link in emails). Defaults to false — opt in explicitly to expose a list. Lists created before this field existed remain visible. |
| `$isDefault` | `?bool` | no | Whether this is the default list for global 'start'/'stop' keywords. Only one list per tenant can be default. |
| `$optInAction` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Per-channel opt-in action (send a MESSAGE or start a FLOW — never both). {default, per_channel}; per_channel keys are SubscriptionChannelType values. Omit to keep the legacy welcome message from newsletter_config. Flow actions must reference a published, same-tenant flow. |
| `$optOutAction` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Per-channel opt-out action (MESSAGE or FLOW). Same shape as opt_in_action. Omit to keep the legacy goodbye message. |
| `$hubSpotOptinFieldConfig` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Per-channel HubSpot contact-property mapping applied on opt-in / opt-out ({default, per_channel} of {property_name, opt_in_value, opt_out_value}). Persisted here; the HubSpot write is performed off the contact.subscribed/unsubscribed event by the integrations layer. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `ListResponse`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Lists/create_list_api_v1_lists_post)

## evaluateConditionsCount

Evaluate Conditions Count. `POST /lists/evaluate-count`

Count contacts matching inline segment conditions.

Accepts segment conditions directly (no saved list required) and returns the count of matching contacts without loading them into memory.

```php
$sendseven->lists()->evaluateConditionsCount();
```

- Scopes: `lists:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$operator` | `?string` | no | Logical operator: AND or OR |
| `$conditions` | `list<array<string, mixed>>\|null` | no | Flat list of conditions (legacy format) |
| `$groups` | `list<array<string, mixed>>\|null` | no | Nested condition groups for complex queries |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `void`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Lists/evaluate_conditions_count_api_v1_lists_evaluate_count_post)

## getSubscriptionStats

Batch opt-in / opt-out / net-change counts for every list in the window.

Returns a row for EVERY list the tenant has (zeros for lists with no subscription activity) so the frontend can map results by list_id.

```php
$result = $sendseven->lists()->getSubscriptionStats();
```

- Scopes: `lists:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$windowDays` | `?int` | no | Rolling window size in days |

Returns `ListSubscriptionStats`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Lists/get_lists_subscription_stats_api_v1_lists_subscription_stats_get)

## addContactTo

Add Contact To List. `POST /lists/{list_id}/members`

Add a contact to a list (static or newsletter).

- Static lists: channel_type should be None (uses email by default) - Newsletter lists: channel_type is required (email, telegram, messenger, instagram, etc.); channel_id is additionally required for the scoped channels telegram / messenger / instagram.

```php
$result = $sendseven->lists()->addContactTo(listId: 'list_id', contactId: 'contact_id');
```

- Scopes: `lists:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$listId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$contactId` | `string` | yes | ID of the contact to add |
| `$channelType` | `?string` | no | Required for newsletter subscriptions (email, telegram, messenger, instagram, ...). DEPRECATED fallback: if omitted for a newsletter list it defaults to email, but this fallback will be removed in a future release — always pass channel_type. |
| `$channelId` | `?string` | no | Channel ID (which bot/page). Required only for scoped newsletter channels: telegram, messenger, instagram. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `AddMember`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Lists/add_contact_to_list_api_v1_lists__list_id__members_post)

## removeContactFrom

Remove Contact From List. `DELETE /lists/{list_id}/members/{contact_id}`

Remove a contact from a list.

- Static lists: Removes the contact completely - Newsletter lists: Removes the subscription for a specific channel; channel_type is required. (For backwards compatibility a missing channel_type still falls back to email, but this is DEPRECATED and will be removed in a future release.) - Dynamic lists: Cannot remove (membership determined by conditions)

```php
$sendseven->lists()->removeContactFrom(listId: 'list_id', contactId: 'contact_id');
```

- Scopes: `lists:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$listId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$contactId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$channelType` | `?string` | no | Required for newsletter unsubscriptions (email, telegram, messenger, instagram, ...). DEPRECATED fallback: if omitted for a newsletter list it defaults to email, but this fallback will be removed in a future release — always pass channel_type. |

Returns `void`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Lists/remove_contact_from_list_api_v1_lists__list_id__members__contact_id__delete)

## getSignupOptions

Get List Signup Options. `GET /lists/{list_id}/signup-options`

Get signup options (deep links + QR codes) for a newsletter list.

Generates channel-specific signup links and QR codes for newsletter subscriptions. Useful for widgets and marketing materials.

```php
$result = $sendseven->lists()->getSignupOptions(listId: 'list_id');
```

- Scopes: `lists:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$listId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$includeQr` | `?bool` | no | Whether to generate QR codes |

Returns `ListSignupOptions`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Lists/get_list_signup_options_api_v1_lists__list_id__signup_options_get)

## getSubscriptionActivity

Get List Subscription Activity. `GET /lists/{list_id}/subscription-activity`

Per-list opt-in / opt-out event drill-down (paginated, newest first).

- direction filters to opt-in events (in), opt-out events (out), or both (all), all within the window. - last_message_in_list is populated only for unsubscribed events (the last outbound campaign message this contact received on this channel that belongs to the list), with attribution of exact / ambiguous / none. It is null for subscribed events.

```php
$result = $sendseven->lists()->getSubscriptionActivity(listId: 'list_id');
```

- Scopes: `lists:read`, `contacts:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$listId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$windowDays` | `?int` | no | Rolling window size in days |
| `$direction` | `?string` | no | all \| in \| out |
| `$page` | `?int` | no | Page number (1-indexed) |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no | Items per page |

Returns `Page<SubscriptionActivityItem>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Lists/get_list_subscription_activity_api_v1_lists__list_id__subscription_activity_get)

# Media Gallery

`$sendseven->mediaGallery()` — 7 endpoints.

| Method | HTTP | Summary |
|---|---|---|

| [`createAsset()`](#createasset) | `POST /media-gallery` | Create Media Asset |

## listAssets

List Media Assets. `GET /media-gallery`

List gallery assets (excludes archived by default).

Returns the unified {items, pagination} shape. Each item carries BOTH the durable attachment_id and a fresh url. Every filter — archived, favorites_only, media_type, tag and query search — composes with AND and with pagination (e.g. ?archived=only&favorites_only=true = archived favorites).

```php
$sendseven->mediaGallery()->listAssets();
```

- Scopes: `media_gallery:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$query` | `?string` | no | Match display_name or description |
| `$tag` | `list<string>\|null` | no | Filter by tag. Repeat the param for multi-tag AND (asset must carry every tag), e.g. ?tag=logo&tag=2024. |
| `$mediaType` | `?string` | no | Filter by media type: image \| video \| document |
| `$favoritesOnly` | `?bool` | no | When true, return only assets marked as favorite. |
| `$archived` | `MediaArchivedFilter\|string\|null` | no | Archive-status view: 'active' (default) = non-archived only (unchanged behavior); 'only' = archived-only (the dedicated Archived tab, for recovering an accidentally-archived asset); 'all' = unified active + archived. |
| `$page` | `?int` | no |  |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no |  |

Returns `void`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Media%20Gallery/list_media_assets_api_v1_media_gallery_get)

## createAsset

Create Media Asset. `POST /media-gallery`

Save an already-stored attachment into the gallery.

Re-verifies the attachment belongs to the caller's tenant before insert (never trusts a client-supplied attachment_id); derives media_type/content_type/file_size from the attachment and validates the type/size caps.

```php
$result = $sendseven->mediaGallery()->createAsset(attachmentId: 'attachment_id', displayName: 'display_name');
```

- Scopes: `media_gallery:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$attachmentId` | `string` | yes | Id of an attachment the caller's tenant already owns |
| `$displayName` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$description` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$tags` | `list<string>\|null` | no | Tags; normalized to lowercase, trimmed, deduped on save |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `MediaGalleryAsset`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Media%20Gallery/create_media_asset_api_v1_media_gallery_post)

## deleteAsset

Delete Media Asset. `DELETE /media-gallery/{asset_id}`

Hard-delete a gallery asset (tags cascade). The underlying attachment is NOT deleted.

```php
$result = $sendseven->mediaGallery()->deleteAsset(assetId: 'asset_id');
```

- Scopes: `media_gallery:delete`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$assetId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `MediaGalleryDelete`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Media%20Gallery/delete_media_asset_api_v1_media_gallery__asset_id__delete)

## updateAsset

Update Media Asset. `PATCH /media-gallery/{asset_id}`

Update a gallery asset. Providing tags REPLACES the full tag set.

```php
$result = $sendseven->mediaGallery()->updateAsset(assetId: 'asset_id');
```

- Scopes: `media_gallery:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$assetId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$displayName` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$description` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$tags` | `list<string>\|null` | no | Full replacement tag set (normalized on save) |
| `$isArchived` | `?bool` | no | Soft-archive toggle; archived assets drop out of the default list |
| `$isFavorite` | `?bool` | no | Favorite toggle; surface with the ?favorites_only=true list filter |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `MediaGalleryAsset`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Media%20Gallery/update_media_asset_api_v1_media_gallery__asset_id__patch)

## unfavoriteAsset

## favoriteAsset

Favorite Media Asset. `POST /media-gallery/{asset_id}/favorite`

Mark a gallery asset as a favorite (idempotent one-tap toggle).


- Scopes: `media_gallery:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |

## requestThumbnail

Request Media Thumbnail. `POST /media-gallery/{asset_id}/thumbnail`

Lazily generate a thumbnail for an asset that has none (generate-on-view).

Idempotent and cheap: if the asset already has a thumbnail (or is a document) this just returns it. Otherwise it de-dupes concurrent callers (Redis claim) and enqueues a single background generation job, returning the asset immediately with its current url — the generated thumbnail_url appears on the next list/refresh. Safe for the gallery/picker to call once per visible thumbnail-less card.

```php
$result = $sendseven->mediaGallery()->requestThumbnail(assetId: 'asset_id');
```

- Scopes: `media_gallery:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$assetId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `MediaGalleryAsset`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Media%20Gallery/request_media_thumbnail_api_v1_media_gallery__asset_id__thumbnail_post)
