# Messages

`$sendseven->messages()` — 11 endpoints.

| Method | HTTP | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`list()`](#list) | `GET /messages` | List Messages |
| [`send()`](#send) | `POST /messages` | Send Message |
| [`createInternalNote()`](#createinternalnote) | `POST /messages/internal-notes` | Create Internal Note |
| [`proxy()`](#proxy) | `POST /messages/proxy` | Send a raw platform request through a channel |
| [`sendCarousel()`](#sendcarousel) | `POST /messages/send/carousel` | Send carousel message |
| [`sendContacts()`](#sendcontacts) | `POST /messages/send/contacts` | Send contact card(s) |
| [`sendInteractive()`](#sendinteractive) | `POST /messages/send/interactive` | Send interactive message |
| [`sendSticker()`](#sendsticker) | `POST /messages/send/sticker` | Send sticker |
| [`get()`](#get) | `GET /messages/{message_id}` | Get Message |
| [`removeReaction()`](#removereaction) | `DELETE /messages/{message_id}/react` | Remove reaction from message |
| [`addReaction()`](#addreaction) | `POST /messages/{message_id}/react` | Add reaction to message |

## list

List Messages. `GET /messages`

List messages for a conversation, or tenant-wide by status/direction.

Conversation mode (conversation_id given): unchanged. Cursor or page pagination.

```php
$result = $sendseven->messages()->list();
```

- Scopes: `messages:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$conversationId` | `?string` | no | Conversation UUID. Required unless a tenant-wide filter (status and/or direction) is given. |
| `$status` | `MessageStatus\|string\|null` | no | Tenant-wide mode only: filter by delivery status (e.g. failed). |
| `$direction` | `MessageDirection\|string\|null` | no | Tenant-wide mode only: filter by direction (inbound / outbound). |
| `$createdAfter` | `DateTimeInterface\|string\|null` | no | Tenant-wide mode only: only messages created at/after this ISO-8601 timestamp. Defaults to the last 30 days. |
| `$page` | `?int` | no | Page number (1-indexed) |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no | Items per page |
| `$cursor` | `?string` | no | Cursor for efficient keyset pagination (overrides page) |

Returns `Page<Message>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Messages/list_messages_api_v1_messages_get)

## send

Send Message. `POST /messages`

Send a new message.

Supports 3 resolution modes:

```php
$result = $sendseven->messages()->send();
```

- Scopes: `messages:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$to` | `?string` | no | The recipient's address on the channel: a phone number (E.164) for WhatsApp, SMS and RCS, an email address, or the channel's ID for the person (e.g. a Telegram chat ID). Optional when conversation_id, contact_method_id or contact_id identifies them. |
| `$channelId` | `?string` | no | Channel UUID (used when creating new conversation or for ambiguous recipients) |
| `$conversationId` | `?string` | no | Conversation UUID (auto-resolved from contact_id if not provided) |
| `$contactMethodId` | `?string` | no | Contact method UUID - cleanest way to send, resolves to, channel_id, and contact_id automatically |
| `$contactId` | `?string` | no | Contact UUID (used to auto-resolve conversation when conversation_id is omitted) |
| `$messageType` | `MessageType\|string\|null` | no | Message type |
| `$replyToMessageId` | `?string` | no | Optional UUID of a prior message in the SAME conversation to reply to (threaded / quote reply). The target message must already have a platform external_id; the outbound message is sent as a native quote-reply on channels that support it (WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, Live Chat). Rejected with 4xx if the target is not found in this conversation or has no external_id yet. |
| `$text` | `?string` | no | Message text content |
| `$subject` | `?string` | no | Email subject line — REQUIRED for email channel sends, ignored for chat-app channels (whatsapp/telegram/sms/etc.). When omitted for an email reply, the conversation's existing subject is used (prefixed with 'Re: ' if not already). The API rejects an email send with no resolvable subject (SendGrid 400s on empty subject). |
| `$attachments` | `string\|array<array-key, mixed>\|null` | no | Attachment IDs (UUIDs) returned from POST /api/v1/attachments/upload or POST /api/v1/attachments/from-url. Do NOT pass raw URLs here — fetch them via /attachments/from-url first to get an ID. Accepts either an array or a single bare ID string ("<uuid>" is treated as ["<uuid>"]). Whitespace is trimmed and empty entries are dropped. On channels that can only carry ONE media object per message (WhatsApp, Telegram, Messenger, Instagram, SMS/MMS, browser push, RCS) several attachments are delivered as several messages — one per attachment, with text used as the caption of the FIRST one. This response returns the first message; the additional ones are listed in related_message_ids. Email (MIME parts) and live chat deliver all attachments inside a single message. |
| `$attachmentFilenames` | `list<string>\|null` | no | Optional per-message display-filename overrides for attachments, aligned positionally by index (entry N overrides the filename of attachments[N]). Controls the filename shown to the recipient — e.g. Meta's filename field on a WhatsApp document, so the user sees Invoice-2026.pdf instead of the stored object name. When omitted (or an entry is null/empty), the send path falls back to the original filename stored on the Attachment record (attachments.filename). If the list is shorter than attachments, only the leading attachments are overridden; extra entries beyond the number of attachments are ignored. Every entry now takes effect: on a channel that delivers one attachment per message, entry N is the filename of the message carrying attachments[N]. |
| `$meta` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Customer metadata |
| `$isVoice` | `?bool` | no | Mark this message as a voice message (push-to-talk). Only valid when message_type is audio AND at least one attachment (the recorded audio) is supplied — the server rejects the send (422) otherwise. When true, duration_ms is required. Persisted into the message's meta as meta.is_voice (sibling meta keys are preserved). The recorded file is the first entry in attachments (a normal Attachment ID); the messages-out worker transcodes it to OGG/Opus before delivery. Default false → ordinary audio file send (unchanged behavior). |
| `$durationMs` | `?int` | no | Recorded duration of the voice message in milliseconds. REQUIRED when is_voice is true; must be > 0 and <= 300000 (5 minutes — longer recordings are rejected with 422). Ignored when is_voice is false. Persisted into meta.duration_ms. |
| `$includeSignature` | `?bool` | no | Append the sender's email signature to outbound email (EmailSignature for the user, falling back to EmailSignatureTemplate for the tenant). Default true for email; ignored for chat-app channels. |
| `$senderId` | `?string` | no | Optional sender override for email channel sends. The id either of an EmailIntegration (proxy / gmail / smtp-imap / ses-managed) or an EmailProviderConfig (SendGrid / Mailgun / SES). Surface candidates via GET /api/v1/conversations/{id}/sender-options. The server validates the choice against the user's EmailMailbox ACL, additionally allowing the conversation's default reply sender (the receiving connection's outbound_provider) even when the user is not on that mailbox's ACL. Ignored for non-email channels. |
| `$messageTrafficType` | `?string` | no | RCS only. Declares the traffic class of this send to the mobile carrier (AgentMessage.messageTrafficType): one of AUTHENTICATION, TRANSACTION, PROMOTION, SERVICEREQUEST, ACKNOWLEDGEMENT. This is a REGULATORY declaration, not a billing option — if the message is marketing you must declare PROMOTION. Omitted (the default) means SERVICEREQUEST, which is correct only for replies to a customer's own enquiry. Unrecognised values are ignored (the default applies) rather than failing the send. Ignored by all non-RCS channels. |
| `$contentFormat` | `?string` | no | How the send pipeline must treat the message body. plain (the default when omitted) = human-typed text, passed through to the channel UNTOUCHED. markdown = canonical markdown that the channel adapter renders into each channel's own formatting. Omit this for normal human replies — only AI/bot/flow-generated content should opt into markdown. Stored on the message as meta.content_format; absence is always treated as plain. |
| `$content` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | DEPRECATED: use text and message_type directly |
| `$metadata` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | DEPRECATED: use meta |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `Message`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Messages/send_message_api_v1_messages_post)

## createInternalNote

Create Internal Note. `POST /messages/internal-notes`

Create an internal note on a conversation.

Internal notes are visible only to agents and are never sent to the customer. They appear in the conversation timeline styled differently from regular messages.

```php
$result = $sendseven->messages()->createInternalNote(conversationId: 'conversation_id', text: 'text');
```

- Scopes: `messages:create`, `conversations:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$conversationId` | `string` | yes | Conversation UUID to attach the note to |
| `$text` | `string` | yes | Note text content |
| `$mentionedUserIds` | `list<string>\|null` | no | User IDs mentioned with @ in this note (triggers notifications) |
| `$assignToUserId` | `?string` | no | If provided, assign the conversation to this user |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `Message`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Messages/create_internal_note_api_v1_messages_internal_notes_post)

## proxy

Send a raw platform request through a channel. `POST /messages/proxy`

Pass a request straight to the channel's platform API, e.g. to mark a WhatsApp message as read.

```php
$result = $sendseven->messages()->proxy(channelId: 'channel_id', endpoint: 'endpoint', payload: []);
```

- Scopes: `messages:create`
- Not in SendSeven's spec; verified: Live: answered 422 rather than 404 (1 Oct 2026); used by Renotify to send WhatsApp read receipts.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$channelId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$endpoint` | `string` | yes | The platform endpoint, e.g. messages |
| `$payload` | `array<string, mixed>` | yes | The platform's own request body |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `array<array-key, mixed>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Messages/proxy_message_api_v1_messages_proxy_post)

## sendCarousel

Send a carousel (multi-card) message via WhatsApp or Messenger.

This endpoint supports both platforms with different approaches:

```php
$result = $sendseven->messages()->sendCarousel(channelId: 'channel_id', contactId: 'contact_id');
```

- Scopes: `messages:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

| `$contactId` | `string` | yes | Contact UUID (the recipient) |
| `$templateName` | `?string` | no | WhatsApp template name (required for WhatsApp) |
| `$language` | `?string` | no | Template language code (default: 'en') |
| `$cards` | `list<array<string, mixed>>\|null` | no | WhatsApp carousel cards (max 10, required for WhatsApp) |
| `$elements` | `list<array<string, mixed>>\|null` | no | Messenger carousel elements (max 10, required for Messenger) |
| `$meta` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Custom metadata to attach to the message |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `SendCarousel`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Messages/send_carousel_api_v1_messages_send_carousel_post)

## sendContacts

Send contact card(s). `POST /messages/send/contacts`

Send one or more contact cards via WhatsApp.

Contact cards allow sharing contact information including names, phone numbers, email addresses, physical addresses, and organization details. Currently supported on WhatsApp only.

```php
$result = $sendseven->messages()->sendContacts(channelId: 'channel_id', contactId: 'contact_id', contacts: []);
```

- Scopes: `messages:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |

| `$contactId` | `string` | yes | Contact UUID (the recipient) |
| `$contacts` | `list<array<string, mixed>>` | yes | Contact cards to send (1-10) |
| `$meta` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Custom metadata to attach to the message |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `SendContacts`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Messages/send_contacts_api_v1_messages_send_contacts_post)

## sendInteractive

Send interactive message. `POST /messages/send/interactive`

Send an interactive message with buttons or list menu.

Interactive messages provide rich UI elements for user engagement. Currently supported on WhatsApp only. Other platforms will return an error with guidance on supported alternatives.

```php
$result = $sendseven->messages()->sendInteractive(channelId: 'channel_id', contactId: 'contact_id', type: 'type', body: 'body');
```

- Scopes: `messages:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$channelId` | `string` | yes | Channel UUID to send through |
| `$contactId` | `string` | yes | Contact UUID to send to |
| `$type` | `InteractiveType\|string` | yes | Interactive message type: 'buttons', 'list', or 'request_contact_info' |
| `$body` | `string` | yes | Main message body text (max 1024 chars) |
| `$header` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Optional header (text, image, video, or document) |
| `$footer` | `?string` | no | Optional footer text (max 60 chars) |
| `$buttons` | `list<array<string, mixed>>\|null` | no | Buttons for type='buttons' (max 3) |
| `$sections` | `list<array<string, mixed>>\|null` | no | Sections for type='list' (max 10) |
| `$buttonText` | `?string` | no | Text on the list menu button (for type='list') |
| `$meta` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Custom metadata to attach to the message |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `InteractiveMessage`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Messages/send_interactive_message_api_v1_messages_send_interactive_post)

## sendSticker

Send sticker. `POST /messages/send/sticker`

Send a sticker via WhatsApp.

Stickers are static or animated images in .webp format that can be sent to WhatsApp contacts. Currently supported on WhatsApp only.

```php
$result = $sendseven->messages()->sendSticker(channelId: 'channel_id', contactId: 'contact_id');
```

- Scopes: `messages:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

| `$contactId` | `string` | yes | Contact UUID (the recipient) |
| `$stickerId` | `?string` | no | WhatsApp media ID of an uploaded sticker (preferred) |
| `$stickerUrl` | `?string` | no | Direct URL to a .webp sticker file |
| `$meta` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Custom metadata to attach to the message |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `SendSticker`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Messages/send_sticker_api_v1_messages_send_sticker_post)

## removeReaction

Remove reaction from message. `DELETE /messages/{message_id}/react`

Remove a reaction from a message.

Removes your reaction from the specified message on any channel that supports reactions (WhatsApp, Telegram, Messenger, Instagram, Live Chat). This is done by sending an empty emoji reaction.

```php
$result = $sendseven->messages()->removeReaction(messageId: 'message_id');
```

- Scopes: `messages:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$messageId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `Reaction`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Messages/remove_reaction_api_v1_messages__message_id__react_delete)

## addReaction

Add reaction to message. `POST /messages/{message_id}/react`

Add a reaction (emoji) to a message.

Sends a reaction to the specified message on the messaging platform. Supported on every channel whose capability matrix advertises reactions (WhatsApp, Telegram, Messenger, Instagram, Live Chat); see the channel capabilities endpoint for the per-channel reactions block.

```php
$result = $sendseven->messages()->addReaction(messageId: 'message_id', emoji: 'emoji');
```

- Scopes: `messages:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$messageId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$emoji` | `string` | yes | Emoji to react with (e.g., thumbs up, heart) |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `Reaction`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Messages/add_reaction_api_v1_messages__message_id__react_post)

## listConversation

# OAuth2 Apps

`$sendseven->oAuth2Apps()` — 8 endpoints.

| Method | HTTP | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`list()`](#list) | `GET /oauth-apps/apps` | List Apps |

| [`revokeAuthorization()`](#revokeauthorization) | `DELETE /oauth-apps/authorizations/{authorization_id}` | Revoke Authorization |

## create

Create App. `POST /oauth-apps/apps`

Register a new OAuth app for the current tenant.

Returns the client_secret once - it cannot be retrieved again. Store it securely!

```php
$result = $sendseven->oAuth2Apps()->create(name: 'name', redirectUris: [], allowedScopes: []);
```

- Scopes: `api:admin`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$name` | `string` | yes | App display name |
| `$redirectUris` | `list<string>` | yes | Allowed redirect URIs |
| `$allowedScopes` | `list<string>` | yes | Scopes the app can request |
| `$description` | `?string` | no | App description for consent screen |
| `$logoUrl` | `?string` | no | App logo URL |
| `$homepageUrl` | `?string` | no | App homepage URL |
| `$isPublic` | `?bool` | no | Can authorize users outside creator's organization |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `OAuthAppCreateResponse`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/OAuth2%20Apps/create_app_api_v1_oauth_apps_apps_post)

## delete

This revokes all authorizations and removes the app.


- Scopes: `api:admin`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

## regenerateSecret

Regenerate App Secret. `POST /oauth-apps/apps/{app_id}/regenerate-secret`

Regenerate the client secret for an OAuth app.

This immediately invalidates the old secret. The new secret is returned once and cannot be retrieved again.

```php
$result = $sendseven->oAuth2Apps()->regenerateSecret(appId: 'app_id');
```

- Scopes: `api:admin`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$appId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `OAuthAppCreateResponse`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/OAuth2%20Apps/regenerate_app_secret_api_v1_oauth_apps_apps__app_id__regenerate_secret_post)

## listAuthorizations

List Authorizations. `GET /oauth-apps/authorizations`

List user's connected OAuth apps.

Shows apps the user has authorized to access their account.

```php
$result = $sendseven->oAuth2Apps()->listAuthorizations();
```

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$scope` | `?string` | no | Which authorizations to return. 'tenant' (default) limits the list to the currently-active tenant; 'all' returns the user's connected apps across every tenant. |

Returns `list<OAuthAuthorization>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/OAuth2%20Apps/list_authorizations_api_v1_oauth_apps_authorizations_get)

## revokeAuthorization

Revoke Authorization. `DELETE /oauth-apps/authorizations/{authorization_id}`

Revoke access for a connected app.

Immediately invalidates all tokens for this app-user combination.

```php
$result = $sendseven->oAuth2Apps()->revokeAuthorization(authorizationId: 'authorization_id');
```

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$authorizationId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `OAuthDelete`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/OAuth2%20Apps/revoke_authorization_api_v1_oauth_apps_authorizations__authorization_id__delete)

# RCS Wallet

`$sendseven->rcsWallet()` — 2 endpoints.

| Method | HTTP | Summary |

## get

Get the RCS wallet. `GET /billing/rcs-wallet`

The prepaid RCS wallet shared by every workspace on the billing account: balance, reserved amount and top-up settings.

```php
$result = $sendseven->rcsWallet()->get();
```

- Scopes: `billing:read`
- Plan feature: `rcs`
- Not in SendSeven's spec; verified: docs.sendseven.com/guides/billing/rcs-wallet (1 Oct 2026)

Returns `array<array-key, mixed>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/RCS%20Wallet/get_rcs_wallet_api_v1_billing_rcs_wallet_get)

## getPrices

Get your RCS unit prices. `GET /billing/rcs-wallet/prices`

Net EUR prices per RCS unit (basic, single, session, mau), resolved exactly as a real send would be.

```php
$result = $sendseven->rcsWallet()->getPrices();
```

- Scopes: `billing:read`
- Plan feature: `rcs`
- Not in SendSeven's spec; verified: docs.sendseven.com/guides/billing/rcs-wallet (1 Oct 2026)

## createCustom

Create Custom Role. `POST /roles`

Create a custom role with specified scopes.

System roles cannot be created via API. You may only bake scopes you yourself hold into a custom role (privilege-escalation ceiling), and a role carrying account:billing_read may only be created by the billing-account owner.

```php
$result = $sendseven->rolesPermissions()->createCustom(name: 'name');
```

- Scopes: `team:admin`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$name` | `string` | yes | Role name |
| `$description` | `?string` | no | Role description |
| `$scopes` | `list<string>\|null` | no | List of scopes to grant to this role |
| `$icon` | `?string` | no | Lucide icon name (e.g., 'crown', 'shield-check') |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `Role`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Roles%20%26%20Permissions/create_custom_role_api_v1_roles_post)

| [`pricelist()`](#pricelist) | `GET /sms/pricelist` | Full per-country SMS pricelist (platform fee + SendSeven margin) |
| [`listSenders()`](#listsenders) | `GET /sms/senders` | List the tenant's configured SMS senders |
| [`createAlphanumericSender()`](#createalphanumericsender) | `POST /sms/senders/alphanumeric` | Register an alphanumeric SMS sender id (no verification) |
| [`confirmSender()`](#confirmsender) | `POST /sms/senders/confirm` | Confirm DTMF voice PIN and bind Channel |
| [`verifySender()`](#verifysender) | `POST /sms/senders/verify` | Start DTMF voice verification for an own MSISDN |
| [`deleteSender()`](#deletesender) | `DELETE /sms/senders/{channel_id}` | Release a dedicated number or archive an alphanumeric/verified sender |

## listAvailableNumbers

List MSISDNs available to purchase in a country. `GET /sms/available-numbers`

List numbers offered by seven.io for the given country.

Results are cached per-tenant for 5 minutes to keep the pick-a-number picker snappy and to avoid hammering seven.io when a customer pages through options.

```php
$result = $sendseven->sms()->listAvailableNumbers(country: 'country');
```

- Scopes: `channels:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$country` | `string` | yes | ISO-3166 alpha-2 |

Returns `AvailableNumbersList`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/SMS/list_available_numbers_api_v1_sms_available_numbers_get)

## getBalance

Current prepaid SMS balance. `GET /sms/balance`

Return the tenant's current seven.io subaccount balance.

```php
$result = $sendseven->sms()->getBalance();
```

- Scopes: `channels:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$forceRefresh` | `?bool` | no |  |

Returns `Balance`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/SMS/get_balance_api_v1_sms_balance_get)

## updateLowBalanceThreshold

Set the low-balance warning threshold. `PUT /sms/low-balance-threshold`

Set (or clear) the workspace's SMS low-balance warning threshold.

When the prepaid balance drops below this amount the workspace owners and admins receive the low-balance warning (email + in-app, at most once per 24h). This is warn-only — it never triggers a charge (see auto-topup).

```php
$result = $sendseven->sms()->updateLowBalanceThreshold();
```

- Scopes: `channels:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$thresholdEur` | `float\|string\|null` | no | Warning threshold in EUR (0 – 1000, max 2 decimals); null reverts to the platform default. |

Returns `Balance`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/SMS/update_low_balance_threshold_api_v1_sms_low_balance_threshold_put)

## priceMessage

Estimated retail price to send one SMS to a country / number. `GET /sms/message-pricing`

Estimate the tenant's retail per-segment SMS price.

Accepts either a phone (preferred — country resolved by E.164 prefix), a country ISO-2 hint, or both. Pricing is sourced live from seven.io's GET /api/pricing (cached 24h in Redis), with a bundled fallback file used if both Redis and the live API are unreachable.

```php
$result = $sendseven->sms()->priceMessage();
```

- Scopes: `channels:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$phone` | `?string` | no | Recipient MSISDN (E.164) |
| `$country` | `?string` | no | ISO-3166 alpha-2 (e.g. 'DE') — alternative to phone |
| `$text` | `?string` | no | Optional message body. When supplied, response includes segment count + total cost. |
| `$appendOptOutLink` | `?bool` | no | Price the text as a Reach campaign with the SMS opt-out link enabled: a representative ' Unsubscribe: https://c.sendseven.com/<code>' suffix (same length and encoding as the real per-recipient link) is appended before segments, char_count and total are computed. |

Returns `MessagePricing`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/SMS/message_pricing_api_v1_sms_message_pricing_get)

## pricelist

Full per-country SMS pricelist (platform fee + SendSeven margin). `GET /sms/pricelist`

Return the full SMS pricelist as a per-country table.

Used by the frontend pricing page. Pricing is sourced live from seven.io (cached 24h), with a bundled fallback file as last resort. The source field reports which one served this request.

```php
$result = $sendseven->sms()->pricelist();
```

- Scopes: `channels:read`

Returns `SmsPricelist`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/SMS/get_sms_pricelist_api_v1_sms_pricelist_get)

## listSenders

List the tenant's configured SMS senders. `GET /sms/senders`

List every SMS sender configured for the tenant.

The frontend cannot get this from /channels: ChannelResponse deliberately omits Channel.config (it holds API tokens and secrets), so sender_type / mode / msisdn_or_alpha were invisible. This endpoint returns a hand-whitelisted projection of those non-secret facts. seven_io_subaccount_id and every other credential stay server-side.

```php
$result = $sendseven->sms()->listSenders();
```

- Scopes: `channels:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$page` | `?int` | no |  |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no |  |

Returns `Page<SmsSender>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/SMS/list_senders_api_v1_sms_senders_get)

## createAlphanumericSender

Register an alphanumeric SMS sender id (no verification). `POST /sms/senders/alphanumeric`

Register an alphanumeric sender id for outbound campaigns.

Enforces seven.io's 11-character upper bound. Replies are not possible for alphanumeric senders — the frontend copy communicates this.

```php
$result = $sendseven->sms()->createAlphanumericSender(senderId: 'sender_id');
```

- Scopes: `channels:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$senderId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `AlphanumericSender`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/SMS/create_alphanumeric_sender_api_v1_sms_senders_alphanumeric_post)

## confirmSender

Confirm DTMF voice PIN and bind Channel. `POST /sms/senders/confirm`

Compare the PIN supplied by the customer to the one seven.io read aloud.

On success we flip the verification row to VERIFIED and create the SMS :class:Channel. On mismatch we flip to FAILED and 400.

```php
$result = $sendseven->sms()->confirmSender(verificationId: 'verification_id', code: 'code');
```

- Scopes: `channels:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$verificationId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$code` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `SenderConfirm`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/SMS/confirm_sender_api_v1_sms_senders_confirm_post)

## verifySender

Start DTMF voice verification for an own MSISDN. `POST /sms/senders/verify`

Kick off seven.io's DTMF voice verification.

seven.io places an outbound call that reads a PIN aloud; the customer repeats it back to our UI which POSTs it to :func:confirm_sender below.

```php
$result = $sendseven->sms()->verifySender(msisdn: 'msisdn');
```

- Scopes: `channels:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$msisdn` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$callbackUrl` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `SenderVerify`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/SMS/verify_sender_api_v1_sms_senders_verify_post)

## deleteSender

Release a dedicated number or archive an alphanumeric/verified sender. `DELETE /sms/senders/{channel_id}`

Delete / release an SMS sender.

For dedicated senders this calls :meth:SmsProvisioningService.release_number (which talks to seven.io). For alphanumeric / verified_own senders we only archive the :class:Channel row — no seven.io resource to release.

```php
$result = $sendseven->sms()->deleteSender(channelId: 'channel_id');
```

- Scopes: `channels:delete`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$channelId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$immediate` | `?bool` | no | If true, release seven.io number immediately |

Returns `DeleteSender`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/SMS/delete_sender_api_v1_sms_senders__channel_id__delete)

## create

Create Saved Interactive Message. `POST /saved-interactive-messages`

Create a new saved interactive message template.

By default, messages are shared (visible to all team members). Set is_shared=false to make it personal. Only users with canned_responses:settings scope can create shared messages.

```php
$result = $sendseven->savedInteractiveMessages()->create(title: 'title', interactiveType: 'interactive_type', body: 'body');
```

- Scopes: `messages:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$title` | `string` | yes | Display name for the template |
| `$interactiveType` | `string` | yes | Interactive message type: 'buttons' or 'list' |
| `$body` | `string` | yes | Main message body text (max 1024 chars) |
| `$shortcut` | `?string` | no | Optional shortcut for slash commands (e.g., 'pricing'). Stored lowercase without leading slash. |
| `$category` | `?string` | no | Category for grouping (e.g., 'Sales', 'Support') |
| `$headerText` | `?string` | no | Optional header text (max 60 chars). Used when header_type is 'text' or omitted. |
| `$headerType` | `?string` | no | Header type: 'text', 'image', 'video', 'document', or null (no header). For backward compatibility, if header_text is set but header_type is null, it is treated as 'text'. |
| `$headerMediaUrl` | `?string` | no | URL for image/video/document header media. Required when header_type is 'image', 'video' or 'document' (unless header_attachment_id is provided). |
| `$headerAttachmentId` | `?string` | no | Attachment ID for uploaded media header. Alternative to header_media_url for image/video/document headers. |
| `$footerText` | `?string` | no | Optional footer text (max 60 chars) |
| `$buttons` | `list<array<string, mixed>>\|null` | no | Buttons for type='buttons' (max 3) |
| `$sections` | `list<array<string, mixed>>\|null` | no | Sections for type='list' (max 10) |
| `$buttonText` | `?string` | no | Menu button text for list type (e.g., 'View Options') |
| `$isShared` | `?bool` | no | If true, visible to all team members |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `SavedInteractiveMessage`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Saved%20Interactive%20Messages/create_saved_interactive_message_api_v1_saved_interactive_messages_post)

```php
$result = $sendseven->scheduler()->listScheduledSendsForContact(contactId: 'contact_id');
```

## createScheduledRule

Create Scheduled Rule. `POST /scheduler/rules`

Create a scheduled rule.

Three rule kinds are supported:

```php
$result = $sendseven->scheduler()->createScheduledRule(name: 'name', kind: 'kind', channelType: 'channel_type', payload: []);
```

- Scopes: `scheduler:write`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$name` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$kind` | `ScheduledRuleKind\|string` | yes | birthday \| recurring_cron \| segment_blast |
| `$channelType` | `ChannelType\|string` | yes |  |
| `$payload` | `array<string, mixed>` | yes | Free-form JSON payload. Same per-channel rules as scheduled_sends.payload: WhatsApp REQUIRES {template_id, variables}; email accepts EITHER free-text ({subject, text\|html}) OR templated ({template_id, variables?}) — mutually exclusive; SMS/Telegram/Messenger/Instagram/RCS must NOT carry template_id but MAY carry attachments (a list of ≤20 attachment UUIDs owned by your workspace). Hard-capped at 64 KB. |
| `$description` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$channelId` | `?string` | no | Pinned channel UUID — REQUIRED for chat-app channel types (whatsapp, telegram, sms, messenger, instagram, rcs). The channel IS the sender for these. Must be NULL for channel_type=email (use email_mailbox_id instead). |
| `$emailMailboxId` | `?string` | no | Pinned EmailMailbox UUID — REQUIRED for channel_type=email. The mailbox is the sender (controls the From: address). Must be NULL for chat-app channel types. |
| `$timeOfDayLocal` | `?string` | no | Local clock time as "HH:MM" or "HH:MM:SS". Required for birthday rules. Optional for recurring_cron (the RRULE controls timing). Ignored for segment_blast. |
| `$timezone` | `?string` | no | IANA tz name (e.g. Europe/Berlin). NULL semantics: birthday → contact-local TZ, recurring_cron/segment_blast → UTC. |
| `$recurrenceRule` | `?string` | no | iCalendar RRULE string. Required for recurring_cron; must be NULL for birthday and segment_blast. |
| `$segmentFilter` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Audience selector. Two accepted shapes: * NEW: {"match_op": "any"\|"all", "rules": [{"kind": "tag"\|"list"\|"language", "op": ..., "values": [...]}]} * LEGACY: {"tags": [...], "tags_op": "any"\|"all"} (normalized by the engine). NULL for birthday (audience is implicit). |
| `$nextEvaluationAt` | `DateTimeInterface\|string\|null` | no | For segment_blast: the dispatch time. For other kinds the evaluator manages this cursor — leaving it NULL is fine. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `ScheduledRule`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Scheduler/create_scheduled_rule_api_v1_scheduler_rules_post)

## deleteScheduledRule

Delete Scheduled Rule. `DELETE /scheduler/rules/{rule_id}`

Soft-delete a scheduled rule (sets status to archived and clears next_evaluation_at). The row is preserved for audit + so already- materialized ScheduledSend rows keep a valid rule_id reference.

Idempotent.

```php
$sendseven->scheduler()->deleteScheduledRule(ruleId: 'rule_id');
```

- Scopes: `scheduler:write`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$ruleId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `void`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Scheduler/delete_scheduled_rule_api_v1_scheduler_rules__rule_id__delete)

- Scopes: `scheduler:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$ruleId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `ScheduledRule`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Scheduler/get_scheduled_rule_api_v1_scheduler_rules__rule_id__get)

## updateScheduledRule

Update Scheduled Rule. `PATCH /scheduler/rules/{rule_id}`

Update a scheduled rule.

Mutates only fields present in the body. status may only be set to active or paused — use DELETE to archive. Pass an empty string for recurrence_rule to clear it (turn a recurring rule into a one-shot via next_evaluation_at).

```php
$result = $sendseven->scheduler()->updateScheduledRule(ruleId: 'rule_id');
```

- Scopes: `scheduler:write`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$ruleId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$name` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$description` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$channelType` | `ChannelType\|string\|null` | no |  |
| `$channelId` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$emailMailboxId` | `?string` | no | New pinned EmailMailbox UUID. Only valid when the rule's channel_type is (or is being changed to) email. |
| `$payload` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no |  |
| `$timeOfDayLocal` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$timezone` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$recurrenceRule` | `?string` | no | Pass an empty string to clear the rule. Capped at 255 chars. |
| `$segmentFilter` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Audience selector. Two accepted shapes: * NEW: {"match_op": "any"\|"all", "rules": [{"kind": "tag"\|"list"\|"language", "op": ..., "values": [...]}]} * LEGACY: {"tags": [...], "tags_op": "any"\|"all"} (normalized by the engine). |
| `$nextEvaluationAt` | `DateTimeInterface\|string\|null` | no |  |
| `$status` | `ScheduledRuleStatus\|string\|null` | no | Only active <-> paused transitions allowed via PATCH. DELETE the rule to archive it. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `ScheduledRule`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Scheduler/update_scheduled_rule_api_v1_scheduler_rules__rule_id__patch)

## createScheduledSend

Create Scheduled Send. `POST /scheduler/sends`

Create a scheduled send.

The send fires once at send_at (UTC) and transitions to completed, unless recurrence_rule is set — in which case the row stays in scheduled and next_run_at advances per the rule.

```php
$result = $sendseven->scheduler()->createScheduledSend(contactId: 'contact_id', channelType: 'channel_type', payload: [], sendAt: 'send_at');
```

- Scopes: `scheduler:write`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$contactId` | `string` | yes | Contact UUID on the tenant's shard |
| `$channelType` | `ChannelType\|string` | yes | Canonical ChannelType (whatsapp, telegram, sms, email, ...) |
| `$payload` | `array<string, mixed>` | yes | Free-form JSON payload. Per-channel rules: - WhatsApp: REQUIRES {template_id, variables} — free text is rejected because the 24h messaging window cannot be guaranteed at schedule time. - Email: EITHER {subject, text\|html, include_signature?} (free-text) OR {template_id, variables?} (references an EmailContent template). Mutually exclusive. - SMS / Telegram / Messenger / Instagram / RCS: rendered text payload (e.g. {"text": "..."}), optionally with attachments — a list of attachment UUIDs (uploaded via POST /attachments/upload) fanned out as one message per attachment at fire time. Max 20. Every id must belong to your workspace. Hard-capped at 64 KB JSON-encoded. |
| `$sendAt` | `DateTimeInterface\|string` | yes | First-fire timestamp (timezone-aware UTC). Must be at least 1 minute in the future. |
| `$channelId` | `?string` | no | Pinned channel UUID — REQUIRED for chat-app channel types (whatsapp, telegram, sms, messenger, instagram, rcs). Each chat-app channel IS the sender (for RCS: the RBM agent). Leave NULL only for channel_type=email (use email_mailbox_id instead). |
| `$emailMailboxId` | `?string` | no | Pinned EmailMailbox UUID — REQUIRED for channel_type=email. The mailbox is the sender (controls the From: address and the underlying provider/integration). Must be NULL for chat-app channel types (use channel_id instead). |
| `$recurrenceRule` | `?string` | no | Optional iCalendar RRULE (e.g. FREQ=DAILY;BYHOUR=9). When set, the row stays in scheduled after firing and next_run_at advances per the rule. Capped at 255 chars. |
| `$timezone` | `?string` | no | IANA timezone for recurrence interpretation (e.g. Europe/Berlin). Defaults to UTC. Currently informational; recurrence math runs in UTC so this is preserved for display only. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `ScheduledSend`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Scheduler/create_scheduled_send_api_v1_scheduler_sends_post)

## cancelScheduledSend

Cancel Scheduled Send. `DELETE /scheduler/sends/{send_id}`

Cancel a scheduled send (soft-cancel — sets status to canceled).

Idempotent: cancelling an already-cancelled / completed / failed send returns the same shape rather than 404. The row is preserved for audit.

```php
$sendseven->scheduler()->cancelScheduledSend(sendId: 'send_id');
```

- Scopes: `scheduler:write`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$sendId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `void`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Scheduler/cancel_scheduled_send_api_v1_scheduler_sends__send_id__delete)

## getScheduledSend

Get Scheduled Send. `GET /scheduler/sends/{send_id}`

```php
$result = $sendseven->scheduler()->getScheduledSend(sendId: 'send_id');
```

- Scopes: `scheduler:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$sendId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `ScheduledSend`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Scheduler/get_scheduled_send_api_v1_scheduler_sends__send_id__get)

## updateScheduledSend

Update Scheduled Send. `PATCH /scheduler/sends/{send_id}`

Update a scheduled send.

Editable fields: payload, send_at, recurrence_rule. Pass an empty string for recurrence_rule to clear it. Only allowed while the send is in status scheduled — returns 409 for any other state.

```php
$result = $sendseven->scheduler()->updateScheduledSend(sendId: 'send_id');
```

- Scopes: `scheduler:write`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$sendId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$payload` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Replaces the entire payload dict. Hard-capped at 64 KB JSON-encoded. Per-channel rules are re-checked against the existing row's channel_type: WhatsApp must carry {template_id, variables}; SMS/Telegram/Messenger/Instagram/RCS must NOT carry template_id (but may carry attachments — ≤20 attachment UUIDs owned by your workspace); email must carry a valid subject + body or template_id. |
| `$emailMailboxId` | `?string` | no | New pinned EmailMailbox UUID. Only valid when the underlying scheduled send has channel_type=email. Pass an empty string to clear. |
| `$sendAt` | `DateTimeInterface\|string\|null` | no | New first-fire timestamp. next_run_at is updated to match. |
| `$recurrenceRule` | `?string` | no | New iCalendar RRULE. Pass an empty string to clear the rule (turn a recurring send into a one-off). Capped at 255 chars. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `ScheduledSend`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Scheduler/update_scheduled_send_api_v1_scheduler_sends__send_id__patch)

# Social Posts

`$sendseven->socialPosts()` — 8 endpoints.

| Method | HTTP | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`list()`](#list) | `GET /social-posts` | List authored social posts |
| [`create()`](#create) | `POST /social-posts` | Create, schedule or publish a social post |
| [`getCapabilities()`](#getcapabilities) | `GET /social-posts/capabilities/publish` | Which channels can publish posts, and which formats |
| [`getAccountInsights()`](#getaccountinsights) | `GET /social-posts/insights/account` | Live account / page insights for one connected channel |
| [`get()`](#get) | `GET /social-posts/{post_id}` | Get one authored social post |
| [`update()`](#update) | `PATCH /social-posts/{post_id}` | Edit or cancel a draft / scheduled post |
| [`getInsights()`](#getinsights) | `GET /social-posts/{post_id}/insights` | Cached insights for one authored post's published targets |
| [`refreshInsights()`](#refreshinsights) | `POST /social-posts/{post_id}/insights/refresh` | Force-refresh cached insights for one authored post's targets |

## list

List authored social posts. `GET /social-posts`

List authored posts for this workspace, newest first, with each post's per-target status. Filter by status, and/or by a scheduled_at calendar window with scheduled_from / scheduled_to (ISO 8601, UTC, both inclusive) — the two combine. scheduled_from after scheduled_to is a 400.

```php
$result = $sendseven->socialPosts()->list();
```

- Scopes: `campaigns:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$status` | `?string` | no | Filter by post status: draft, scheduled, publishing, published, partially_failed, failed, cancelled. |
| `$scheduledFrom` | `DateTimeInterface\|string\|null` | no | Calendar lower bound (ISO 8601, UTC, inclusive). Only posts whose scheduled_at is at or after this instant are returned. Combinable with status and scheduled_to. |
| `$scheduledTo` | `DateTimeInterface\|string\|null` | no | Calendar upper bound (ISO 8601, UTC, inclusive). Only posts whose scheduled_at is at or before this instant are returned. |
| `$page` | `?int` | no | Page number (1-indexed). |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no | Items per page. |

Returns `Page<ScheduledPost>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Social%20Posts/list_social_posts_api_v1_social_posts_get)

## create

Create, schedule or publish a social post. `POST /social-posts`

Author a post and publish it to one or more Instagram / Facebook Page channels. Each channel becomes a target that succeeds or fails independently.

Three modes:

```php
$result = $sendseven->socialPosts()->create(channelIds: [], format: 'format');
```

- Scopes: `campaigns:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$channelIds` | `list<string>` | yes | The Instagram / Facebook Messenger (Page) channels to publish to. Each becomes one target that succeeds or fails independently. Every id must be an active, non-archived channel of a publish-capable type in this workspace. |
| `$format` | `string` | yes | text, image, video or reel. Per-platform: reel is Instagram-only, text is Facebook-only, and Instagram always requires media. Unsupported combinations are rejected against the capability matrix before any Meta call. |
| `$caption` | `?string` | no | Post caption (Instagram/Facebook limit 2200 characters). |
| `$firstComment` | `?string` | no | Optional self-authored first comment. Posted as a top-level comment on the post from the SAME account immediately after it publishes (IG media / FB post). Best-effort: a comment failure never fails the post. NULL/empty means no first comment. |
| `$mediaAttachmentIds` | `list<string>\|null` | no | Ordered list of attachment UUIDs (upload via POST /api/v1/attachments/* first). Required for every non-text format; NULL/empty for text. At most 10. Slide order is preserved. Every id must belong to this workspace. |
| `$scheduledAt` | `DateTimeInterface\|string\|null` | no | When to publish (UTC, must be in the future). Omit and set publish_now to publish immediately; omit both to save a draft. |
| `$publishNow` | `?bool` | no | Publish immediately and return the publish result. Mutually exclusive with scheduled_at. |
| `$isAiGenerated` | `?bool` | no | Mark the post as AI-generated (EU AI Act transparency). When true, the AI-content flag is passed through to Meta on publish — set on the Instagram container and, best-effort, on the Facebook feed / photo / video payload. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `ScheduledPost`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Social%20Posts/create_social_post_api_v1_social_posts_post)

## getCapabilities

Which channels can publish posts, and which formats. `GET /social-posts/capabilities/publish`

Report, for every Instagram / Facebook Page channel in this workspace, whether it can publish authored posts and which formats it supports (text, image, video, reel). Fail-closed: unknown channel types report can_publish: false.

beta_enabled reports the tenant's social_comments_beta enrolment separately.

```php
$result = $sendseven->socialPosts()->getCapabilities();
```

- Scopes: `channels:read`

Returns `PostCapabilities`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Social%20Posts/get_post_capabilities_api_v1_social_posts_capabilities_publish_get)

## getAccountInsights

Live account / page insights for one connected channel. `GET /social-posts/insights/account`

Fetch account-level (Instagram) or page-level (Facebook) insights LIVE for one connected channel. Nothing is stored — this proxies Meta's /insights on each call. If the page was connected before insights access was granted, the response is authorized: false with error_code: insights_not_authorized (a 200, not a 500) so the UI can prompt a reconnect.

```php
$result = $sendseven->socialPosts()->getAccountInsights(channelId: 'channel_id');
```

- Scopes: `campaigns:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$channelId` | `string` | yes | The IG / FB Page channel to read. |

Returns `AccountInsights`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Social%20Posts/get_account_insights_api_v1_social_posts_insights_account_get)

## get

Get one authored social post. `GET /social-posts/{post_id}`

Get one authored post with its per-target status.

```php
$result = $sendseven->socialPosts()->get(postId: 'post_id');
```

- Scopes: `campaigns:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$postId` | `string` | yes | The authored post id. |

Returns `ScheduledPost`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Social%20Posts/get_social_post_api_v1_social_posts__post_id__get)

## update

Edit or cancel a draft / scheduled post. `PATCH /social-posts/{post_id}`

Edit a draft or scheduled post (caption / media / scheduled_at / channel_ids), or cancel it with cancel: true.

* Editing is allowed only while the post is draft or scheduled. * Changing media_attachment_ids re-validates ownership and re-bumps retention. * Changing channel_ids reconciles targets: removed channels are dropped, added channels get a new pending target. * cancel: true moves the post to cancelled; rejected once it is publishing or published. Cannot be combined with edit fields.

```php
$result = $sendseven->socialPosts()->update(postId: 'post_id');
```

- Scopes: `campaigns:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$postId` | `string` | yes | The authored post id. |
| `$caption` | `?string` | no | Replacement caption (draft/scheduled only). |
| `$firstComment` | `?string` | no | Replacement self-authored first comment (draft/scheduled only). Send "" to clear it. |
| `$mediaAttachmentIds` | `list<string>\|null` | no | Replacement ordered media list (draft/scheduled only). Re-validated for ownership and re-bumps retention. Send [] to clear media. |
| `$scheduledAt` | `DateTimeInterface\|string\|null` | no | Reschedule (UTC, future). Draft/scheduled only. Setting this on a draft moves it to scheduled. |
| `$channelIds` | `list<string>\|null` | no | Replacement target channel list (draft/scheduled only). Targets are reconciled: removed channels are dropped, added channels get a new pending target. |
| `$isAiGenerated` | `?bool` | no | Toggle the AI-generated flag (draft/scheduled only). When set, it is passed through to Meta on publish (EU AI Act transparency). |
| `$cancel` | `?bool` | no | Cancel the post (status → cancelled). Cannot be combined with edit fields. Rejected once the post is publishing or published. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `ScheduledPost`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Social%20Posts/update_social_post_api_v1_social_posts__post_id__patch)

## getInsights

Cached insights for one authored post's published targets. `GET /social-posts/{post_id}/insights`

Return insights for every PUBLISHED target of one authored post, served from a per-target cache. Each target carries its own last_refreshed_at; the top-level last_refreshed_at is the OLDEST of those (the staleness of the stalest number).

Numbers are NOT re-fetched on every load. A target that has never been cached (last_refreshed_at: null) is populated LIVE once, on this first read, and persisted so the next load is served from cache. Use POST /{post_id}/insights/refresh to force a fresh read of all targets.

```php
$result = $sendseven->socialPosts()->getInsights(postId: 'post_id');
```

- Scopes: `campaigns:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$postId` | `string` | yes | The authored post id. |

Returns `PostInsights`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Social%20Posts/get_post_insights_api_v1_social_posts__post_id__insights_get)

## refreshInsights

Force-refresh cached insights for one authored post's targets. `POST /social-posts/{post_id}/insights/refresh`

Force a LIVE re-fetch of Meta insights for every PUBLISHED target of one authored post, UPSERT the per-target cache, and return the freshly-cached PostInsightsResponse. Every readable target's last_refreshed_at is stamped to now; the top-level last_refreshed_at is the oldest of the returned targets.

Degrade behavior matches GET /{post_id}/insights (unauthorized page → insights_not_authorized, deleted channel → insights_unavailable, and the degraded state is persisted too). A target that never published is omitted.

```php
$result = $sendseven->socialPosts()->refreshInsights(postId: 'post_id');
```

- Scopes: `campaigns:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$postId` | `string` | yes | The authored post id. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `PostInsights`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Social%20Posts/refresh_post_insights_api_v1_social_posts__post_id__insights_refresh_post)

# Tenant Email Settings

`$sendseven->tenantEmailSettings()` — 3 endpoints.

| Method | HTTP | Summary |

## get

Get Email Settings. `GET /tenant-email-settings`

Get tenant email settings.

Returns the tenant's email configuration including campaign defaults, support defaults, and settings. Creates default settings if none exist.

```php
$result = $sendseven->tenantEmailSettings()->get();
```

- Scopes: `email_integrations:read`

Returns `TenantEmailSettingsResponse`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Tenant%20Email%20Settings/get_email_settings_api_v1_tenant_email_settings_get)

## update

Update Email Settings. `PUT /tenant-email-settings`

Update tenant email settings.

Partial update - only provided fields are changed. Validates from_email fields against sendable domains if provided.

```php
$result = $sendseven->tenantEmailSettings()->update();
```

- Scopes: `email_integrations:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$campaignFromEmail` | `?string` | no | Default from email for campaigns |
| `$campaignFromName` | `?string` | no | Default from name for campaigns |
| `$campaignReplyTo` | `?string` | no | Default reply-to for campaigns |
| `$supportFromEmail` | `?string` | no | Default from email for support |
| `$supportFromName` | `?string` | no | Default from name for support |
| `$supportIntegrationId` | `?string` | no | Preferred email integration ID for support |
| `$campaignDefaultMailboxId` | `?string` | no | Default mailbox ID for campaigns |
| `$supportDefaultMailboxId` | `?string` | no | Default mailbox ID for support |
| `$doiMailboxId` | `?string` | no | Mailbox ID for double opt-in confirmation emails |
| `$allowCustomSender` | `?bool` | no | Allow agents to use custom sender addresses |
| `$doubleOptInEnabled` | `?bool` | no | Enable double opt-in for subscriptions |
| `$doubleOptInTemplateId` | `?string` | no | Template ID for double opt-in confirmation |
| `$complianceFooterHtml` | `?string` | no | HTML compliance footer appended to emails |
| `$trackOpensDefault` | `?bool` | no | Default OPEN tracking for new campaigns |
| `$trackClicksDefault` | `?bool` | no | Default CLICK tracking for new campaigns |

Returns `TenantEmailSettingsResponse`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Tenant%20Email%20Settings/update_email_settings_api_v1_tenant_email_settings_put)

## getSendableDomains

Get Sendable Domains. `GET /tenant-email-settings/sendable-domains`

List verified domains and addresses the tenant can send email from.

Aggregates sendable domains from all email integrations and provider configs: - SendGrid/SendGrid Managed/Mailgun BYOK providers with verified domains - SES managed integrations with verified domains - Gmail OAuth integrations (fixed address, support-only) - SMTP/IMAP integrations (fixed address, support-only)

```php
$result = $sendseven->tenantEmailSettings()->getSendableDomains();
```

- Scopes: `email_integrations:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$purpose` | `?string` | no | Filter by intended use: 'campaign' returns only campaign-capable sources (SendGrid, Mailgun, SES); 'support' returns all sources; omit for all sources (default). |

Returns `SendableDomains`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Tenant%20Email%20Settings/get_sendable_domains_api_v1_tenant_email_settings_sendable_domains_get)

## features


## mine

Get My Tenants. `GET /tenants/me`

Get current user's tenants

```php
$result = $sendseven->tenants()->mine();
```

Returns `list<Tenant>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Tenants/get_my_tenants_api_v1_tenants_me_get)

## retention

Get My Retention. `GET /tenants/me/retention`

Get the current data retention policy and value for the caller's tenant.

Returns the stored message_retention_days (0 = unlimited), the allowed range (floor/ceiling), whether the plan is API-only (fixed at 90), and the effective_days the nightly purge worker enforces.

```php
$result = $sendseven->tenants()->retention();
```

- Scopes: `settings:read`

Returns `RetentionPolicy`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Tenants/get_my_retention_api_v1_tenants_me_retention_get)

## updateRetention

Update My Retention. `PUT /tenants/me/retention`

Set the data retention period (in days) for the caller's tenant.

Validated against the plan policy. The plan's data_retention_days is the ceiling and 90 days is the global floor: plans capped at 90 are fixed (not configurable); plans with a finite cap > 90 accept any value in [90, cap]; unlimited-cap plans accept 0 (unlimited) or any value >= 90. Returns HTTP 400 with a clear message if the value is out of bounds.

```php
$result = $sendseven->tenants()->updateRetention(messageRetentionDays: 1);
```

- Scopes: `settings:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$messageRetentionDays` | `int` | yes |  |

Returns `RetentionPolicy`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Tenants/update_my_retention_api_v1_tenants_me_retention_put)

## delete

Delete Tenant. `DELETE /tenants/{tenant_id}`

Deactivate a tenant (requires team:delete scope - OWNER only).

Deactivation also releases the tenant's channels: every channel is archived, and WhatsApp numbers / Facebook Pages are unsubscribed and deregistered on Meta where applicable, so they can be connected again in another tenant.

```php
$sendseven->tenants()->delete(tenantId: 'tenant_id');
```

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$tenantId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `void`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Tenants/delete_tenant_api_v1_tenants__tenant_id__delete)

## update

Update Tenant. `PUT /tenants/{tenant_id}`

Update tenant information (requires settings:update scope).

The tenant is resolved from the X-Tenant-ID header and the caller's membership + scope are enforced by require_scope, mirroring the sibling settings PUTs (features / channel-priority / dashboard-settings). The {tenant_id} path segment is kept for URL compatibility but is shadowed by the header-resolved value.

```php
$result = $sendseven->tenants()->update(tenantId: 'tenant_id');
```

- Scopes: `settings:update`

## getChannelPriority

Get Channel Priority. `GET /tenants/{tenant_id}/channel-priority`

Get channel priority for a tenant.

Channel priority is used to resolve conflicts when a contact has multiple channels available (e.g., both WhatsApp and Telegram). The priority list determines which channel to use for sending campaigns.

```php
$result = $sendseven->tenants()->getChannelPriority(tenantId: 'tenant_id');
```

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$tenantId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `array<array-key, mixed>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Tenants/get_channel_priority_api_v1_tenants__tenant_id__channel_priority_get)

## updateChannelPriority

Update Channel Priority. `PUT /tenants/{tenant_id}/channel-priority`

Update channel priority for a tenant (requires settings:update scope).

Channel priority determines which channel to use when a contact has multiple channels available. For example, if set to ["whatsapp", "telegram", "sms"], campaigns will prefer WhatsApp, then Telegram, then SMS for contacts with multiple channels.

```php
$result = $sendseven->tenants()->updateChannelPriority(tenantId: 'tenant_id', channelPriority: []);
```

- Scopes: `settings:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$tenantId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$channelPriority` | `list<string>` | yes |  |

Returns `array<array-key, mixed>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Tenants/update_channel_priority_api_v1_tenants__tenant_id__channel_priority_put)

## leave

Leave Tenant. `POST /tenants/{tenant_id}/leave`

Leave a tenant the user is currently a member of.

Self-service equivalent of DELETE /users/{user_id} — no special scope required because the user is acting on themselves.


| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |

# User Inbox Access

`$sendseven->userInboxAccess()` — 2 endpoints.

| Method | HTTP | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`get()`](#get) | `GET /users/{user_id}/inbox-access` | Get per-user inbox access settings |
| [`update()`](#update) | `PUT /users/{user_id}/inbox-access` | Update per-user inbox access settings |

## get

Get per-user inbox access settings. `GET /users/{user_id}/inbox-access`

Get the target user's inbox-access mode + the inboxes they're listed in.

Returns 200 with {mode: 'all', inbox_ids: []} for a freshly-added team member who has no overrides — mode defaults to 'all' (PRIMARY server_default) and the SHARD grant list starts empty.

```php
$result = $sendseven->userInboxAccess()->get(userId: 'user_id');
```

- Scopes: `team:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$userId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `UserInboxAccessResponse`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/User%20Inbox%20Access/get_user_inbox_access_api_v1_users__user_id__inbox_access_get)

## update

Update per-user inbox access settings. `PUT /users/{user_id}/inbox-access`

Update the user's mode + replace their per-inbox grants.

Behaviour: - Validates target user is a member of this tenant (404 otherwise — using 404 over 403 to avoid an existence oracle). - Validates every inbox_ids element belongs to this tenant (422 otherwise). - Updates tenant_users.inbox_access_mode on PRIMARY. - Reconciles the user's rows in custom_inbox_users on SHARD to the target set (delete grants no longer wanted, insert only missing ones).

```php
$result = $sendseven->userInboxAccess()->update(userId: 'user_id', mode: 'mode');
```

- Scopes: `team:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$userId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$mode` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$inboxIds` | `list<string>\|null` | no |  |
| `$contactHistoryVisibility` | `?string` | no |  |

Returns `UserInboxAccessResponse`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/User%20Inbox%20Access/update_user_inbox_access_api_v1_users__user_id__inbox_access_put)

## listTeamMembers

List Team Members. `GET /users`

List all users in the tenant with their RBAC roles.

Returns a paginated list of team members with their roles and permissions. Each member also carries account-wide-usage access flags for the /settings/team access toggle: is_billing_account_owner (owner always has usage access → render the toggle checked+disabled) and account_billing_read_granted (whether the member holds a direct account:billing_read grant → checkbox state for non-owners). Both default False and are fail-closed.

```php
$result = $sendseven->users()->listTeamMembers();
```

- Scopes: `team:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$page` | `?int` | no | Page number (1-indexed) |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no | Items per page |

Returns `Page<TenantUser>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Users/list_team_members_api_v1_users_get)

## invite

Invite User. `POST /users/invite`

Invite a user to join the tenant.

Creates a user record with pending Auth0 ID. The user can then log in via Auth0 using the invited email address.

```php
$result = $sendseven->users()->invite(email: 'email', name: 'name');
```

- Scopes: `team:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$email` | `string` | yes | Email address to invite |
| `$name` | `string` | yes | User's display name |
| `$roleId` | `?string` | no | RBAC role UUID to assign (system OR this tenant's custom role). Get valid ids from GET /roles. Preferred over the legacy role field. |
| `$role` | `UserRole\|string\|null` | no | DEPRECATED legacy role enum. Ignored when role_id is set. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `UserInvite`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Users/invite_user_api_v1_users_invite_post)

## deleteMyAccount

Delete my account. `DELETE /users/me`

Permanently delete the authenticated user's own account.

This is irreversible. It removes the login identity (you will be signed out everywhere and cannot sign in again), the profile (name, avatar, phone, preferences), API sessions and OAuth grants, and detaches the user from every workspace they are a member of. Workspaces, billing accounts, conversations and contacts belong to the organisation and are not deleted — only the person's membership is removed.

```php
$sendseven->users()->deleteMyAccount();
```

Returns `void`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Users/delete_my_account_api_v1_users_me_delete)

## getCurrentProfile

Get Current User Profile. `GET /users/me`

Get current user's profile with optional tenant context.

If X-Tenant-ID header is provided, includes: - User's role in that tenant - Tenant's multi_agent_mode setting

```php
$result = $sendseven->users()->getCurrentProfile();
```

Returns `CurrentUser`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Users/get_current_user_profile_api_v1_users_me_get)

## updateCurrent

Update Current User. `PATCH /users/me`

Update current user's profile (alias for /users/me/profile).

This endpoint accepts the same request body as /users/me/profile. Both endpoints are equivalent and provided for API convenience.

```php
$result = $sendseven->users()->updateCurrent();
```

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$displayName` | `?string` | no | User-editable display name |
| `$chatNickname` | `?string` | no | Chat display nickname |
| `$liveChatAvailable` | `?bool` | no | Available for live chat assignment |
| `$personalPhone` | `?string` | no | Personal phone for receiving notifications (user-global) |
| `$preferredLanguage` | `?string` | no | Preferred UI language code (e.g., en, de, fr) |
| `$preferredTranslationLanguage` | `?string` | no | Preferred language for chat translations (e.g., en, de, fr, es) |
| `$autoTranslateEnabled` | `?bool` | no | Enable automatic translation of incoming messages (user-global). Omit or null to leave unchanged. |
| `$shoutboxHidden` | `?bool` | no | Hide/deactivate the team-chat Shoutbox widget across all devices (user-global). Omit or null to leave unchanged. |
| `$spokenLanguages` | `?string` | no | Comma-separated ISO 639-1 codes the user speaks (e.g., 'de,en'). Empty string clears the value; omit or null to leave unchanged. |
| `$phone` | `?string` | no | Agent's phone number for email signatures (per-tenant) |
| `$title` | `?string` | no | Agent's job title for email signatures (per-tenant) |
| `$emailAutoSignatureEnabled` | `?bool` | no | Master toggle for auto-inserting your signature into the composer (per-tenant) |
| `$emailAutoSignatureOnReplies` | `?bool` | no | Auto-insert your signature when opening a reply composer (per-tenant) |
| `$emailAutoSignatureOnNew` | `?bool` | no | Auto-insert your signature when opening a new-email composer (per-tenant) |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `CurrentUser`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Users/update_current_user_api_v1_users_me_patch)

## updateCurrentProfile

Update Current User Profile. `PATCH /users/me/profile`

Update current user's profile.

Updatable fields: - display_name: User-editable name (takes precedence over Auth0 name in UI) - chat_nickname: Display name in chat - live_chat_available: Availability for live chat assignment - personal_phone: Personal phone for receiving SMS/WhatsApp notifications (user-global) - preferred_language: UI language code (en, de, fr, es, pt, it, ru, hr, tr, ar) - auto_translate_enabled: Enable automatic translation of incoming messages (user-global) - shoutbox_hidden: Hide/deactivate the team-chat Shoutbox widget across all devices (user-global) - spoken_languages: Comma-separated ISO 639-1 codes the user speaks, e.g. "de,en" (user-global; empty string clears) - phone: Agent's phone number for email signatures (per-tenant, requires X-Tenant-ID header) - title: Agent's job title for email signatures (per-tenant, requires X-Tenant-ID header)

```php
$result = $sendseven->users()->updateCurrentProfile();
```

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$displayName` | `?string` | no | User-editable display name |
| `$chatNickname` | `?string` | no | Chat display nickname |

| `$preferredTranslationLanguage` | `?string` | no | Preferred language for chat translations (e.g., en, de, fr, es) |
| `$autoTranslateEnabled` | `?bool` | no | Enable automatic translation of incoming messages (user-global). Omit or null to leave unchanged. |
| `$shoutboxHidden` | `?bool` | no | Hide/deactivate the team-chat Shoutbox widget across all devices (user-global). Omit or null to leave unchanged. |
| `$spokenLanguages` | `?string` | no | Comma-separated ISO 639-1 codes the user speaks (e.g., 'de,en'). Empty string clears the value; omit or null to leave unchanged. |
| `$phone` | `?string` | no | Agent's phone number for email signatures (per-tenant) |
| `$title` | `?string` | no | Agent's job title for email signatures (per-tenant) |
| `$emailAutoSignatureEnabled` | `?bool` | no | Master toggle for auto-inserting your signature into the composer (per-tenant) |

## setAccountBillingAccess

Set Account Billing Access. `PUT /users/{user_id}/account-billing-access`

Grant or revoke account-wide usage access for a team member.

Idempotently grants (enabled=true) or revokes (enabled=false) a DIRECT account:billing_read scope on the target user within the current workspace. This is the backing endpoint for the "Can view account-wide usage" checkbox on /settings/team.

```php
$result = $sendseven->users()->setAccountBillingAccess(userId: 'user_id', enabled: true);
```

- Scopes: `team:admin`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$userId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$enabled` | `bool` | yes | True grants the member a direct account:billing_read scope; False revokes it |

Returns `AccountBillingAccess`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Users/set_account_billing_access_api_v1_users__user_id__account_billing_access_put)

## updateRole

Update user's role in the tenant.

Only OWNER and ADMIN roles can update user roles. Only OWNER can change another OWNER's role.

```php
$result = $sendseven->users()->updateRole(userId: 'user_id', role: 'role');
```

Returns `UserRoleUpdate`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Users/update_user_role_api_v1_users__user_id__role_patch)


## createEndpoint

Create Webhook Endpoint. `POST /webhook-endpoints`

Create a new webhook endpoint.

Creates a webhook endpoint and returns the secret key for HMAC verification. Important: The secret key is shown only once - store it securely!

```php
$result = $sendseven->webhooks()->createEndpoint(name: 'name', url: 'url', subscribedEvents: []);
```

- Scopes: `webhooks:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$name` | `string` | yes | User-friendly name for the webhook |
| `$url` | `string` | yes | HTTPS URL to receive webhook events |
| `$subscribedEvents` | `list<string>` | yes | List of event types to subscribe to |
| `$authorizationHeader` | `?string` | no | Authorization header value to send with each webhook (e.g., 'Bearer token123') |
| `$retryStrategy` | `RetryStrategy\|string\|null` | no | Retry strategy for failed deliveries |
| `$maxRetries` | `?int` | no | Maximum number of retry attempts (default: 8, covers ~2 hours with exponential backoff) |
| `$timeoutSeconds` | `?int` | no | Request timeout in seconds |
| `$sourceFilterMode` | `?string` | no | Source filtering mode: 'all' receives events from all channels, 'selected' only receives events from specified channels/integrations |
| `$filteredChannelIds` | `list<string>\|null` | no | Channel IDs to filter events by (only used when source_filter_mode='selected') |
| `$filteredEmailIntegrationIds` | `list<string>\|null` | no | Email integration IDs to filter events by (only used when source_filter_mode='selected') |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `WebhookSecret`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Webhooks/create_webhook_endpoint_api_v1_webhook_endpoints_post)

## retryDelivery

Retry Webhook Delivery. `POST /webhook-endpoints/{webhook_id}/deliveries/{delivery_id}/retry`

Manually retry a failed or dead_letter webhook delivery.

Re-queues a failed delivery for immediate sending. This creates a new delivery record and publishes it to the webhooks queue for processing.

```php
$result = $sendseven->webhooks()->retryDelivery(webhookId: 'webhook_id', deliveryId: 'delivery_id');
```

- Scopes: `webhooks:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |

| `$deliveryId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `WebhookRetry`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Webhooks/retry_webhook_delivery_api_v1_webhook_endpoints__webhook_id__deliveries__delivery_id__retry_post)

## sendTest

Send Test Webhook. `POST /webhook-endpoints/{webhook_id}/test`

Send a test webhook event.

Sends a test event to the webhook endpoint with sample data. The webhook must be verified to receive test events.

```php
$result = $sendseven->webhooks()->sendTest(webhookId: 'webhook_id');
```

- Scopes: `webhooks:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$webhookId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$body` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | The request body |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `WebhookTest`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Webhooks/send_test_webhook_api_v1_webhook_endpoints__webhook_id__test_post)

## verifyEndpoint

Verify Webhook Endpoint. `POST /webhook-endpoints/{webhook_id}/verify`

Sends a verification challenge to the webhook URL. The endpoint must respond with the challenge to become verified and active.

```php
$result = $sendseven->webhooks()->verifyEndpoint(webhookId: 'webhook_id');
```
