## getSendingLimit

Get Whatsapp Sending Limit. `GET /whatsapp/channels/{channel_id}/sending-limit`

Get a WhatsApp channel's persisted *sending limit* (messaging tier).

Lean replacement for the live-fetching /account-status endpoint on the Settings → Channels page. Instead of hitting Meta on every page open, this endpoint serves a value persisted onto the channel's encrypted config and re-queries the provider at most once per 24h per channel (server-side, authoritative gate). Safe to call on every page load: it is idempotent and cheap, and it NEVER 500s the page — a provider/token failure degrades to the last-known value with stale=True and a soft error.

```php
$sendseven->whatsApp()->getSendingLimit(channelId: 'channel_id');
```

- Scopes: `channels:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$channelId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `void`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/WhatsApp/get_whatsapp_sending_limit_api_v1_whatsapp_channels__channel_id__sending_limit_get)

## getCallWindow

Get Whatsapp Call Window. `GET /whatsapp/conversations/{conversation_id}/call-window`

Whether an OUTBOUND WhatsApp call can be placed on this conversation now, plus the call-permission window expiry (Feature #34 backend half).

Mirrors /conversations/{id}/whatsapp-window (the 24h MESSAGING window) but for the CALL-permission window. WhatsApp's business-initiated calling requires an open call-permission window — granted by the customer (a permission grant or a prior connected call) and lasting 7 days (168h). The "Call" button in the conversation view gates on this.

```php
$result = $sendseven->whatsApp()->getCallWindow(conversationId: 'conversation_id');
```

- Scopes: `calls:view`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$conversationId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `array<array-key, mixed>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/WhatsApp/get_whatsapp_call_window_api_v1_whatsapp_conversations__conversation_id__call_window_get)

## getWindowStatus

Get Whatsapp Window Status. `GET /whatsapp/conversations/{conversation_id}/whatsapp-window`

Get WhatsApp messaging window status for a conversation

WhatsApp Business API restricts sending free-form messages outside a window after the last customer message. This endpoint returns the current window status so the UI can gate free-form vs template composition.

$result = $sendseven->whatsApp()->getWindowStatus(conversationId: 'conversation_id');

## sendFlow

Send Whatsapp Flow. `POST /whatsapp/flows/send`

Send a WhatsApp Flow message to a contact

WhatsApp Flows allow businesses to create rich, interactive experiences within WhatsApp conversations. The flow must exist and be published (or in draft mode for testing).

```php
$result = $sendseven->whatsApp()->sendFlow(channelId: 'channel_id', flowId: 'flow_id', flowCta: 'flow_cta');
```

- Scopes: `messages:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

| `$flowId` | `string` | yes | WhatsApp Flow ID |
| `$flowCta` | `string` | yes | Button text to trigger flow (max 20 chars) |
| `$contactId` | `?string` | no | Contact ID to send to |
| `$recipient` | `?string` | no | Recipient phone number (alternative to contact_id) |
| `$body` | `?string` | no | Message body text |
| `$header` | `?string` | no | Optional header text |
| `$footer` | `?string` | no | Optional footer text |
| `$screen` | `?string` | no | Initial screen to navigate to |
| `$data` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Data to pre-populate flow fields |
| `$mode` | `FlowMode\|string\|null` | no | Flow mode: draft or published |
| `$conversationId` | `?string` | no | Link to existing conversation (creates new if not provided) |
| `$flowToken` | `?string` | no | Optional tracking token (auto-generated if not provided) |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `SendFlow`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/WhatsApp/send_whatsapp_flow_api_v1_whatsapp_flows_send_post)

## connect

Connect Catalogue. `POST /whatsapp-catalog/connect`

Connect a Meta product catalogue to a WhatsApp channel.

Consumes the catalogue token/code from the FBLB dialog, resolves the catalogue id from the token's catalog_management granular scope, and persists the (encrypted) token + catalogue id on the channel.

```php
$result = $sendseven->whatsAppCatalogue()->connect(channelId: 'channel_id');
```

- Scopes: `channels:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$channelId` | `string` | yes | The WhatsApp channel to attach the catalogue to |
| `$code` | `?string` | no | Authorization CODE from the FBLB catalogue dialog. Exchanged server-side for an access token. Provide this OR access_token. |
| `$accessToken` | `?string` | no | A catalogue access token already exchanged client-side. Provide this OR code. |
| `$catalogId` | `?string` | no | Optional explicit catalogue id (e.g. copied from Meta Business Suite, or forwarded from the dialog's session_info). Guaranteed unblock for Coexistence numbers, where no Graph edge auto-returns the linked catalogue id. When supplied it is VERIFIED server-side (GET /{catalog_id}/products) before persisting and may be sent alone (without 'code'/'access_token'), since the channel's own WhatsApp token can read a Business-Manager catalogue. When omitted, the id is auto-resolved from the token's granular catalog_management scope. Must be a numeric Meta id. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `CatalogueConnect`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/WhatsApp%20Catalogue/connect_catalogue_api_v1_whatsapp_catalog_connect_post)

## create

Create Template. `POST /whatsapp-templates`

Create a new WhatsApp message template

Submits a new template to Meta for approval. Templates typically take 24-48 hours to be reviewed and approved.

```php
$result = $sendseven->whatsAppTemplates()->create(channelId: 'channel_id', name: 'name', category: 'category', components: []);
```

- Scopes: `channels:admin`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$channelId` | `string` | yes | WhatsApp channel ID |
| `$name` | `string` | yes | Template name (lowercase, numbers, underscores only) |
| `$category` | `TemplateCategory\|string` | yes | Template category |
| `$components` | `list<array<string, mixed>>` | yes | Template components |
| `$language` | `?string` | no | ISO language code (e.g., en, de, es) |
| `$allowCategoryChange` | `?bool` | no | Allow Meta to change template category if needed |
| `$parameterFormat` | `?string` | no | Placeholder style for the template body. positional uses {{1}}, {{2}}, ...; named uses identifier placeholders like {{first_name}}. When named, supply body_named_examples instead of example.body_text on the BODY component. |
| `$bodyNamedExamples` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Example values for NAMED placeholders, keyed by placeholder name (e.g., {"first_name": "John", "order_id": "ORD-123"}). Required when parameter_format='named'. Ignored when parameter_format='positional' (use example.body_text on the BODY component instead). |
| `$messageSendTtlSeconds` | `?int` | no | AUTHENTICATION templates only. Time-to-live for the delivered code message (30-900 seconds). WhatsApp stops trying to deliver the message after this window. Ignored for other categories. |
| `$defaultHeaderMediaUrl` | `?string` | no | Default header media URL for IMAGE/VIDEO/DOCUMENT templates. Persisted alongside the template so the send path can fall back to it when callers don't pass header_media_url. Typically the public URL returned by POST /upload-media. |
| `$defaultHeaderDocumentFilename` | `?string` | no | Default filename presented to the recipient for DOCUMENT-type headers. Persisted alongside the template so the send path can fall back to it when callers don't pass header_document_filename. Should include the correct file extension (e.g. 'invoice.pdf'). Only meaningful for DOCUMENT header templates. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `CreateTemplate`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/WhatsApp%20Templates/create_template_api_v1_whatsapp_templates_post)

## adoptLibrary

Adopt Library Template. `POST /whatsapp-templates/library/adopt`

Add a template from Meta's Template Library to the customer's WABA.

messages:create is accepted on purpose: the primary entry point is an agent in /conversations who has no approved template and needs one to open the 24h window. Adopting an unchanged library template is a pre-approved, Meta-curated action — gating it behind channel administration would break exactly the flow it exists for.

```php
$result = $sendseven->whatsAppTemplates()->adoptLibrary(channelId: 'channel_id', libraryTemplateName: 'library_template_name');
```

- Scopes: `channels:admin`, `messages:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$channelId` | `string` | yes | WhatsApp channel whose WABA receives the template |
| `$libraryTemplateName` | `string` | yes | name of the library entry (e.g. delivery_update_1) |
| `$language` | `?string` | no | Meta language code to create it in |
| `$category` | `?string` | no | Defaults to the library entry's category (UTILITY / AUTHENTICATION) |
| `$name` | `?string` | no | Name for the created template. Defaults to the library template name. Normalised to lowercase/underscores. |
| `$buttonInputs` | `list<array<string, mixed>>\|null` | no | Customer-specific button values. Omit to accept the library entry's own example values — this is what the one-click flow in /conversations does. |
| `$snapshot` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | The library entry exactly as the client displayed it. Used as the content source when Meta rate-limits the confirmation lookup, so a 429 never blocks the customer's first send. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `AdoptLibraryTemplate`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/WhatsApp%20Templates/adopt_library_template_api_v1_whatsapp_templates_library_adopt_post)

## suggestMapping

Suggest Mapping. `GET /whatsapp-templates/suggest-mapping`

Suggest canonical variable_mapping keys for a list of placeholder names.

Returns a dict keyed by the input name. Unknown names map to None so the caller can render an empty dropdown for the user to fill in.

```php
$result = $sendseven->whatsAppTemplates()->suggestMapping(names: 'names');
```

- Scopes: `channels:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$names` | `string` | yes | Comma-separated list of NAMED template placeholder names (e.g. first_name,workspace,order_id). |

Returns `array<array-key, mixed>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/WhatsApp%20Templates/suggest_mapping_api_v1_whatsapp_templates_suggest_mapping_get)

## sync

Sync Templates. `POST /whatsapp-templates/sync`

Sync templates from WhatsApp Business API

Fetches all message templates from WhatsApp Business API and syncs them to the local database. This operation: - Adds new templates - Updates existing templates - Removes templates that no longer exist in WhatsApp

```php
$result = $sendseven->whatsAppTemplates()->sync(channelId: 'channel_id');
```

- Scopes: `channels:admin`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$channelId` | `string` | yes | WhatsApp channel ID to sync templates for |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `WhatsAppTemplateSync`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/WhatsApp%20Templates/sync_templates_api_v1_whatsapp_templates_sync_post)

## translate

Translate a WhatsApp template. `POST /whatsapp-templates/translate`

Translate a template's text with SendSeven's AI translation.

```php
$result = $sendseven->whatsAppTemplates()->translate(bodyText: 'body_text', targetLanguage: 'target_language');
```

- Scopes: `templates:create`
- Not in SendSeven's spec; verified: Live: answered 422 naming body_text and target_language as required (1 Oct 2026); used by Renotify's template translation.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$bodyText` | `string` | yes | The template body to translate |
| `$targetLanguage` | `string` | yes | Language code to translate into, e.g. de |
| `$sourceLanguage` | `?string` | no | Language code of the text; detected when omitted |
| `$headerText` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$footerText` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$buttonTexts` | `list<string>\|null` | no |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `array<array-key, mixed>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/WhatsApp%20Templates/translate_whatsapp_template_api_v1_whatsapp_templates_translate_post)

## uploadMedia

Upload Template Media. `POST /whatsapp-templates/upload-media`

Upload media for WhatsApp template header

Uploads an image, video, or document to Meta's servers and returns a handle that can be used when creating a template with a media header.

```php
$result = $sendseven->whatsAppTemplates()->uploadMedia(channelId: 'channel_id', mediaType: 'media_type', file: FilePart::fromPath('/path/to/file.pdf'));
```

- Scopes: `channels:admin`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$channelId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$mediaType` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$file` | `FilePart` | yes |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `MediaUpload`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/WhatsApp%20Templates/upload_template_media_api_v1_whatsapp_templates_upload_media_post)

## send

Send Template. `POST /whatsapp-templates/{template_id_or_name}/send`

Send a template message to a contact

Sends the specified WhatsApp template to the contact. The template must be approved by WhatsApp before it can be sent.

```php
$result = $sendseven->whatsAppTemplates()->send(templateIdOrName: 'template_id_or_name');
```

- Scopes: `messages:create`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$templateIdOrName` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$contactId` | `?string` | no | Contact to send the message to. OPTIONAL — supply ANY ONE of contact_id, contact_method_id, conversation_id, or whatsapp_id to identify the recipient. If contact_method_id is also provided it WINS and this contact_id is ignored. When combined with whatsapp_id, this contact is used (and a matching WhatsApp contact method is auto-created on it if missing). |
| `$contactMethodId` | `?string` | no | OPTIONAL. A contact_methods.id (UUID) of type whatsapp_id or whatsapp_bsuid owned by the tenant. When provided it determines BOTH the recipient WhatsApp id (the method's value) AND the contact (the method's owning contact). Highest-priority recipient selector — if both contact_id and contact_method_id are given, contact_method_id WINS and contact_id is ignored. A method of any other type returns 422. |
| `$whatsAppId` | `?string` | no | OPTIONAL. A WhatsApp recipient id sent directly — a phone number WITHOUT a leading + (a leading + is stripped; spaces/dashes/parens are tolerated for phone-shaped values), an alphanumeric WhatsApp id (Meta now permits alphanumeric ids — digits are NOT required), OR a Business-scoped user ID such as US.13491208655302741918 (kept verbatim, periods included, and sent in Meta's recipient field instead of to). The value is normalized with the same canonical contact-method normalization used elsewhere so dedup is consistent. If contact_id is also supplied, that contact gains a whatsapp_id (or whatsapp_bsuid) method with this value (created if missing); otherwise an existing contact is matched by this identifier, or a new contact + method is created. Note that AUTHENTICATION templates cannot be sent to a Business-scoped user ID (Meta error 131062). When sent without a conversation_id, the new conversation's channel is the template's channel (optionally selected via channel_id). |
| `$channelId` | `?string` | no | OPTIONAL. A WhatsApp channel id (UUID) owned by the tenant. Always allowed alongside any recipient selector. Used to (a) disambiguate a template referenced by NAME that exists on multiple channels, and (b) select the sending channel when sending by whatsapp_id with no contact/conversation. If it conflicts with the resolved template's own channel, the request returns 400. |
| `$variableValues` | `mixed` | no | Override auto-mapped values. Pass a list (positional only) or a dict (positional with numeric keys, or named with identifier keys). Shape must match the template's parameter_format. Reserved dict keys (coexist with body variable keys): - url_suffix — replaces {{1}} inside a dynamic URL button. Value is ONLY the suffix portion that fills {{1}}, not the full URL (e.g. for template URL https://example.com/orders/{{1}}, pass "url_suffix": "track/INV-2026-001"). - otp_code — the code copied by the user for authentication / OTP COPY_CODE buttons. |
| `$language` | `?string` | no | OPTIONAL. Template language to send when the template is referenced BY NAME and that name exists in multiple languages. Use the exact code stored in whatsapp_templates.language — the Meta language/locale code (e.g. en, de, en_US, pt_BR). Resolution when a name maps to multiple language rows (after the channel filter): if only one language remains it is used; if several remain, an explicit language selects that variant (400 if no such variant), else the recipient contact's stored language is matched (exact, then base-language family e.g. de_DE↔de), else 400 asking for language. When the template is referenced by DB ID the language is fixed by that row; passing a conflicting language returns 400. |
| `$conversationId` | `?string` | no | Link to existing conversation (creates new if not provided) |
| `$headerMediaUrl` | `?string` | no | Header media reference for IMAGE/VIDEO/DOCUMENT templates. Accepts ANY of: - a bare attachment_id (UUID) returned by POST /attachments or POST /whatsapp-templates/upload-media - the proxy URL /api/v1/attachments/{id}/download (relative or absolute) - the permanent public URL /api/v1/attachments/public/{tenant_id}/{id} - a legacy https://storage.googleapis.com/... GCS URL - any absolute external https:// URL (customer CDN, etc.) The server resolves the input to a Meta-deliverable URL via WhatsAppHeaderMediaService. Field name is kept for backwards compatibility — it has not been URL-only since May 2026. |
| `$headerDocumentFilename` | `?string` | no | Optional filename override for DOCUMENT-type template headers. Must include the correct file extension matching the document (e.g. 'invoice.pdf' for a PDF). Ignored for non-DOCUMENT headers. |
| `$cards` | `list<array<string, mixed>>\|null` | no | Per-card parameters for a CAROUSEL template, supplied POSITIONALLY — entry 0 fills the first card, entry 1 the second, etc. Provide one entry per card you want to personalize. When ABSENT the non-carousel send path is unchanged. Each entry carries its own variable_values (same positional/named rules as the top-level field) and header_media_url. Only meaningful for CAROUSEL templates; ignored otherwise. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `SendTemplate`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/WhatsApp%20Templates/send_template_api_v1_whatsapp_templates__template_id_or_name__send_post)

## delete

Delete Template. `DELETE /whatsapp-templates/{template_id}`

Delete a WhatsApp message template

Deletes the template from both Meta and local database. Note: Deleting an approved template will make it unavailable immediately.

```php
$sendseven->whatsAppTemplates()->delete(templateId: 'template_id');
```

- Scopes: `channels:admin`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$templateId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `void`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/WhatsApp%20Templates/delete_template_api_v1_whatsapp_templates__template_id__delete)

## get

Get Template. `GET /whatsapp-templates/{template_id}`

Get a specific WhatsApp template by ID

```php
$result = $sendseven->whatsAppTemplates()->get(templateId: 'template_id');
```

- Scopes: `channels:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$templateId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `WhatsAppTemplate`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/WhatsApp%20Templates/get_template_api_v1_whatsapp_templates__template_id__get)

## update

Update Template. `PATCH /whatsapp-templates/{template_id}`

Update local-only fields on a WhatsApp template.

Currently only default_header_media_url and default_header_document_filename are mutable here. Template content (body text, header, buttons) is approved by Meta and cannot be edited in place — to change those, delete and re-create the template.

```php
$result = $sendseven->whatsAppTemplates()->update(templateId: 'template_id');
```

- Scopes: `channels:admin`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$templateId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$components` | `list<array<string, mixed>>\|null` | no | Updated template components |
| `$defaultHeaderMediaUrl` | `?string` | no | Default header media URL for IMAGE/VIDEO/DOCUMENT templates. Used as fallback when callers do not pass header_media_url on send. Pass an empty string to clear. |
| `$defaultHeaderDocumentFilename` | `?string` | no | Default filename presented to the recipient for DOCUMENT-type headers. Used as fallback when callers do not pass header_document_filename on send. Pass an empty string to clear; omit the field to leave it unchanged. Only meaningful for DOCUMENT header templates. |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `WhatsAppTemplate`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/WhatsApp%20Templates/update_template_api_v1_whatsapp_templates__template_id__patch)

## preview

Preview Template. `POST /whatsapp-templates/{template_id}/preview`

Preview a template with variable substitution

Returns the template with placeholders replaced using either: - Contact data (if contact_id provided) - Override values (if variable_values provided) - Sample data (if neither provided)

```php
$result = $sendseven->whatsAppTemplates()->preview(templateId: 'template_id');
```

- Scopes: `channels:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$templateId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$contactId` | `?string` | no | Contact ID to use for preview (optional - uses sample data if not provided) |
| `$variableValues` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Override values for preview |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `PreviewTemplate`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/WhatsApp%20Templates/preview_template_api_v1_whatsapp_templates__template_id__preview_post)

## updateVariableMapping

Update Variable Mapping. `PUT /whatsapp-templates/{template_id}/variable-mapping`

Update variable mapping for a template

Maps WhatsApp template placeholders ({{1}}, {{2}}, etc.) to contact fields for automatic personalization when sending messages.

```php
$result = $sendseven->whatsAppTemplates()->updateVariableMapping(templateId: 'template_id', variableMapping: []);
```

- Scopes: `channels:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$templateId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$variableMapping` | `array<string, mixed>` | yes | Map placeholders to contact fields: {'1': 'contact.first_name'} |

Returns `UpdateVariableMapping`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/WhatsApp%20Templates/update_variable_mapping_api_v1_whatsapp_templates__template_id__variable_mapping_put)

# Widgets

`$sendseven->widgets()` — 11 endpoints.

| Method | HTTP | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`list()`](#list) | `GET /widgets` | List Widgets |
| [`create()`](#create) | `POST /widgets` | Create Widget |
| [`delete()`](#delete) | `DELETE /widgets/{widget_id}` | Delete Widget |
| [`get()`](#get) | `GET /widgets/{widget_id}` | Get Widget |
| [`update()`](#update) | `PUT /widgets/{widget_id}` | Update Widget |
| [`getAnalytics()`](#getanalytics) | `GET /widgets/{widget_id}/analytics` | Get Widget Analytics |
| [`getEmbedCode()`](#getembedcode) | `GET /widgets/{widget_id}/embed-code` | Get Embed Code |
| [`getIdentityVerification()`](#getidentityverification) | `GET /widgets/{widget_id}/identity-verification` | Get Identity Verification |
| [`updateIdentityVerification()`](#updateidentityverification) | `PUT /widgets/{widget_id}/identity-verification` | Update Identity Verification |
| [`revealIdentityVerificationSecret()`](#revealidentityverificationsecret) | `POST /widgets/{widget_id}/identity-verification/reveal` | Reveal Identity Verification Secret |
| [`rotateIdentityVerificationSecret()`](#rotateidentityverificationsecret) | `POST /widgets/{widget_id}/identity-verification/rotate` | Rotate Identity Verification Secret |

## getIdentityVerification

Get Identity Verification. `GET /widgets/{widget_id}/identity-verification`

Get the identity verification status of a widget

Returns whether signed identities are verified, whether a secret exists, the last 4 characters of the secret and when it was generated. Never returns the secret itself.

```php
$result = $sendseven->widgets()->getIdentityVerification(widgetId: 'widget_id');
```

- Scopes: `widgets:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$widgetId` | `string` | yes |  |

Returns `WidgetIdentityVerification`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Widgets/get_identity_verification_api_v1_widgets__widget_id__identity_verification_get)

## updateIdentityVerification

Update Identity Verification. `PUT /widgets/{widget_id}/identity-verification`

Enable or disable identity verification for a widget

Body: {"enabled": true} or {"enabled": false}. Enabling requires a secret (generate one with the rotate endpoint first), otherwise 409 secret_required.

```php
$result = $sendseven->widgets()->updateIdentityVerification(widgetId: 'widget_id');
```

- Scopes: `widgets:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$widgetId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$enabled` | `mixed` | no | true to enable verification, false to disable it |

Returns `WidgetIdentityVerification`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Widgets/update_identity_verification_api_v1_widgets__widget_id__identity_verification_put)

## revealIdentityVerificationSecret

Reveal Identity Verification Secret. `POST /widgets/{widget_id}/identity-verification/reveal`

Reveal the current identity verification secret of a widget

Returns 404 secret_not_found when no secret has been generated yet.

```php
$result = $sendseven->widgets()->revealIdentityVerificationSecret(widgetId: 'widget_id');
```

- Scopes: `settings:admin`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$widgetId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `WidgetIdentitySecretReveal`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Widgets/reveal_identity_verification_secret_api_v1_widgets__widget_id__identity_verification_reveal_post)

## rotateIdentityVerificationSecret

Rotate Identity Verification Secret. `POST /widgets/{widget_id}/identity-verification/rotate`

Generate a new identity verification secret for a widget

Returns the new secret. The previous secret stops working immediately, so every identity signed with it falls back to unverified until your server signs with the new one. Store the secret on your server only; never put it in browser code.

```php
$result = $sendseven->widgets()->rotateIdentityVerificationSecret(widgetId: 'widget_id');
```

- Scopes: `settings:admin`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$widgetId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `WidgetIdentitySecretRotate`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Widgets/rotate_identity_verification_secret_api_v1_widgets__widget_id__identity_verification_rotate_post)
